title: Sr Manager, Adobe Ventures
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe generated ~$24B revenue in FY 2025 and has completed ~$10B in strategic acquisitions since 2018. Our Corporate Development team strategically identifies, sources, evaluates, and implement Adobe’s inorganic growth roadmap, including acquisitions and investments. We are looking for grounded, thoughtful, and collaborative teammates to drive Adobe shareholder value through exceptional, ground-breaking opportunities

Adobe Ventures is our strategic VC program. We invest in exceptional founders and start-ups who share our vision to empower everyone to create. The Senior Manager role is crucial on Adobe’s Corporate Development team. They source and evaluate investment opportunities, deliver deals, and support portfolio growth to improve strategic value for Adobe and its investments. I work with deal teams, business unit (BU) sponsors, and internal and external collaborators to improve strategic value for Adobe and its portfolio companies.

The Challenge

Investing & Sourcing: Market Research, Exploratory Sourcing & Deal Support

  • Build and maintain market landscapes and investment theses; proactively source and qualify opportunities through outbound outreach, founder/fund engagement, and first meetings; cultivate relationships across venture, founder, and internal networks.
  • Maintain a robust, well-documented pipeline across themes and Adobe's business with the CDA team, including CRM hygiene, clear next steps, and timely follow-ups.
  • Lead early-stage diligence (market/competitive, product/positioning, and customer/reference calls) and synthesize findings into clear recommendations and open questions for decision-making.
  • Craft compelling investment narratives and materials, such as briefs and pre-IC/IC memos. These should explain why now is the right time and why this team is the best fit. Work with partners in legal, finance, and other areas to complete investments.

Portfolio Management

  • Serve as the bridge between portfolio companies and Adobe—driving key introductions, advancing priority workstreams, and enabling partnerships (including commercial relationships) including via the Adobe Ventures Advisory Board.
  • Develop and track comprehensive value metrics, including partnerships, product integration, commercial outcomes, and learning opportunities, and regularly synthesize/report progress and impact.
  • Marketing, Events, Communications and Operations
  • Own Ventures events and marketing across key moments (Tech Week, MAX/Summit activations) and channels (social, web, external comms).
  • Track event/networking conversion to qualified deal flow; report insights and optimization actions.
  • Lead Ventures internal communications and enablement with cross-functional partners (Comms, Adobe.com, Brand Social), including employee updates and All Hands.
  • Produce year-end Ventures performance recap for executives covering investments, partnership wins, brand/program updates, and events.
  • Manage Ventures operating cadence and hygiene, partnering with Ventures Ops.

What is needed to succeed

  • Interest and experience in Adobe’s key businesses (Creativity & Productivity, Customer Experience Orchestration).
  • Demonstrated network of relevant high-growth tech founders and industry contacts.
  • Strategic problem solver that connects the dots. High EQ, executive influencing and business intuition.
  • Attention to detail. Strong work ethic. Proactive self-starter. Calm under pressure. Able to adapt to fast paced, ambiguous environments. High learning agility. Consummate teammate.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including presentation and memo formats. Strong spoken communication skills.
  • 5-8 years of cumulative experience in corporate VC, corporate development, investment banking, or venture capital / private equity. Experience in product, operations, SaaS, consumer tech, and enterprise software are a plus.
  • BA/BS or equivalent experience from a top university in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar field; MBA is preferred. years of equivalent practical experience

The Opportunity

With Adobe Experience Platform, our enterprise customers manage their entire data lifecycle. We are looking for hands on engineers to join our core team. In this role, you will architect, develop, and deploy large scale applications that serve Fortune 500 companies. This is an opportunity to work on the Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RTCDP) using innovative technologies to process massive data pipelines and build sophisticated systems.

What You'll Do

  • Define and implement new services and components of Adobe RTCDP services.
  • Develop and own critical features within a microservice architecture.
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster a high performing team culture.
  • Collaborate closely with architects and product managers to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Ensure the quality of your components through rigorous testing, validation and monitoring.
  • Stay curious and introduce new technologies or process improvements to keep our products efficient and scalable.

What You Need to Succeed

  • A degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Experience building highly performant backend and data applications.
  • Proven expertise in Java or Scala.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining RESTful API services.
  • Hands on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Deep understanding of large scale distributed systems and technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, or Hadoop.
  • Proficiency in cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Take full ownership of tasks and thrives with a high degree of independence.
  • Natural curiosity for self-learning and staying ahead of the rapidly evolving tech landscape.
  • Experience shipping production quality applications and conducting constructive code reviews.
  • Clear technical communication and a dedication to extensive documentation.

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms.
  • Familiarity with marketing platforms and CRMs.
  • Exposure to generative AI and machine learning technologies.

title: Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe is driving its next phase of growth by building deep, dynamic partnerships with our most strategic global accounts—helping them reinvent customer and employee experiences, rationalize operations and technologies, and accelerate innovation. We are seeking a Sr. Director to lead Adobe’s Strategic Partner Accounts (SPA) organization: a portfolio of 11 of our highest-value global customers spanning Ad Agencies, Technology Hyperscalers, and System Integrators. This is Adobe’s only sales team with full cross-cloud ownership of both Creative & Productivity and Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) revenue across a global account set.

You will lead a team of 22—including 2 First-Line Managers, 11 Global Account Directors (each owning a single account end-to-end), and 9 Account Directors—and serve as the senior executive face of Adobe to the world’s most consequential organizations.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio Strategy & Executive Leadership

  • Establish and lead 3+ year joint account strategies and roadmaps, aligning enterprise objectives, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes across all SPA accounts.

  • Define and reinforce joint governance models ensuring alignment and executive sponsorship across each global account.

  • Develop and maintain C-suite relationships that support priority initiatives, remove barriers, and accelerate long-term account growth.

  • Lead executive-level storytelling and performance communications to both business and IT audiences.

Growth, Adoption & Value Realization

  • Own aggregate SPA portfolio revenue performance across all clouds—driving durable growth, long-term retention, and full cross-cloud expansion.

  • Drive adoption of Adobe’s newest capabilities—including agentic AI, CX Enterprise, and Firefly Enterprise—by translating them into each account’s transformation priorities.

  • Orchestrate the account lifecycle globally from vision and strategy through sales, post-sales implementation, and sustained consumption.

Co-Innovation & Market Opportunity Development

  • Establish account-specific frameworks to identify, evaluate, and execute co-innovation opportunities that respond to emerging market needs.

  • Coordinate high-impact executive engagements: company visits, strategic briefings, joint ideation workshops, and Adobe Summit activations.

  • Partner with Adobe Marketing to drive engagement plans and events that deepen executive sponsorship across the portfolio.

Leadership, Operating Model & Team Orchestration

  • Lead and develop 2 FLMs, coaching them to operate independently with commercial authority; build the overall team’s capability to engage at executive level across complex, global accounts.

  • Establish and maintain operating cadence—pipeline governance, QBRs, account planning—that drives predictability and accountability without administrative burden.

  • Act as the internal champion for the SPA organization—aligning Services, Product, Marketing, and Finance to resource and prioritize the portfolio appropriately.

  • Evolve the SPA operating model in partnership with senior leadership as the team’s charter, account scope, and strategic purpose continue to develop.

Successful engagement will be defined by durable revenue growth across the SPA portfolio, increasing C-suite executive sponsorship depth, team performance and development, and the maturation of SPA’s strategic identity within Adobe’s broader go-to-market.

title: Global Alliance Director - WPP
descriptionHtml:
Global Alliance Director - WPP

This role serves as the General Manager of one of Adobe’s most strategic global agency alliances, WPP, with end-to-end accountability for strategy, growth, and business performance. Operating as the senior-most leader for the partnership, this executive will define and execute a multi-year vision to scale revenue, expand market influence, and drive co-innovation across Adobe’s cross-cloud ecosystem. 


The GM will own the alliance as a business—shaping joint investments, orchestrating global go-to-market (GTM), and ensuring measurable outcomes across pipeline, bookings, and customer success. This leader will act as the primary executive interface between Adobe and the partner, aligning C-suite stakeholders and mobilizing global teams to deliver differentiated solutions and sustained growth. 


This is a highly visible leadership role requiring a combination of strategic thinking, commercial rigor, and executive influence, with the ability to operate across a complex, matrixed global organization. 

Key Responsibilities 

General Management & Alliance Strategy 

  • Own the global alliance as a business, including vision, strategy, and multi-year growth plan aligned to Adobe’s corporate priorities 
  • Define and drive joint investment strategy, ensuring focus on highest-value opportunities across industries, geographies, and solution areas 
  • Identify, incubate, and scale new revenue streams, business models, and innovation opportunities 

Revenue Growth & Market Expansion 

  • Lead end-to-end revenue accountability, including partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and long-term growth targets 
  • Architect and scale global co-sell motions, including alignment with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, to increase deal velocity and win rates 
  • Personally engage in strategic deal shaping, executive sponsorship, and closing of high-impact opportunities 

Executive Leadership & Influence 

  • Serve as the primary executive relationship owner with the partner, building deep, trust-based engagement at the C-suite level 
  • Align partner executives with Adobe’s senior leadership to drive shared priorities, investments, and accountability 
  • Represent the alliance externally through industry events, thought leadership, and executive forums 

Joint Solutions & Category Leadership 

  • Lead the development and global GTM of differentiated joint offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes – needs familiarity with agency services offerings and associated Mar-Tech/Ad-Tech. 
  • Champion Adobe’s cross-cloud strategy within the partner ecosystem to accelerate adoption of integrated solutions 
  • Position the alliance as a market leader through co-innovation, IP development, and industry-specific solutions 

Global Operating Model & Governance 

  • Establish and adhere a world-class governance model, including executive steering committees, QBRs, and performance management frameworks 
  • Own and drive a balanced scorecard across pipeline, bookings, partner practice growth, and customer success metrics 
  • Ensure operational excellence and consistency across regions while enabling local market agility 

Field Alignment & Team Leadership 

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing, globally distributed team (direct and matrixed) supporting the alliance 
  • Drive tight alignment between Adobe field sales and partner teams to maximize market coverage and impact – be a change agent  
  • Build scalable engagement models that increase leverage, efficiency, and speed of execution 

Experience & Leadership Profile 

  • 15+ years of experience in global alliances and global agencies, strategic partnerships, and/or enterprise sales leadership 
  • Proven success operating with global accountability for revenue growth and partnership performance at scale 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-level executives and lead within complex, matrixed global organizations 
  • Strong commercial acumen, including pipeline development, deal structuring, and forecasting 
  • Experience leading global teams and driving cross-functional execution in high-growth environments 
  • Recognized as a thought leader with strong executive presence, communication, and negotiation skills 
  • Experience working with or within global agency ecosystems strongly preferred

title: Customer Success Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Challenge
Adobe Managed Services provides digital marketing solutions for strategic customers who provide a digital marketing presence to their end users via Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Customer Success Engineers (CSEs) are customer-facing engineers who partner with their assigned customers to drive value realization, return on investment and help the customer deliver on marketing goals. CSEs interact with their customers to understand business and technical requirements, build long term relationships, and develop and operate AEM cloud solutions that delight customers and meet SLAs.
 

***This role requires ability to achieve a Top Secret security Clearance, hands on Linux experience and front-end developer experience.
 

This position includes the following aspects:
Strategic client relationship management. CSEs are assigned as a designated technical operation advisor for 5 to 7 customers who are using Adobe Experience Manager and other digital marketing products.


The CSE role is equally:
1. Client-facing (developing long term client relationships),
2. Keyboard-facing (technical operations)
3. Colleague-facing (developing your own subject matter expertise, and drawing on that of your peers in a collaborative environment)


CSEs are tech-savvy trusted advisors who champion projects and initiatives and act as facilitators between clients, third party providers, project managers, internal engineering and automation engineers. There will be frequent interaction with clients including Directors of Fortune 500 companies.


What CSEs do:
Communicate consistently with clients throughout the contract lifecycle, calling out relevant issues where needed. We maintain client contact and provide status updates for all outstanding issues while continuing to handle client expectations, keeping clients satisfied and expectations realistic.


Help our clients achieve their business objectives by guiding or finding resources to answer clients' questions, identifying needs for account customization and coordinating changes to technical implementations.


Work closely with account teams and collaborate with other internal team members (consulting/project management/engineering services/customer support) to be sure mutual objectives are met in support of client happiness.


Support customer production websites. Solve technical issues, quickly resolve root cause issues and recommend and/or implement steps to resolution is a key component.


Lead all aspects of customer support to ensure timely closure of quality and security issues and provide project management for professional services requests.


Partner with customers to drive their strategic roadmap through Adobe technology solutions while driving Adobe Managed Services’ technical roadmap with customers.


Collaborate with the teams that provision, customize, monitor, handle and upgrade our cloud hosted Enterprise offerings.


The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a passion for digital marketing and client success and have a consistent track record of successfully leading client relationships and technical projects with an excellent work ethic and collaboration skills.
  • Be self-motivated and passionate about exceeding client expectations and understand enterprise internet business models and online processes, terminology, concepts and strategies.
  • Evaluate and adopt change and excel in high-stress situations, taking action to provide responsive, thoughtful dedication to client success.
  • Demonstrate excellent social, presentation, and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must meet eligibility requirements for obtaining Canadian Government Top Secret security clearance.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe's Experience Manager (AEM) and other DMA products teams to assist in developing new automation tools that improve efficiency and productivity.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in public cloud offerings (AWS, Azure, GCP) cloud operations and
  • Use Command/Control and CI/CD tools to enable next-generation cloud management solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, Apache web server, CDN, WAF, DNS, Java-based applications, Load balancing.
  • Front-end development experience with JavaScript and CSS.
  • Experience with operational monitoring tools (New Relic, Icinga, Splunk)

Special consideration given for:

  • Master's degree or other advanced education or equivalent experience
  • Prior account management experience with Fortune 500 clients
  • Knowledge of and experience with digital marketing technologies
  • Prior experience with customer success in a SaaS, or Managed Services company
  • Experience in highly secure environments such as FSI vertical

title: Principal Product Manager, GenAI Training Data
descriptionHtml:
The Research and AI team builds foundational generative AI models and applications for Adobe products, enabling customers to ideate, develop, and scale content in new ways.

We're looking for a Principal PM to define and drive our data roadmap, including sourcing and processing training data as we develop the next generation of generative capabilities. This position supports multimodal generative capabilities across images, video, and more. It is a technical role with deep impact, combining data engineering, applied science, and product thinking. You will act as a key connection between the data organization and modeling team to drive real customer impact.

What you'll do:

  • Define and own the data product roadmap, including the end-to-end pipeline to significantly scale training data in generative models.
  • Build systems and processes to increase value from data: prioritize what we acquire, how we process it, and ensure it maps directly to downstream model performance needs.
  • Translate between modeling requirements and data reality – transform customer asks into concrete, actionable data programs.
  • Partner closely with data engineering and applied science to build feedback loops that close the gap between model evaluation and data approach.
  • Build institutional knowledge around data decisions - what was included, why, how it was processed - so the team can reason about model behavior and iterate faster.
  • Make data health visible to the right collaborators at the right time.
  • Partner with legal and collaborators to ensure data programs meet needs around commercial safety.
  • Find opportunities to build proprietary data advantages such as reward models.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion in AI/ML or data-intensive environments.
  • Strong technical depth to hold conversations about data pipelines, model training, quality metrics, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical collaborators.
  • Detailed thinking to build for scale.
  • Proactivity and comfort with ambiguity to refine problem statements and move fast without waiting for perfect information.
  • Attitude centered on balancing value, coverage, quality distributions, and downstream impact.
  • Great partner collaboration to build trust with engineering, science, legal, and leadership.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with generative AI.
  • Experience building tools for creatives and designers.

title: Senior Product Manager,  Chief Accounting Office
descriptionHtml:
• The Opportunity 

    Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates.

    You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem.

    What You'll Do

  • S/4HANA Product Management Ownership
  • Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting.
  • Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams.
  • Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility.

  • • Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams.

    • Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering.

    Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership

    • Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals.

    • Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams.

    • Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments.

    • Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives.

    • Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers.

    Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap

    • Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements.

    • Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close.

    • Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows.

    • Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap.

    AI Feature Delivery & Innovation

    • Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines.

    • Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement.

    • Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform.

    • Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows.

    What you need to succeed

    • 8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations.

    • Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics).

    • Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting.

    • Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production.

    • Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models.

    • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes.

    • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development.

    • Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data.

    • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems.

    • Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent.

    • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training.

    Leadership & Soft Skills

    • Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences.

    • Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment.

    • Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy.

title: Workfront Competency manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role 

We are looking for a people leader who can elevate and scale a well-established Workfront practice at Adobe. This is a mature, scaled competency covering implementation, consulting, architecture, and delivery, and the focus here is on raising the bar across all of it. The right person develops talent, embeds AI into how the team works, holds a high standard on delivery quality, and represents the practice with credibility to customers and senior stakeholders. If you are as energised by building people and culture as you are by driving efficiency and business impact, this role is for you. 

What You'll Do 

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a diverse team of Workfront practitioners across implementation, consulting, and architecture, owning their performance, development, and career progression 
  • Execute competency initiatives that keep the practice sharp on Workfront platform developments, AI automation, and content supply chain trends 
  • Own the full competency cycle, defining skill frameworks, assessing proficiency gaps, and building targeted development plans to close them 
  • Champion AI adoption across the practice, identifying opportunities to embed AI tools into delivery workflows, knowledge management, and day to day operations to drive measurable efficiency gains 
  • Own delivery quality standards across the practice, establishing review mechanisms, feedback loops, and accountability structures that ensure consistently high customer outcomes 
  • Drive delivery excellence through playbooks, best practices, and reusable frameworks that raise quality and consistency across every engagement 
  • Act as a thought leader internally and externally, representing the Workfront practice in customer conversations, industry forums, and strategic initiatives 
  • Partner with pre-sales, delivery, and product teams to connect practice capabilities with market demand and commercial outcomes 
  • Maintain awareness of delivery health, utilisation, and customer satisfaction metrics, escalating and course correcting where needed

  • Background in enterprise technology consulting, work management platforms, or professional services, enough to lead a diverse technical practice with credibility 
  • Proven experience managing performance, career development, and team culture at scale across mixed roles and seniority levels 
  • Experience building or scaling skill frameworks and competency models within a mature practice

title: Senior Solution Architect – Content Supply Chain & AI Transformation
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity:

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that many of those interactions and experiences were touched by an Adobe product.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in EMEA. This role can be based anywhere in Germany, Paris or London.

This role is for a strategic, customer-facing architect who can help customers modernize content operations for the AI era. You will work with customers and prospects to understand their goals, capture requirements, shape scope, and translate complex needs into compelling solution direction that connects Adobe technology to clear business value.

While a strong foundation in CMS platforms and Adobe Experience Manager is essential, this is not simply a product architecture role. We are looking for someone who can elevate customer conversations—helping organizations rethink how content is planned, created, governed, activated, and optimized through Content Supply Chain, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging agentic approaches.

You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from business leaders to technical teams, using your CMS and digital experience background to bring credibility to strategic discussions. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Partner teams, you will lead discovery, shape roadmaps, create compelling presentations and proposals, and help customers understand how Adobe can accelerate transformation across content operations, experience delivery, and long-term innovation.

This is a highly collaborative, customer-facing role suited to someone who combines strategic thinking, technical credibility, and strong communication skills to help customers move from vision to action.

The role requires travel across EMEA of up to 30%.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead business and technical discovery sessions to understand customer objectives, requirements, constraints, risks and success measures
  • Capture and translate customer needs into clear solution strategies, recommendations, scoped proposals, and phased roadmaps
  • Create compelling customer-ready presentations, proposals, estimates, and solution narratives that articulate the value of Adobe technology
  • Help customers modernize content operations through Content Supply Chain strategies, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic approaches to experience delivery
  • Connect business priorities to architecture direction and help customers understand how Adobe solutions support transformation outcomes
  • Use your AEM and CMS background as a foundation for broader conversations around governance, reuse, metadata, operating models, and scalable content delivery
  • Advise customers on architecture approaches, integration patterns, risks, and best practices across enterprise CMS and digital experience environments
  • Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Partner teams to shape opportunities and support successful customer outcomes
  • Present confidently to executive and technical audiences, simplifying complex topics in business-friendly language and helping customers buy into the vision

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Significant experience in consulting, professional services, pre-sales, delivery, or enterprise digital transformation
  • Around 10+ years of relevant experience in customer-facing roles involving solutioning, scoping, advisory work, or strategic consulting
  • Strong experience with enterprise CMS platforms, with Adobe Experience Manager preferred
  • Experience capturing requirements, defining scope, supporting estimation, and developing proposals or customer-facing recommendations
  • Ability to translate business requirements into solution direction and communicate value clearly to both executive and technical stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of digital experience architecture, CMS integration patterns, and enterprise content management strategies
  • Interest in helping customers apply Content Supply Chain, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging agentic capabilities to real business challenges
  • Fluency in English is required. Any other european language (German, French,.. ) would be a plus.

As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog, https:// blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com.

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race or colour, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. This is what it means to be Adobe For All.

title: Creative Technologist-AI Studio
descriptionHtml:
Creative Technologist, AI Studio

Workflow Automation · Generative AI · Creative Production

The Opportunity

Adobe’s AI Studio partners with the world’s leading brands to produce campaign creative at scale. Creative Technologists are the builders at the center of that production engine — designing and maintaining the automated workflows that allow our Creative Designers to move faster, produce more, and focus on what only humans can do.

As Creative Technologist, you will architect and operate the technical infrastructure behind AI Studio’s creative production workflows. You bring deep hands-on fluency in ComfyUI, Weavy, and other node based design apps. and you know how to stitch those tools together into production-grade systems that scale. You are equally comfortable in a technical build session and a customer conversation , and you take personal ownership of the reliability and quality of everything you ship.

What You’ll Do

Build and Operate Production Workflows

  • Design, build, and maintain automated creative production workflows.
  • Architect end-to-end pipelines that integrate generative AI outputs into brand-compliant, activation-ready creative assets.
  • Develop and maintain reusable workflow components, node libraries, and prompt templates that accelerate production across the team.
  • Optimize pipelines for throughput and consistency, enabling high-volume variant production across formats, channels, and aspect ratios.
  • Monitor workflow performance, diagnose failures, and continuously improve reliability and output quality.

Collaborate with Creative and Operations Teams

  • Partner closely with Creative Designers, Motion Designers, and Content Operations Leads to translate campaign briefs into automated production pipelines.
  • Serve as the technical bridge between creative intent and workflow execution — ensuring that automated outputs meet the quality bar set by the creative team.
  • Document workflows, configurations, and best practices so the full team can build on and maintain your work.
  • Contribute to a growing internal knowledge base of workflow patterns, prompting strategies, and tooling integrations.

Partner with Customers and Inform the Product

  • Engage directly with customer counterparts to understand technical requirements and configure workflows that meet their brand and production standards.
  • Present workflow logic and capabilities clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translating complexity into confidence.
  • Provide structured feedback on Adobe tools and adjacent tools to help inform Adobe’s product roadmap.
  • Stay current on emerging tools and techniques — and bring what’s working back to the team.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in creative technology, workflow automation, or a related technical role — agency, in-house, or production studio environments all translate well.
  • Hands-on proficiency with ComfyUI, including custom node development, pipeline design, and troubleshooting.
  • Fluency in Adobe Creative Cloud; working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and related tools as workflow inputs and outputs.
  • Solid understanding of generative AI models, image generation pipelines, and prompt engineering best practices.
  • Ability to read and write code sufficient for workflow scripting and automation — Python, JavaScript, or equivalent is a strong plus.
  • Experience integrating APIs and third-party tools into production pipelines.
  • Strong communication skills across creative, technical, and business audiences.
  • A high bar for quality and a sense of ownership over the systems and outputs you build.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight timelines.
  • Experience in digital marketing, campaign production, or creative operations is a strong plus.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Observability
descriptionHtml:
The Team

We are a globally distributed team inside Adobe Developer Platforms. We own the observability platform Adobe's engineering ecosystem runs on – one of the largest logging deployments in the industry, spanning 50,000+ nodes, billions of OTel events daily, and an auth service we built in Go that handles 15,000 req/sec. Every Adobe engineer depends on what we ship.

We build it, we ship it, we run it.


What You Will Do

  • Design and operate Adobe's observability infrastructure at scale – Splunk, Loki, ClickHouse, Cortex, Tempo, and OTel collector pipelines processing billions of events daily

  • Drive cost optimisation: analyse pipeline data, build guardrails, and engage engineering teams

  • Build AI-powered tooling that surfaces actionable insights from high-volume log datasets and automates routine platform workflows

  • Own SLOs and SLIs for a platform thousands of engineers rely on every day

  • Own on-call, lead incident response for high-severity issues, and make every shift better than the last

  • Strong programming skills in Go and/or Python; experience building integrations and applications to large-scale Observability environments

title: Senior Manager, Channel Lead - YouTube
descriptionHtml:
Role overview

As our footprint on YouTube grows from supporting cutdowns into YouTube-first content, episodic shows, originals, and discovery-optimized content, we need a strategist fully dedicated to the platform. This person owns how we show up on YouTube end to end: channel strategy, content programming, creative direction, rollout, and audience growth. They are the in-house authority on what works on YouTube and they translate that into briefs, plans, and decisions the rest of the social team can complete.

What you’ll own

YouTube channel strategy. Define the channel’s positioning, content pillars, and programming model across long-form, Shorts, and live. Build the strategy for YouTube-first content, recurring installments, presentations, and original works. Creative strategy input. Partner alongside creative strategists to compose briefs so that concepts are built for YouTube from the beginning, not adapted after the fact. Translate platform mechanics (packaging, hooks, retention, pacing) into creative direction. Creative briefing. Brief creatives on YouTube-specific creative: thumbnails, titles, intros, episode structure, series formatting, and the differences between extended videos, short clips, and live broadcasts. Rollout and launch planning. Develop rollout strategies for new series, shows, and originals: programming cadence, sequencing, cross-platform support, and launch moments. Audience growth and engagement. Develop engagement and community strategies that grow subscribers, returning viewers, and watch time. Define how we use comments, community posts, premieres, and live. Discovery and optimization. Own YouTube search and suggested strategy. Manage packaging optimization, playlist organization, and channel layout. Structure content to be discoverable and citable through AI and answer engines (LLM-optimized content).

What you’ll do day to day

  • Develop and maintain the YouTube content and programming calendar.

  • Write YouTube strategy docs and feed requirements into creative strategist briefs.

  • Brief and review creative for platform fit before it ships.

  • Develop rollout plans for launches and recurring programming.

  • Analyze channel and video performance and turn findings into recommendations.

  • Partner with the social planner on scheduling and the creative team on execution.

  • Stay ahead of YouTube format, algorithm, and monetization shifts and advise the team accordingly.

What you bring

5+ years in YouTube, video, or content strategy, with a track record of growing channels or launching series and outstanding creative work. Deep YouTube proficiency: algorithm and discovery mechanics, packaging (titles and thumbnails), retention and average view duration, Shorts vs long-form vs live, playlists, and channel architecture. Strong analytics skills. Comfortable in YouTube Studio and reading retention curves and traffic source data to drive decisions. Experience briefing creative teams and partnering with creative strategists. You can translate platform insight into clear creative direction. Understanding of episodic and original content programming, including cadence, season structure, and host or talent collaboration. Working knowledge of search and discovery optimization, including structuring content for AI and answer-engine visibility.

title: Principal Architect
descriptionHtml:
Principal Architect


Location: San Jose, CA (Hybrid with min. 3 days in office)

Summary

Drives architectural evolution of Adobe’s Enterprise Customer Experience platform and applications through system and application design as well as technology innovation for Agentic AI solutions. This role will partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to define architecture strategy, influence product direction, and deliver highly scalable systems that support global-scale workloads, ensure data governance, and drive AI solutions.

This is a highly visible, leadership role requiring deep expertise in data management, distributed systems, and Agentic AI technologies, along with the ability to operate across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive end-to-end system architecture for large-scale data management, ensuring performance, security, and reliability
  • Drive the development, integration and adoption of AI-native services (including Agentic Tools, Skills and Context-sensitive Agentic Loops).
  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to translate business requirements into technical architecture
  • Lead architectural reviews, guide design decisions, and ensure adherence to best practices

title: Senior TPRM Consultant (Partner Engagements)
descriptionHtml:
Senior TPRM Consultant (Partner Engagements)

Location: 1540 Broadway, New York, NY 10036
Department: Corporate Controllership – Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
Reports to: Director of Third-Party Risk Governance & Awareness

Position Summary:

The Senior TPRM Consultant is responsible for supporting the development and management of the TPRM Program framework, specifically for the sales partner ecosystem (e.g., solution partners, system integrators, resellers and distributors). This role sits at the intersection of risk management, sales, legal, and sales operations — and requires someone who can independently drive risk conversations forward, not simply administer a process. Success in this role depends on your ability to lead — setting the agenda, holding partners and internal stakeholders accountable to timelines, and driving issues to closure.

The role supports the design, maintenance, and enforcement of TPRM policy, standards, and governance. In close partnership with risk domain leads and cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps advance program maturity, support regulatory alignment, and strengthen third-party risk practices across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the TPRM governance committees, including preparing materials and strategizing focused agendas that drive risk identification, mitigation, and oversight.
  • Set the TPRM governance framework by defining roles and responsibilities to ensure appropriate oversight of third-party engagements and manage associated risks; and enhancing risk treatment / risk acceptance processes.
  • Determine and establish program metrics, including key performance and risk indicators (KPIs/KRIs) to enable effective oversight of the TPRM program.
  • Maintain TPRM policies, procedures, and governance documentation to reflect regulatory changes and evolving industry standards.
  • Lead the management and oversight of third-party risk management control requirements and framework.
  • Support the development of board and senior management materials that clearly communicate TPRM objectives, priorities, and program health using metrics and thresholds.
  • Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of Adobe’s TPRM governance framework to strengthen risk management across all third-party relationships.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Sales, Sales Ops, Compliance, Procurement, Security) to ensure consistent application of TPRM policies and risk requirements.
  • Collaborate with the TPRM Training & Awareness Manager to design and deliver training and awareness materials that reinforce policy compliance and third-party lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of TPRM tools, technology, and workflows (e.g., GRC platforms).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in third-party risk management, governance, compliance, or related oversight roles with at minimum, 2 years of experience driving and managing projects or programs.
  • Strong understanding of third-party risk management and risk management fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., FCPA / UK Bribery Act, GDPR, NIST RMF, ISO 27001) and third-party risk management tools.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex risk data and synthesize into clear, actionable insights.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Solid understanding of related risk domains: regulatory, channel, fraud, information security, business continuity, data privacy, financial risk, and concentration risk.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CTPRP, CRISC, CISA, PMP).
  • Prior experience in TPRM 2nd line function team and/or from one of the Big4.
  • Experience with sales partner and fourth-party/subcontractor risks.

title: AI Studio - Content Operations Lead (GenStudio & Firefly)
descriptionHtml:
Content Operations Lead, AI Studio

Job Description

The Opportunity

Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.

This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.

What You’ll Do

Drive Programs and Unblock the Team

  • Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
  • Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
  • Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
  • Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

Own Data, Workflow, and Tooling

  • Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
  • Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
  • Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
  • Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

Support Creative Quality and Output

  • Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
  • Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
  • Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.

Be the Team’s Connective Tissue

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
  • Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
  • Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
  • Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
  • A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
  • Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
  • A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.
  • Experience in digital marketing, advertising production, or campaign operations is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and timelines are rarely forgiving.

title: Senior Director, Global Engagement
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

This position is a senior leadership role within the Government Relations team, responsible for designing and accomplishing our global plans for external engagement, third-party coalition building, and narrative development. This individual will be the architect of how the organization develops its public policy story externally. They will mobilize allies and manage relationships with trade associations, think tanks, advocacy organizations, and civil society groups. The goal is to promote the company's policy agenda at the federal, state, and international levels. This is a highly visible position that combines policy expertise with communications competence, partner management, and campaign strategy.

What you will do

  • Design and implement a global strategy for engaging third-party organizations including trade associations, NGOs, think tanks, academic institutions, and advocacy coalitions
  • Build, maintain, and activate a portfolio of external allies to advance our public policy priorities across federal, state, local, and international jurisdictions
  • Identify and cultivate new coalition partners and external validators in priority issue areas including technology policy, AI governance, data privacy, competition, and digital infrastructure

Narrative Development & Strategic Communications

  • Lead the development and execution of public affairs narratives and messaging frameworks that support the organization's policy campaigns
  • Oversee original research initiatives — including polling, public opinion surveys, and customer perception studies — to inform engagement strategy and policy positioning
  • Translate complex technical and policy issues into compelling, accessible content crafted for multiple external audiences including government officials, journalists, and the general public
  • Develop and distribute thought leadership content, white papers, briefing materials, and public-facing reports on key policy issues

Messaging and Referenceable Data/Arguments

  • Partner with Communications to build strong messaging around our business and governmental policy initiatives that can be used to advance them publicly and with governments.
  • Work to get our public policies referenced in bills, legislation and regulations you can talk about publicly
  • Work with 3rd parties and research firms to produce outside referenceable material that supports our positions
  • Work with the appropriate parts of the company to get more visible media moments with Adobe and public policy/govt so our voice is bigger and more impactful for the company.

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Build and lead coordinated public engagement initiatives that combine grassroots advocacy, earned media, coalition activation, and direct policymaker engagement
  • Manage rapid-response efforts during legislative or regulatory developments, coordinating external partners and internal team members to deliver timely, aligned messaging
  • Track developments globally and assess implications for coalition strategy and narrative positioning

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as an advisor to policy teams, providing guidance on engagement and coalition strategy
  • Partner with legal, communications, and government affairs leadership to ensure all engagement activities follows lobbying disclosure requirements and company policies

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, political consulting, essential communications, or a related field
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering successful third-party engagement strategies and public affairs campaigns at the national or global level
  • Deep experience managing relationships, advocacy organizations, think tanks, and other external partners
  • Proven expertise in public opinion research, polling methodology, and translating research findings into action
  • Experience working with or within Congress, the Executive Branch, state legislatures, or government bodies
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for a range of recipients such as policymakers, media, and the public

title: Senior Digital Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As an Digital Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful adoption of marketing technology platforms by increasing employee engagement, streamlining operational models, and driving sustainable change. You'll work with Adobe’s largest enterprise customers, guiding them through digital marketing transformation across technology, business processes, organizational structures, and workforce capabilities.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on experience with organizational change. You’ll help customers navigate the complexities of onboarding and adopting new digital solutions—ensuring they unlock the full potential of their investments.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Change Leadership

  • Lead digital transformation engagements focused on change management, operating model refinement, and organizational design.

  • Partner with executive stakeholders to align digital strategy with business goals.

  • Facilitate discovery sessions and strategic workshops to uncover needs and co-create solutions.

  • Deliver compelling executive-level presentations, strategic roadmaps, and value frameworks.

Change Management Execution

  • Apply structured change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci) to drive adoption.

  • Create actionable deliverables for change levers: communication plans, sponsor roadmaps, training and coaching programs, and resistance management.

  • Assess change readiness, conduct impact analyses, and develop stakeholder engagement plans.

  • Support project teams in integrating change activities into delivery plans.

Organizational Enablement

  • Define and implement future-state operating models, team structures, and process frameworks.

  • Coach senior leaders and managers to act as effective change sponsors.

  • Support the development and delivery of training programs to drive user adoption.

Practice Development

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Digital Strategy & Performance practice.

  • Share knowledge, mentor team members, and support methodology development.

  • Collaborate closely with Adobe’s delivery and partner teams to ensure seamless execution.

title: Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The AI Technical Architect is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced artificial intelligence solutions that address critical business challenges. The role demands a deep understanding of AI technologies, architecture principles, and hands-on experience in building scalable AI systems. The ideal candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of AI-driven platforms, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI frameworks, tools, and technologies for various use cases.
  • Oversee the development, deployment, and integration of machine learning models and AI services.
  • Establish best practices for AI development, including data governance, model management, and MLOps processes.
  • Mentor and guide technical teams in the adoption and implementation of AI technologies.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and data science, and recommend relevant innovations.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, data privacy, and ethical AI standards.
  • Prepare technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and reports as required.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. A PhD is an added advantage.
  • 10+ years of experience in software architecture, with at least 3 years in AI/ML solution design and implementation.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages (Python, Java, R, etc.) relevant to AI development.
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or Scikit-learn.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly desirable.
  • Excellent understanding of data engineering, model deployment, and MLOps pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and distributed team environment.

Preferred Attributes

  • Relevant AI certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer).
  • Experience in developing AI solutions for Indian or international markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with deep learning architectures (CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers).
  • Familiarity with MLOps and CI/CD pipelines for model deployment and monitoring.
  • Understanding of ethical AI practices and data privacy regulations.
  • Published research papers or contributions to open-source AI projects.
  • LLM: Hugging Face OSS LLMs, GPT, Gemini, Claude, Mixtral, Llama
  • LLM Ops: ML Flow, Langchain, Langraph, LangFlow, Flowise, LLamaIndex, SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI
  • Databases/Datawarehouse: DynamoDB, Cosmos, MongoDB, RDS, MySQL, PostGreSQL, Aurora, Spanner, Google BigQuery. 
  • Cloud Knowledge: AWS/Azure/GCP
  • Dev Ops (Knowledge): Kubernetes, Docker, FluentD, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus
  • Cloud Certifications (Bonus): AWS Professional Solution Architect, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Proficient in Python, SQL, Javascript

title: Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.

You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.

The Opportunity

Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.

As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:

  • Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.

  • Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.

  • Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.

  • Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.

What You Will Do

Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy

  • Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.

  • Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.

  • See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.

  • Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.

Lead Enterprise Architecture Build

  • Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.

  • Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.

  • Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.

  • Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.

  • Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.

Drive Alignment and Transformation

  • Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.

  • Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.

  • Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.

  • Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.

Influence and Encourage

  • Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.

  • Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.

  • Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.

  • Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.

Contribute to Adobe's Growth

  • Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.

  • Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

  • Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.

What You Need to Succeed

Required Qualifications

  • Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.

  • Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.

  • Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.

  • Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.

  • Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.

  • Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across organizations.

  • Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.

  • Experience working with digital marketing, customer experience, customer data, or personalization platforms.

  • Knowledge of customer journey orchestration, decisioning, and real-time activation strategies.

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate.


The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion.


You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  • Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation.
  • Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion.
  • Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution.
  • Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show:


  • Software Development Acumen — You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architectures are grounded in implementation reality because you’ve built them yourself.
  • Customer Empathy — You connect with customers on their terms — understanding their pressures, constraints, and definitions of success. Trust is earned through empathy, not just expertise.
  • Collaborative Engagement — You engage cross-functionally with ease, aligning engineers, architects, product managers, and executive stakeholders around shared outcomes.
  • Communication — You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences — in workshops, written architecture reviews, and executive briefings.
  • Business Acumen — You translate business goals into solution design. You understand the use case before reaching for the technology, and your architectures reflect that order of operations.
  • Cross-Product Architecture — You design end-to-end solutions across multiple products and systems — not just individual components. Your architectures hold up under integration, scale, and production conditions.
  • Data Modeling — You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved. You can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipeline architecture.
  • Growth Mindset & AI Fluency — You actively build toward agentic capabilities and adopt AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver.
  • Bias Toward Action — You identify problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution. You don’t wait for permission to move.

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. Masters or bachelor’s in computer science or any relevant field. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years.


Your Domain

  • AEP / RTCDP / AJO — Adobe’s core platform: data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation.
  • Enterprise Architecture — Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes.
  • Security & Compliance — Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR.
  • Cloud Platforms — AWS, Azure: infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking.
  • Data Platforms — Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes.
  • Observability — Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target).
  • Background in similar platforms — CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government) and familiarity with their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration patterns.
  • Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification systems.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar).
  • Track record of driving architecture decisions or technical strategy at team or org level.

How You’ll Work — Pod-Based Execution

You operate within small, cross-functional Customer Pods — outcome-oriented teams embedded with specific strategic accounts.


Each Pod has:

  • Customer Representative — feedback and validation
  • Product Manager — prioritization and decision-making
  • Engineers / Builders — implementation and experimentation
  • Account Team + Enterprise Architects — enterprise alignment and strategy

The Forward Deployed Engineer acts as the technical execution backbone of the Pod: customer-facing, highly technical, hands-on, enterprise-aware, and focused on rapid end-to-end delivery.


Key principles: Run small, time-boxed experiments. Maintain tight customer feedback loops. Prototype before fully building. Document learnings and decisions. Use staged rollouts to reduce risk.


Why This Team

  • Work on complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact — your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks.
  • Operate inside autonomous, cross-functional Pods embedded with Adobe’s most strategic accounts.
  • Combine architecture, strategy, engineering, and customer engagement in a single role — no two weeks look the same.
  • Shape a new engineering engagement model centered around rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution.
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  • Build engineering credibility that earns expansion rights — from workshops to FDE to renewals.

This role is for engineers who want to understand not only how systems work — but why they matter to the customer.
