title: Senior AI Systems Engineer — C++ / Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior AI Systems Engineer with deep C++ expertise to help build the next generation of AI-enabled product and platform capabilities. 

This role sits at the intersection of large-scale systems engineering, applied AI, and production software architecture. You will design and build the native infrastructure, service integration layers, evaluation systems, and reliability mechanisms that allow AI-powered features to operate safely, predictably, and efficiently inside complex software products. 

This is not a research-only role and not a prompt-engineering role. This is a hands-on principal engineering role for someone who can move between architecture, production code, AI system design, technical strategy, and cross-team leadership. 

The ideal candidate is a strong C++ engineer first, with practical AI fluency: someone who understands how modern AI systems behave, where they fail, how to integrate them into production workflows, and how to design systems that make AI useful, reliable, observable, and secure. 

What You’ll Do 

AI-Native Systems Architecture 

  • Design and build native C++ infrastructure that connects complex product codebases to AI-powered services, agents, and model-backed workflows. 

  • Define clean execution interfaces, schemas, validation layers, and error-handling contracts for AI-driven actions. 

  • Create reliable bridges between product capabilities, AI orchestration systems, and backend services. 

  • Ensure AI-initiated actions behave safely, predictably, and consistently within existing product workflows. 

  • Guide long-term architecture decisions through ADRs, design documents, technical reviews, and cross-functional alignment. 

C++ Platform and Integration Engineering 

  • Build high-quality C++ components for performance-sensitive, cross-platform environments. 

  • Own critical client-side infrastructure such as service connectivity, session lifecycle, authentication, TLS, reconnection, concurrency, and async execution. 

  • Design APIs and abstractions that are maintainable, testable, and scalable across multiple product surfaces. 

  • Improve code health through modernization, refactoring, better testing, and stronger engineering patterns. 

  • Balance performance, memory safety, reliability, backward compatibility, and developer experience in a mature codebase. 

Applied AI Reliability and Evaluation 

  • Design systems that make AI features measurable, debuggable, and production-ready. 

  • Build evaluation frameworks for AI workflows, including automated task execution, output validation, regression testing, scoring, and human review loops. 

  • Define guardrails for AI-driven actions, including safety checks, capability boundaries, fallback paths, and failure handling. 

  • Create privacy-conscious tracing, observability, and diagnostics for model-backed systems. 

  • Partner with product, data science, security, legal, and AI governance teams to ensure AI capabilities meet quality, safety, and compliance expectations. 

Technical Leadership 

  • Set engineering direction in ambiguous and fast-moving technical areas. 

  • Influence architecture across native clients, backend AI services, orchestration layers, and product experience teams. 

  • Help teams adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and review. 

What You’ll Bring 

Required Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant depth in C++. 

  • Strong experience building or maintaining large, mature, performance-sensitive codebases. 

  • Expertise in modern C++ design, memory management, concurrency, API design, debugging, and systems-level performance. 

  • Experience building cross-platform software across Windows, macOS, Linux, or similar environments. 

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI, LLMs, agents, or model-backed systems into production or production-adjacent software. 

  • Practical understanding of AI system failure modes, including hallucination, tool-calling errors, incomplete context, multi-turn drift, nondeterminism, and unreliable outputs. 

  • Experience designing reliable interfaces between AI systems and deterministic software systems. 

  • Strong systems architecture skills, including tradeoff analysis, technical strategy, and architecture documentation. 

  • Experience with testing at scale, including unit tests, integration tests, CI validation, regression testing, and quality gates. 

  • Ability to lead through influence across engineering, product, design, platform, security, and data science teams. 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to both engineering and executive audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with frontier model APIs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar systems. 

  • Experience designing tool/function-calling interfaces, agentic workflows, or AI orchestration systems. 

  • Experience building AI evaluation frameworks, automated scoring systems, or human-in-the-loop quality review. 

  • Familiarity with JSON-RPC, gRPC, WebSockets, REST, or similar service protocols. 

  • Experience with observability and tracing for AI systems or distributed systems. 

  • Experience with privacy-aware telemetry, data retention, secure client/service communication, or enterprise compliance requirements. 

  • Familiarity with sandboxing, safety boundaries, permissions, or policy enforcement for AI-initiated actions. 

  • Experience modernizing legacy C++ systems or improving developer productivity in large engineering organizations. 

  • Background in creative tools, productivity applications, developer tools, enterprise software, or complex desktop applications. 

What Makes This Role Special 

  • You will help define how AI becomes a reliable part of complex production software systems. 

  • You will work at the intersection of C++ systems engineering, applied AI, platform architecture, and product-scale impact. 

  • You will shape infrastructure that enables AI-powered experiences across multiple teams and product surfaces. 

  • You will influence both technical strategy and day-to-day engineering execution. 

  • You will help raise the bar for how teams build, evaluate, secure, and operate AI systems in production. 

About the Team 

This team builds foundational AI systems and native infrastructure for product engineering teams. We partner across client engineering, backend AI services, platform teams, product, data science, security, privacy, and release engineering. 

We focus on durable architecture, production-quality implementation, measurable reliability, and practical AI adoption. Our goal is to make AI-powered software safer, faster, more capable, and easier for engineering teams to build and ship.

title: Senior Engineering Manager  | iOS Video Applications
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Our iOS mobile team is part of the Adobe Video organization, where we build video creation and editing experiences for storytellers across desktop, mobile, and web. We move fast, care deeply about craft—and we’re hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to help lead that work on iOS! 

We want someone who will help define both what we build and how we build it. That includes establishing modern engineering practices and embracing AI‑assisted development to improve quality and speed. We’re looking for a manager who empowers their team to ship great iOS experiences while encouraging use of AI tools to move fast. 

 

We think you’ll thrive here if you bring people leadership and technical fluency. You communicate clearly across disciplines. And you enjoy working through trade‑offs with engineers and product partners to deliver the best outcome for customers. 

What You’ll Do 

You’ll lead, grow, and support a talented team of senior iOS engineers. Together, we build creative, user‑facing features—from early product and interaction design through execution and production quality. You’ll set technical and quality standards for the iOS organization. That means ensuring architectural coherence, maintainability, and performance across the codebase. 

We also need someone who can coach engineers on effective use of AI‑assisted development tools and agentic workflows. You’ll help the team accelerate responsibly while maintaining rigorous standards for code quality, correctness, and security. 

You’ll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape product strategy. We want a collaborator who brings a clear technical and UX perspective—not just resourcing or delivery plans. You’ll guide the team in making thoughtful scope and priority decisions, balancing user impact, velocity, and long‑term technical health. 

We believe great products come from safe‑to‑experiment cultures. You’ll create that environment: validating assumptions early, learning from real user feedback, and treating each release as a chance to improve. You’ll develop talent through regular feedback, mentorship, and career growth conversations. And you’ll represent our iOS team in org‑level planning, advocating for investment, technical excellence, and a user‑centered approach! 

What We’re Looking For 

  •  

    10+ years of experience shipping Apple applications, with significant time delivering complex, production‑scale iOS products. 

  •  

    Experience managing and growing teams of senior engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. 

  •  

    Technical fluency in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and the iOS SDK. You can review, guide, and influence architectural decisions even when not coding daily. 

  •  

    Product instincts and UX sensibility—familiarity with Apple Human Interface Guidelines, a keen eye for interaction quality, and a feel for why details matter to users. 

  •  

    Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces. You help teams move from unclear problem statements to crisp execution plans. 

  •  

    Experience using AI‑assisted development tools at a team level—setting expectations, workflows, and guardrails for AI‑generated output. 

  •  

    A clear, compelling communicator who translates between technical, product, and design perspectives. 

  •  

    An understanding of mobile video editing workflows—or the curiosity and drive to develop that understanding quickly. 

Even Better If You Have 

A track record of influencing product direction, technical strategy, or design outcomes beyond your immediate team. Experience evolving engineering processes on growing teams (quality, reliability, release management). Experience building creative tools, video production software, or editing workflows. Hands‑on experience using video editing applications, with an appreciation for creative users’ needs. Familiarity with modern AI‑enabled developer tooling and practices. 

Why Adobe Video? 

We offer a small-team environment with big ownership — you'll work at the intersection of world-class creative software and AI-augmented engineering. We invest in our people with industry-leading benefits, including comprehensive health coverage, generous equity, flexible time off, and access to Adobe's full suite of creative tools. We believe diverse perspectives make our products better, and we're committed to building a team where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

title: Value Creation Director - Adobe Private Capital
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe is driving strategic growth with global Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), and Sovereign Wealth (SWF) companies through a new go to market – Adobe Private Capital (APC). We are investing in high-calibre, experienced individuals with a background in managing large scale transformation programs with large corporates, or experience working within a PE firm as an Operating Partner.

We are looking for individuals with a start-up mentality – enthusiasm and resilience backed up by a passion for quality of thinking and execution. As an APC Value Creation Director, you will have responsibility for coordinating efforts across all aspects of the Adobe Digital Experience and Digital Media lines of business, working with PE firms to drive value within Portfolio Companies across the globe.

What you’ll do

  • Work with analysts to define priority portfolio companies that can derive significant value from the use of Adobe’s integrated technology stack.

  • Lead relationships with Operating Partners in the PE, VC and SWF firms to drive discussion on value levers within the Portfolio Company – leading with industry insights collated from Adobe’s proprietary sources and external data.

  • Work with a small group of delivery partners to define a roadmap for execution and value realisation.

  • Define and build an effective joint governance model ensuring alignment and sponsorship across the account.

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with customer and Adobe executives to support priority initiatives and long-term account growth.

  • Drive the adoption of Adobe products and innovations within the portfolio through thoughtful development of business cases that map back to customer priorities.

  • Grow revenues across the business (software, services, and support).

  • Lead and mentor regional account teams to drive value for portfolio companies at a regional level.

  • Coordinate critical customer-facing activities including executive engagement, company visits, briefings, and ideation workshops.

  • Ideate with, and support Adobe marketing functions to drive engagement and events for the PE firms.

What you need to succeed

Successful engagement will be defined by short-term pipeline generation, medium term value creation for the PE firm through its portfolio, leading to long term retention and growth:

  • Deep experience in both the Software and Services business models with the confirmed ability to structure and negotiate large, multi-faceted agreements.

  • Natural leadership skills, including confidence employing senior executives and influencing strategies for leading teams in highly matrixed organizations, galvanising a sense of common purpose.

  • Proven success leading and delivering on enterprise engagements either internal or through a consultancy / PE, VC or SWF firm.

  • A background in enterprise transformation and change management with referenceable supporting examples.

  • Experience leading successful digital transformations for marketing organizations paired with knowledge of the technologies and tactics needed to effectively perform.

  • Deep knowledge of digital transformation trends in the industry and Adobe’s position relative to those trends.

  • Experience in developing and driving adherence to a multi-layered governance model supporting multiple business functions and IT with engagement across executives, management, steering committees, and PMO functions.

  • Practical knowledge in developing GTM plans between enterprise organizations.

  • Willingness to travel.

title: Principal Scientist - Adobe Brand Intelligence

Adobe Brand Intelligence forms the basis of Content Supply Chain, helping enterprises develop, control, and enhance on-brand content at scale . Through the integration of enterprise context, extensive brand knowledge, and AI agents, ABI develops smart workflows that assist global brands in providing flawless and personalized customer experiences across all platforms.

Impact You’ll Make

  • Define the long-term software architecture and technical vision for ABI.
  • Build the foundational platform delivering AI capabilities consistently across Adobe applications, web experiences, and enterprise ecosystems.
  • Drive architectural decisions for backend services, web applications, APIs, and platform infrastructure.
  • Partner with the ML team to operationalize AI models into scalable, secure, enterprise-ready software systems.
  • Direct engineering strategy across multiple teams while offering mentorship to senior engineers and technical leaders.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the comprehensive architecture for ABI, including backend services, frontend applications, SDKs, APIs, and integration systems.
  • Architect and build highly scalable distributed systems with high availability, low latency, and operational resilience.
  • Build scalable APIs and platform capabilities that enable seamless connection with Adobe Creative Cloud applications and other third-party platforms.
  • Lead the development of modern web applications and shared frontend frameworks for Adobe Brand Intelligence experiences.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into production through effective orchestration and enterprise-level APIs.
  • Drive platform architecture across authentication, authorization, governance, observability, deployment automation, and performance optimization.
  • Lead architecture reviews, define engineering standards, and promote contemporary software engineering methods.
  • Support senior engineers and technical leads while encouraging a culture of engineering excellence and innovation.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and UX teams to translate customer needs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Influence Adobe’s long-term platform strategy for intelligent enterprise content creation.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience building large-scale distributed software systems.
  • Proven background in developing extensive software systems supporting millions of users or sizable enterprise clients.
  • Significant experience in backend development using Java, Python, or comparable technologies, along with a solid grasp of distributed systems and cloud-native platforms.
  • Experience building modern web applications using frontend frameworks such as React, TypeScript, or similar technologies.
  • Proven experience building extensible APIs, SDKs, plug-in architectures, and integration frameworks.
  • Experience integrating software platforms into desktop applications, web applications, SaaS platforms, or enterprise ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge of software architecture patterns, platform engineering, scalability, resiliency, observability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Experience working closely with Machine Learning and Applied AI teams to incorporate AI features into enterprise software products.
  • Demonstrated skill in guiding technical direction across multiple engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills to explain complex architectural concepts to engineers, product leaders, and executives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing AI-native enterprise software platforms.
  • Experience with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, agentic systems, or intelligent workflow platforms.

title: Group Manager, Communications Strategy & Ops
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe's communications team helps define how the world understands Adobe by showcasing our products, innovation, and customer and industry impact for media, creators, partners, and the broader market.

We're looking for a Group Manager, Strategy & Operations to own the strategic and operational backbone of communications for Adobe's Creativity & Productivity (C&P) business. You'll build the systems, rhythms, and judgment that let the team scale, operate effectively, and move strategically across media relations, executive communications, product communications, thought leadership and day-to-day operations.

We want someone who thinks structurally, writes with precision, thrives in ambiguity, and sees operational excellence as a form of strategic leverage. You have an intuitive understanding on people and the judgment to know when to push, when to listen, and how to bring out the best in a team.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with the Senior Director to set strategic direction and turn it into clear operating plans.
  • Own the team's operating rhythm – planning, goal-setting, performance tracking, day-to-day priorities – and act as a trusted proxy in meetings and decisions.
  • Facilitate faster decision-making by prioritizing issues and clearing the way so the team can move fast and stay focused on external results.
  • Hold the team to a high standard of operational excellence including timely, accurate reporting, budget tracking, industry analysis, and media measurement.
  • Build AI-native systems that make the team more efficient, from briefing and review cycles to content tracking and operations.
  • Lead special projects and critical initiatives, often operating independently and without a playbook.
  • Manage a small team, setting clear expectations, mentoring for growth, holding the team accountable for quality, responsiveness, and ensuring cohesive direction.
  • Establish workback schedules, editorial standards, and preparedness protocols that bring consistency and reliability to high-stakes communications moments.
  • Serve as an editorial steward on strategic engagements, reviewing content, shaping materials and crafting positioning.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships and coordinate partners to guarantee quality and timely deliverables.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 8–10+ years of experience in communications, strategy, or operations, preferably at a tech company or in high-stakes comms.
  • Chief of Staff or senior communications strategist experience, having acted as a trusted proxy for an executive.
  • Exceptional writer comfortable moving between executive voice and internal narrative with strategic framing.
  • Structured problem solver who translates ambiguity into clear plans with owners, timelines, success criteria, and builds the systems that maintains sustainable plans.
  • Strong executive presence and the confidence to engage at the VP/C-suite level.
  • High EQ skilled at reading people, influencing without formal authority, and managing and mentoring teams.

title: Principal Product Manager, AI Brand Visibility
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Chat responses and AI Overviews don't just link anymore - they synthesize answers. When an answer is synthesized instead of clicked, everything about how a brand gets found online changes.
We're growing the team that owns Adobe Brand Visibility (formerly Adobe LLM Optimizer) - newly formed as Adobe combines its own solutions with Semrush Enterprise following the acquisition.
This is a small, builder-heavy team that ships fast, uses AI natively, and measures success in real customer outcomes. No talking to hypothetical personas: Adobe's customers are the world's top brands, and you'll be talking directly with the people running marketing at them, every day.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for an area of our Brand Visibility solution
  • Drive how the product ingests AI-answer-engine signals and connects into the CMS, analytics, and CDN platforms customers already run - AEM Sites and Adobe Analytics included
  • Talk to top-brand marketing leaders daily - then sketch the flow, prototype it yourself with AI tools, and validate before engineering picks it up
  • Define and own the important metrics that prove your area is moving the needle

What makes for a great fit

Go deep on the product instead of just coordinating around it. When a customer conversation surfaces something the roadmap missed - you ship it.

  • 3–8 years of PM experience (Senior or Principal scope, depending on background)
  • Deep SEO/GEO expertise — proficient in the AI-visibility tool landscape (Semrush AIO, BrightEdge, Conductor, Profound, or similar); hands-on Semrush experience is a strong plus
  • Plugged into the SEO community, following the research and benchmarks published; a plus if you've shared your own findings or experiments
  • Proficient in UX prototyping and user interviews, comfortable sketching flows and building a first version
  • Technical enough to partner credibly with engineering and data partners
  • Bonus: direct experience with AEM Sites, Adobe Analytics, or comparable enterprise CMS/analytics/CDN solutions, and social media monitoring or affiliate marketing solutions.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Creativity & Productivity
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the ads you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions, every single one of those experiences, was touched by an Adobe product. 

We have a fantastic opportunity for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our Creativity & Productivity business based in Paris (3 days a week office presence required + Remote work options across the year). 

Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity Unit focuses on advancing brand new content and driving digital transformation of industries. It provides tools and services that enable enterprises to create, publish, promote, manage and monetize their content anywhere through the Adobe Creative Cloud and Document Cloud. With the recent addition of Firefly Services (GenAI APIs),  Firefly Foundry (Privately trained models), and Acrobat Studio (Document Productivity & AI powered Creativity) Adobe is supporting the creation at scale with unprecedented agility and efficiency. 

Adobe’s creative and document solutions are used by designers, photographers, filmmakers, content publishers, storytellers, UX designers, knowledge workers, consumers and more. Through our connected apps and services, customers have all the tools and assets they need to create and manage content across desktop and mobile devices. 

What you'll Do  

  • Working with assigned accounts to achieve/exceed quarterly sales quota. 
  • Plan and prioritize sales activities which includes but not limited to; pro-active prospecting, targeted sales campaigns, qualifying marketing leads, social media selling, and face to face customer meetings towards achieving agreed business goals. 
  • Negotiate, liaise and communicate both internally and externally using appropriate methods to facilitate the sales process. 
  • Deliver online or face to face presentations and demonstrations and coordinate internal resources as needed.
  • Plan and manage your sales territory (20 accounts), business and customers relationships according to an agreed market development strategy in collaboration with the your V-Team (BDR, Sales Specialists, Inside Sales, Solution Consultants and Customer Success Managers). 
  • Use analytical and selling skills to understand the customer, their business, requirements and create a value proposition based on their needs.
  • Create and manage a sales pipeline of new business which consistently delivers above expectation results.
  • Maintain and develop existing and new customers through appropriate personalised value propositions, relevant internal engagements, and ethical sales methods to optimise quality of, customer engagement and experience therefore accelerating business growth. 

What you need to succeed  

  • Candidates should have a track record of successful enterprise business to business sales experience. 
  • Understanding of the end to end sales cycle management from prospecting to closing. 
  • Ability to connect across all organizational levels and identify decision makers. Build long-term customer relationships by earning trust and credibility. Focus on CxO level while presenting Adobe vision and strategy.  
  • Ability to build pipeline through individual prospecting, lead qualifying, and cross-selling/up-selling into our customer base as well as targeting potential new logos.
  • Seeking for excellence and proven interpersonal and collaboration skills are also required.
  • Animation of a virtual team and cross collaboration at One Adobe level. 
  • Highly motivated and professional with excellent communication skills, confident and goal-oriented. 
  • Must have high ethics, integrity, and humility with a desire to operate as part of a team. 
  • Ability to challenge the status quo to help drive innovation across the business with a critical thinking approach.  

As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog, https://blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com. 

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We hire dedicated individuals, regardless of gender, race or colour, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. This is what it means to be Adobe For All. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.

title: Principal Scientist - Data Pipeline Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal ML Engineer to drive down cost per asset and drive up throughput across the ML pipelines behind Adobe's multimodal foundation models (image, video, audio). You'll own the end-to-end economics of turning billions of raw assets into training-ready data, making it faster and cheaper without sacrificing data quality. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across modeling and infrastructure teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own cost per asset across the full pipeline, including compute (GPU and CPU), storage, data access and movement, and reprocessing, and identify the biggest levers to reduce it
  • Optimize pipeline DAGs to cut cost, such as running cheap filters first so expensive model stages only process the assets that matter and reduce waste from unnecessary duplications
  • Improve throughput of pipelines running specialized and general-purpose models (VLMs, LLMs, captioners, embedding and quality models) through batching, parallelism, quantization, and serving optimizations
  • Distill larger models into smaller, cheaper ones that preserve labeling and filtering quality
  • Decide where specialized models, general models, or cascades give the best cost/quality tradeoff
  • Build evaluation frameworks to ensure efficiency gains don't degrade training data quality
  • Develop a deep understanding of what makes data valuable for training LLMs, VLMs, and diffusion models, and encode it into filtering, scoring, and selection
  • Partner with modeling teams to connect pipeline changes to training outcomes
  • Work with data platform teams on orchestration (e.g., Ray), scheduling, and storage so ML workloads run cost-efficiently on shared infrastructure

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 10+ years in ML systems, ML infrastructure, or applied ML engineering, including work at billions-of-assets scale
  • Track record of cutting the cost of large-scale ML data pipelines across compute, storage, and data access (e.g., early filtering, deduplication, model cascades)
  • Deep expertise in optimizing inference for VLMs, LLMs, or other large models, including batching, quantization, serving, and distillation
  • Experience with data curation and data quality for training generative or multimodal models
  • Strong Python, plus a systems-level language (C++, Rust, Go, or Java), and experience with distributed frameworks such as Ray or Spark
  • Clear communication across modeling, infrastructure, and data teams
  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in CS, Engineering, ML, or a related field

title: Systems Design/Architecture Engineer 5
descriptionHtml:
• Job Description SummaryJob Description SummaryDesigns a complete and complex framework, system or product. Defines processes for technical platforms, system specifications, input/output and working parameters for hardware and/or software compatibility. Conceives system interfaces and business application prototypes. Identifies, analyzes and resolves system design weaknesses. Influences the shaping of future products by contributing to the framework (architecture) used across multiple products or systems. Provides multi-layered technical expertise for next generation initiatives.
  • Job DescriptionJob Description

    About the Role

    Join Adobe as a Systems Design/Architecture Engineer and play a pivotal role in building the future of our technology stack! This is an outstanding opportunity to work with world-class talent and technologies to develop exceptional products.

    What You'll Do

    • Develop robust technical artifacts such as automation tools, secure-by-default templates, and reference architectures that enable flawless and secure engineering processes.

    • Drive strategic decisions by aligning company strategy with analytical insights to meet ambitious growth goals.

    • Build comprehensive system architectures covering identity and access management, network segmentation, application security, and data protection.

    • Establish and enforce architectural standards across product teams.

    • Collaborate with business units to represent the architecture function.

    • Mentor junior engineers, encouraging a culture of excellence through design reviews, office hours, or structured mentoring programs.

    • Evaluate new technologies and determine their relevance to our stack, recommending strategic investments.

    • Conduct ongoing research to benchmark and incorporate industry guidelines, providing actionable insights.

    What You'll Bring

    • 15+ years in systems development, architecture engineering, or a related field, with at least 10 years in distributed computing environments.

    • Demonstrated proficiency in at least three core domains: identity and access management, applied cryptography, network security, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), application security, or secure SDLC.

    • Practical experience with threat modeling methods.

    • A track record of crafting impactful architecture decisions that others have successfully implemented.

    • Strong communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical collaborators.

    • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, or a related area.

    Nice to Have

    • Experience operating as a senior or staff-level engineer.

    • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or cloud security certifications.

    • Experience presenting security posture to enterprise customers or regulators.

    • Experience working within a matrixed organization.

    • A public history of contributions via presentations, publications, open-source projects, or patents.

    How We'll Know You're Succeeding

    • Within your first year, your architecture decisions will become the standard for other teams.

    • Your threat models will lead to actionable fixes that improve security.

    • Engineering leads will seek your input early in the build phase.

    • Your contributions will bring about clear progress in risk metrics, reflecting your influence within the organization.

title: Sr Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Adobe Firefly Services
descriptionHtml:
Adobe Firefly’s Generative AI Services team is seeking a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer for our GenAI Services area. In this high-impact role, you will work with a team of talented engineers in building scalable, high-performance generative AI systems—powering features across Adobe products like Firefly, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock, and Premiere. You will design and develop efficient inference pipelines, optimize models for latency and through at inference, and build APIs and ecosystems that integrate both Adobe’s first-party and third-party generative models into Adobe suite of products that serve individual and enterprise customers. You will tackle Adobe’s most complex engineering challenges at the forefront of the the industry, set technical direction, and mentor other ML engineers.Job Responsibilities

  • Design and Development of core GenAI services and APIs that integrate a wide range of generative models into Adobe’s flagship products.

  • Design and build ML workflows for enterprise-scale model customization, serving, and ecosystem integration.

  • Collaborate with Adobe Research and other model developer teams with a focus on model inference strategies and productization of those model

  • Build and optimize GPU-accelerated pipelines for both (customized) model training and inference—prioritizing performance, scalability, and reliability.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field—or equivalent industry experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in machine learning, including production-scale deployments.

  • 3+ years of experience leading large-scale, GPU-intensive GenAI systems (training, inference, and optimization).

  • Experience with GenAI frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, TensorRT, Nvidia Dynamo, and Python.

  • Good understanding of generative model architectures, including diffusion models, transformers, and GANs.

  • Good communication and leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment in matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with model serving, inference, orchestration, and GPU resource management in large-scale environments.

  • Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, distributed systems, and MLOps platforms.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Brand Concierge, Adobe's groundbreaking conversational AI platform. Brand Concierge lets businesses engage customers through an AI concierge that actually knows their brand. Brand Concierge is grounded in each business's content, data, and standards, so every answer builds trust instead of eroding it. 

Our mission is to help brands drive deeper engagement, strengthen customer loyalty, and increase conversion through AI-powered personalization. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help lead the Brand Concierge's Runtime product— owning how our AI agents understand, represent, and scale brand voice across every customer conversation. You should be passionate about how AI is reshaping the way businesses represent their brand. 

What You'll Own 

  • Lead product vision, strategy, and execution for Brand Concierge Runtime, the Runtime layer of Adobe Brand Concierge.

  • Own the full product lifecycle from discovery through launch, balancing technical feasibility, design excellence, and business impact.

  • Bring a strong point of view on where the industry is heading and set the direction for the Brand Concierge product accordingly.

  • Engage directly with customers and partners to gather feedback and insights that help shape and refine the product vision.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Product Leadership to execute on the product vision and drive prioritization decisions.

  • Conduct market and competitive analysis to inform product positioning and identify areas for differentiation and growth.

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years of product management experience building Enterprise grade products, ideally within conversational AI, digital experience, or customer engagement domains.

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and present recommendations across engineering, sales, design, go-to-market, and senior leadership.

  • Proven ability to identify transformative product opportunities and own large product areas, setting long-term strategy and driving execution across multiple teams and organizations.

  • Deep familiarity with platform fundamentals such as MCPs, LLMs, APIs, authentication, extensibility, and enterprise requirements around reliability, scalability, and governance.

Job Description

Digital Experience (DX) ( https://www.adobe.com/experience-cloud.html) is a USD 4B+ business serving the needs of enterprise businesses including 95%+ of fortune 500 organizations.

title: Director, Channel Planning
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

This role provides a rare chance to develop a new function as Adobe moves advertising operations in-house, replacing outside agencies with an AI-based engine. It requires working at the crossroads of strategy, data, and hands-on work, with real sway over global advertising for a Fortune 500 company.

Team Mission

Lead and develop the team that converts marketing strategy into media plans for Adobe's Global audience segments (Business Professionals, Creative Professionals, and Creators). Adobe is internalizing paid media execution and establishing a new "Channel Planning" function to connect strategy with practical execution.

What you'll Do

Key Initiatives

  • Build and manage a group of Channel Planners located in key regions (America, EMEA, APAC, Japan). These individuals bridge marketing strategy and the buying desk, guaranteeing global consistency in media planning while adapting to local nuance.
  • Own the "Adobe on Adobe" story, ensuring all regions are bringing to bear Adobe adtech, where it makes sense (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP, etc)
  • Take responsibility for the framework guiding this new team’s interaction with regional marketing leaders. Establish clear ways to handle critical issues, decision rights, and expectations. Schedule formal reviews every 3–6 months to ensure the approach is effective.
  • Collaborate with Adobe's media-buying team in India
  • Drive smarter audience targeting and data-sharing across regions and campaigns, and manage partnerships with ad platforms (to unlock better rates, credits, and support)
  • In partnership with Ops, set standards for how campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked before they become available

Scope & Direct Reports

  • Director-level leader directly managing a global team of (6) Channel Planners
  • Americas-based, with monthly international trave to stay connected with in-market regional Channel Planners and local Media Strategy teams
  • Peers include the heads of regional marketing strategy groups and the leader of the India-based buying team
  • Works closely with (but doesn't directly manage) the buy desk, analytics, strategy, and engineering partners
  • Define how Adobe plans and accomplishes advertising campaigns for years to come, starting with paid social and growing from there
  • Balance consistent global standards with the reality that every region has different pricing, language, and regulatory needs

First 90-Day Deliverables:

  • Hire and build out the core team
  • Arrange routine meetings with regional marketing leaders, the new planning team, and the India-based buying team
  • Audit how campaigns currently get planned, tagged, and quality-checked
  • Stand up the playbook and process for how the planning team hands work to the buying team when there is a blocking issue

What you need to succeed

  • 10+ years in digital advertising/media, with 5+ years leading media buying or campaign execution teams
  • Proven track record building new teams or functions from scratch
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of digital ad platforms and the technology used to target audiences and measure campaigns
  • Experience standardizing how a media team operates across multiple regions or markets
  • Excellent skill at influencing collaborators and managing change — this role will need agreement from multiple regional leaders
  • Self-starter, comfortable both setting direction and rolling up their sleeves

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience working with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools specifically
  • Experience managing overseas or offshore execution teams
  • Experience across both business (B2B) and consumer advertising
  • Background connecting the planning side of advertising to the execution/buying side

title: Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
職務内容

Enterprise Architect（EA）は、Adobeの日本国内エンタープライズ顧客に対し、Digital Experience領域における高品質なソリューションデリバリーを牽引する、戦略的テクノロジーガイドです。AdobeはGenerative AI・Agentic AIを核とした新しいデジタル体験のあり方を追求しており、EAはその技術的先鋒として、AI活用による顧客ビジネスの変革を主導する役割を担います。

お客様のビジネスゴールとAdobeソリューションを、スケーラブルで統合的なアーキテクチャによって整合させます。プロジェクト単位のCustom Serviceと、サブスクリプション型のIntegrated Servicesの双方にまたがる、数少ない横断的な戦略ロールです。

EAは以下の3つのフェーズでお客様に伴走します。

  • Plan and align：アーキテクチャDiscoveryの実施、将来アーキテクチャの定義、ITストラテジーとの整合

  • Design and guide：統合・データフローの提言、クロスソリューションのアーキテクチャガイダンス、技術設計のレビューと検証

  • Enable and Optimize：価値の検証、ROIの実証、成功事例の発掘

主な業務内容

  • Adobe CX Enterprise（旧Adobe Experience Cloud）を横断する、サードパーティ連携を含むエンドツーエンドのアーキテクチャ設計

  • 複雑なビジネス要件を技術ソリューションへ変換し、デリバリーチームの活動をお客様のビジネス目標に整合させる

  • プロジェクトスコープ・見積り・リソース配分・進行計画の立案

  • ビジネス部門、IT部門、パートナー、経営層など関係者を巻き込んだロードマップ策定

  • グローバルデリバリーチーム、パートナーエコシステムと連携したプロジェクト推進と、技術成果物の品質レビュー

  • Agentic AIを含むAEM / Adobe CX Enterpriseの先進機能を調査し、新しいサービスモデルの開発に貢献

  • Generative AI／Agentic AIをお客様のビジネスにどう活用できるか、具体的なユースケースとアーキテクチャの観点から提言

このポジションで得られる機会

  • 日本を代表するエンタープライズ企業のデジタル変革を、技術面の中核として牽引できる

  • AdobeのProduct/Engineering組織と直接連携できる

  • Firefly、GenStudio、Agentic AIなど、Adobeが投資する最先端AIソリューション群を活用した新規サービスの立ち上げに携われる

  • Custom ServiceとIntegrated Servicesを横断する希少なロールとして、コンサルティング産業の変化の最前線に立てる

必須スキル・経験

  • 以下のいずれかに関連する6年以上の経験:
     (a) Enterprise Architectまたはコンサルタントとして、大規模エンタープライズ向けWebアプリケーション
    (b) デジタルマーケティング領域におけるプロダクトマネジメント経験

  • CMSやWebアプリケーションに関する基礎知識

  • CDNを含む、高パフォーマンスなWebシステムアーキテクチャの設計・立案経験

  • 複雑なビジネス要件を技術ソリューションに変換し、デリバリーチームの活動を整合させた経験

  • プロジェクトスコープ定義、見積り、リソース配分の実務経験

  • Generative AI／Agentic AIをはじめとする技術トレンドを常にキャッチアップし、お客様のビジネスへの具体的な応用を提案できる力

  • 相手（技術者・マーケティング部門・経営層）に応じてコミュニケーションを調整できる能力

  • ビジネスレベルの日本語力（必須）。英語はビジネス文書の読み書きができる程度で可

歓迎するスキル

  • Adobe CX Enterprise製品の実務経験

  • アナリティクス導入のデリバリー 経験

  • React、TypeScriptなど、モダンなWebフロントエンドスタックに関する知識

  • 広告テック、マーケティングオートメーション、オムニチャネルパーソナライゼーション、CRMなど、デジタルマーケティングジャーニー全体の知見

  • Generative AI／Agentic AIソリューションの業務活用経験、またはAIエージェント構築経験

  • グローバルチームと直接折衝できるレベルの英語力

  • 複数リージョンにまたがるクロスファンクショナルなチームをリードした経験

求める人物像

  • 顧客のビジネス課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによる解決策を描ける方

  • 技術部門と経営層の橋渡し役として、双方から信頼される関係を築ける方

  • AIをはじめとする変化の激しい技術トレンドを常にキャッチアップし、実務への応用を探求できる方

  • 複数の関係者を巻き込みながら、責任を持ってプロジェクトを推進できるリーダーシップをお持ちの方

  • 既存の枠にとらわれず、新しいサービスモデルの構築に主体的に関わりたい方

  • オンショア／オフショア混成のグローバルチームとの協働に抵抗がない方

Job Description

The Enterprise Architect (EA) operates as the principal strategic technology guide and technical force behind delivering high-quality Digital Experience solutions to Adobe's enterprise customers in Japan. Adobe is pursuing a new generation of digital experiences built around Generative AI and Agentic AI, and the EA serves as the technical vanguard driving customer business transformation through these capabilities.

The EA ensures customer business goals match Adobe solutions through scalable, integrated architectures that generate sustained value. This cross-functional strategic position operates within both Custom Service, which is project-focused consulting, and Integrated Services, Adobe's subscription advisory service. Few roles span these two engagement approaches.

The EA partners with customers across three phases:

  • Plan and align: Conduct architecture discovery sessions, define future-state solution architecture, and align Adobe solutions with IT strategy

  • Design and guide: Recommend integration and data flows, provide cross-solution architecture guidance, review and validate technical designs, and advise on governance and scalability

  • Enable and Optimize: Verify and validate value, measure path to value and return on investment, and find opportunities to showcase success

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop complete architectures throughout the Adobe CX Enterprise (formerly Adobe Experience Cloud) portfolio, incorporating connections with third-party solutions

  • Translate intricate business needs into technical solutions, ensuring all delivery team actions correspond with documented customer business goals

  • Develop project scope definitions, delivery estimates, resource allocation plans, and project timelines

  • Develop roadmaps in collaboration with business collaborators, IT teams, partners, and executive leadership

  • Propel project advancement in partnership with global delivery teams and the partner network, and review technical deliverables to ensure quality

  • Investigate advanced features of AEM and Adobe CX Enterprise, including Agentic AI, to aid the development of new service models

  • Advise customers on concrete use cases and architectural approaches for applying Generative AI and Agentic AI to their business

Opportunities Offered

  • Lead the technical architecture behind digital transformation for leading Japanese enterprise customers

  • Work directly with Adobe's Product and Engineering teams

  • Contribute to the creation of new services powered by Adobe's leading-edge AI portfolio, including Firefly, GenStudio, and Agentic AI

  • Take on a distinctive role that combines both Custom Service and Integrated Services—situating you at the forefront of changes in the consulting field

Required Skills and Experience

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in either following:
    (a) Enterprise Architect or Consultant, delivering enterprise-scale web applications
    (b) Digital Marketing Product Management

  • Foundational knowledge of CMS and web application technologies

  • Experience designing and planning high-performance web system architectures, including CDN

  • Proven capability to transform intricate business needs into technical solutions and coordinate delivery team efforts accordingly

  • Experience developing project scope definitions, delivery estimates, and resource allocation plans

  • Ongoing familiarity with technology trends such as Generative AI and Agentic AI, with the ability to propose concrete applications for customer business

  • Skilled in written and verbal communication, capable of adapting for technical, marketing, or executive audiences

  • Business-level Japanese (required). Working proficiency in reading and writing English is sufficient

Skills That Set You Apart

  • Hands-on experience with Adobe CX Enterprise solutions

  • Experience in analytics implementation

  • Knowledge of modern web frontend stacks such as React and TypeScript

  • Working knowledge of the end-to-end digital marketing journey, including Ad Tech (CDP/DMP, DSP), marketing automation, omni-channel personalization, and CRM

  • Experience employing Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions to optimize daily workflows, or hands-on experience building AI agents

  • English proficiency adequate to negotiate and work directly with international teams

  • Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams

Candidate Profile

We encourage candidates who demonstrate the following qualities:

  • Deep understanding of customer business challenges, with the ability to translate them into solutions powered by modern tools

  • Strong communication skills that build trust as a bridge between technical teams and executive collaborators

  • A genuine interest in fast-moving technology trends, including AI, and a drive to explore practical applications

  • Leadership that can engage multiple collaborators while taking ownership of a project through to completion

  • A readiness to think beyond current frameworks to contribute to the creation of new service models

  • Comfort collaborating with mixed onshore/offshore global teams

title: AI Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Bridgeway is Adobe's agentic marketing partner for small businesses and solopreneurs — photographers, estheticians, fitness coaches, bakers, contractors — the people running a business with no marketing team behind them. We're building software that acts like a great marketing hire, not another tool to learn.

We're looking for a design engineer who lives at the intersection of design and code. Bridgeway runs like a startup — a small, talent-dense team bringing startup speed inside Adobe, with Adobe's platform and reach behind it. If you want early-stage pace and ownership plus enterprise-scale resources, this is that combination.

Work directly with product and engineering to prototype, build, and ship the experiences that make Bridgeway feel like a partner. Our engineers already build with AI-native workflows, and we want design at that same clock speed — motivated by generating options, not just refining one, so “which direction” becomes today's conversation instead of next week's.

What great looks like

We look for builders who have shipped — people who've launched something real and are proud of the outcome — more than a specific title or pedigree.

Everyone here operates across three lenses: product, design, and engineering. That means real design sense, production-quality code, and product-manager-level reasoning, without outsourcing any of it. What sets people apart isn't which of the three they can do — it's which one they lead with.

Taste and judgment sharp enough to orchestrate AI-assisted prototyping at high speed while holding a bar most teams miss even working slowly.

Taste

Identify what good looks like before it exists — faced with dozens of AI-generated directions, can immediately spot the two worth refining.

Judgment

Know what to build, not just how. Understand our user — a solo business owner with 90 seconds to spare — well enough to make the call without a committee.

Speed of orchestration

Operate AI tools like instruments — fast prototyping loops, rapid evaluation, continuous refinement — getting through in days what would take a team weeks, without cutting corners.

Ownership breadth

Own a design surface end to end: concept, prototype, production code, and the system it plugs into.

The Challenge

  • Turn a single problem into several distinct, high-fidelity prototypes so the team chooses between real options, not one idea presented one way

  • Build production-quality UI components and interactions in code, so what we're evaluating is close to what we'd ship
  • Ground decisions in first-principles thinking about our users — solo business owners with 90 seconds to spare
  • Champion simplicity: cut, collapse, and clarify so the product feels effortless for non-designers and non-technologists
  • Bridge design and engineering — translating concepts into real code, and feasibility into the design process from the start
  • Evolve Bridgeway's design system so the team ships faster and quality compounds instead of resetting each screen
  • Two things matter most in this role: 1. Systems - Can you build a design system and prototyping workflow that compounds — so every new prototype starts stronger than the last?  2. Review - Can you judge quality at an unreasonably high bar — spotting the two options worth building out of a wall of AI-generated ones, and saying why?

What is needed to succeed

  • Comfortable in Figma and a code editor — and increasingly reach for the code editor first
  • Strong front-end skills (React, TypeScript, CSS, animation)
  • Strong sense of build — an understanding of craft, hierarchy, restraint — and can explain why something works
  • Naturally explore multiple directions before converging, and you'd rather show than describe
  • Prototype in hours, not days, using AI tools without cutting corners on quality
  • A bias toward simplicity and love designing for real people — SMB owners, not power users
  • Think in systems and build reusable components, not one-off screens
  • Genuinely excited about AI agents and new interaction paradigms, not just AI as a buzzword

title: AI Engineer 4
descriptionHtml:
We build the agentic AI platform that Adobe teams use to get real work done — OneAI, our unified intelligence layer, along with the reusable skills, agents, and dashboards that run on top of it. You'll design and ship autonomous agents that connect to enterprise data (Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Slack, SharePoint) and turn natural-language questions into trustworthy, cited answers.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to grow. You'll own components end to end — from prototype to production — and see them adopted across business units. If you enjoy making AI systems that are genuinely reliable, well-governed, and fast, you'll fit in well here.

What you'll do

  • Build and productionize reusable agentic components — skills, orchestration workflows, and tool-calling integrations — that plug into OneAI's intelligence layer (Neo4j + pgvector + Databricks + Claude).
  • Take AI models and agents from prototype to production, and keep them healthy once they're live.
  • Improve how agents reason: prompt design, memory and context management, retrieval quality, and multi-step tool use.
  • Tune for latency, reliability, and cost so the platform holds up as more teams rely on it.
  • Partner with product managers and data engineers to shape what we build, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Help raise the bar on evaluation — measure solve rates and accuracy, and use what you find to make the agents better.

What you'll bring

  • Around 3+ years building AI/ML or backend systems, including some experience running LLM-powered services in production.
  • Strong fundamentals in Python and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling — frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and vector databases.
  • A habit of measuring quality and iterating, rather than shipping and hoping.
  • Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

Nice to have

  • Experience with event streaming (Kafka, Flink, or Kinesis) and data pipelines (Spark or Databricks).
  • Exposure to production operations — CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
  • Interest in AI governance, safety, or evaluation.

title: Director, M&A Finance
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

  • The Director of M&A Finance is a forward-thinking professional, responsible for helping to drive the strategy, timing and orchestration of integration motions at Adobe as part of the Chief Accounting Officer (“CAO”) organization.
  • The ideal candidate will engage with partners, stakeholders, and leadership to effectively plan and lead M&A Integrations through an efficient and repeatable application of standardized frameworks, with the goal of maximizing business value.
  • They will ensure successful M&A Integrations by partnering with cross functional teams, including Finance stakeholders, Corporate Development, GTM, IT and others, to drive alignment on priorities, budget, deal close and systems integration timelines.

What you'll Do:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end execution of new M&A transactions, from pre-close integration planning to post-merger integration execution for all Finance workstreams (e.g., R2R, P2P, Q2C)
  • Lead cross-functional teams (internal and external) to deliver on M&A integration activities, ensuring accountability, clarity, and the removal of roadblocks to achieve successful outcomes
  • Work hand in hand with Senior Leaders, business and functional leaders to ensure alignment across the operating model, integration approach and organizational structure for each deal to drive execution and efficiencies.
  • Develop and maintain integration-related key performance indicators to measure the efficiency of transaction-value drivers.
  • Drive integration plans, coordinate cross-functional teams, run regular integration meetings and drive proactive issue resolution.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvements throughout the deal lifecycle and implement best-in-class practices.
  • Help ensure repeatable process strategy and finance integration toolset (e.g., playbooks, process flows, work plans) incorporating prior experience and industry-leading practices across all key workstreams are set up and maintained up to date.
  • Build trusted and strong working relationships with all stakeholders.

What you need to succeed

  • Experienced Professional with a bachelor’s degree, minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, demonstrated success in Global M&A and large-scale integrations, proven ability to lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams
  • Strong Finance acumen across Finance workstreams (e.g. Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Global Source to Pay, Pricing & Revenue Operations, Payroll and Equity)
  • Strong familiarity with enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, HRIS)
  • Ability to create structure in ambiguity, synthesize complex inputs, and turn broad strategic goals into executable plans and executive-level content. 
  • Hands-on leadership style with strong ownership of planning, dependency management, escalation, communication, and outcome tracking. 
  • Strong background in GTM, product integration, and Lead to Quote
  • Highly self-directed with a strong consultative approach to problem-solving and the ability to deliver results
  • Strong business acumen, a hands-on approach, and confident communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and executive experience, enabling clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment, while proactively addressing and resolving challenges arising from uncertainty

title: Sr. Director, Engineering - Digital Video & Audio (DVA)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe's Digital Video & Audio (DVA) business powers the world's leading creative tools for professional video editing, motion graphics, visual effects, and content creation. Premiere Pro and After Effects are industry-defining applications used by filmmakers, broadcasters, social creators, enterprises, and creative professionals worldwide!

The future of creative storytelling will be hybrid, bringing together traditional craft and AI-powered creation in ways that expand what's possible. Whether an artist starts with an ARRI camera, a script, or a prompt, Adobe is building the world's leading creative platform to support every stage of the journey. From intelligent editing and generative video to cloud-native workflows and connected creative experiences, Digital Video & Audio is helping creators imagine, craft, and deliver compelling stories wherever inspiration begins. 

As Senior Director of Engineering, you will lead engineering strategy and execution across Premiere Pro, After Effects, and the platform, helping shape the future of professional video creation. You will partner closely across Product, Design, Research, and Platform Engineering to accelerate innovation, modernize core technologies, and deliver intelligent experiences that delight millions of creators around the world. 

This is a highly visible leadership role supporting one of Adobe's most strategic product portfolios. Success requires building high-performing teams, influencing across a complex matrixed organization, and driving technical and organizational excellence at scale.   

You will partner closely with leaders across Product Management, Design, Applied Research, Firefly AI, Creative Cloud, and Engineering to define and deliver the future of Adobe's video, motion graphics, and creative technology platform. 

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with strong technical judgment, operational rigor, and a track record of delivering creative products through major technology shifts. The ideal candidate has modernized mature architectures, scaled organizations, and integrated AI into customer experiences at global scale. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Define and drive the engineering strategy for DVA across. Lead the next generation of AI-native and agent-based creative experiences. 

  • Integrate generative AI, intelligent agents, and multimodal workflows into creator experiences in partnership with Adobe AI Research and Firefly teams. 

  • Lead engineering execution and advance extensibility frameworks, developer experiences, and AI-powered workflows while delivering seamless experiences across devices and creative surfaces. 

  • Drive the technology strategy for Adobe's Digital Video & Audio portfolio, accelerating AI-powered experiences across Premiere Pro, After Effects, and the platform. Modernize core video and rendering technologies, cloud services, collaboration capabilities, extensibility frameworks, and shared platform infrastructure while balancing architectural transformation with continuous product delivery. 

  • Build and develop a high performing global engineering organization responsible for performance, scalability, reliability, and operational rigor. Foster accountability, technical excellence, innovation, and strong execution while partnering across Adobe to align strategy, priorities, and platform direction. 

  • Represent Adobe externally through executive engagement, technical leadership, and a clear vision for shaping the next era of creativity. 

What You'll Need to Succeed 

  • Demonstrated ownership of business outcomes that delivered double-digit growth. Experience expanding product value and adoption among new and emerging creators, with a strong focus on activation, retention, and business impact. 

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping products with a worldwide reach. Experience leading large distributed engineering organizations responsible for complex, business-critical platforms including large-scale desktop applications and cross-platform experiences used by millions of creators. 

  • Proven experience integrating AI and machine learning technologies to enhance customer experiences, including generative AI, large language models, agent-based workflows, orchestration frameworks, inference systems, and multimodal experiences. 

  • Demonstrated success in modernizing platforms and leading large-scale AI adoption initiatives across mature engineering organizations and codebases. Experience improving engineering productivity through AI-assisted development and modern delivery practices. 

  • Strong technical depth across native applications, cloud-connected platforms, distributed systems, web, mobile, AI infrastructure, and developer ecosystems. 

  • Deep understanding of scalability, reliability, performance optimization, platform architecture, and operational excellence. Experience supporting globally distributed products and services used at large scale. 

  • Passion for creativity tools and a strong understanding of creator workflows, imaging technologies, graphics systems, extensibility, security, compliance, and enterprise requirements. 

  • Proven ability to build and develop leadership teams across directors, managers, architects, and engineers. Experience driving alignment across executive collaborators and partnering with organizations such as Premiere, Illustrator, and Firefly to deliver connected creative workflows.

title: Director of Engineering – Machine Learning & AI Products
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to guide the development of AI-native, production-ready machine learning products for external clients. This leader will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of sophisticated AI systems—from product conception and rollout to production, customer engagement, and continuous operational success.

This role requires a rare blend of hands‑on technical depth, product judgment, and senior‑level people leadership. You will lead a highly experienced ML engineering organization and work closely with Product, Development, and Go‑to‑Market partners to bring differentiated AI solutions to market.
 

Key Responsibilities
 

Technical & Product Leadership

  • Own the end‑to‑end delivery of AI/ML solutions deployed in production, moving beyond proofs‑of‑concept to scalable, reliable, customer‑facing systems.

  • Lead deep technical discussions on system build, model integration, performance, reliability, and operational readiness.

  • Collaborate directly with Product Management to build product vision, challenge assumptions, and ensure differentiation beyond general‑purpose LLM capabilities.

  • Drive architectural decisions that balance innovation, scalability, cost, and long‑term maintainability.

  • Act as a senior technical voice with customers, handling partner concerns, roadmap discussions, and production issue resolution.
     

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Establish, grow, and manage a high-caliber ML engineering organization, scaling the team from about 4 to over 20 engineers as time progresses.

  • Manage and mentor senior engineers and leaders with 16+ years of experience, encouraging accountability, ownership, and continuous growth.

  • Establish a flat, hands‑on, hybrid operating model where leaders stay close to the work while empowering teams to implement initiatives independently.

  • Conduct performance management, career development, and succession planning aligned to director‑level expectations.
     

Execution & Operations

  • Ensure excellence in production operations, including monitoring, incident response, model performance, and customer‑reported issues.

  • Drive strong engineering rigor across testing, release readiness, and post‑launch support.

  • Build scalable processes that support rapid iteration while maintaining enterprise‑grade reliability.
     

Required Qualifications

  • Over 15 years of experience in software engineering, with extensive expertise in machine learning or systems driven by artificial intelligence.

  • Demonstrated history of delivering and managing AI/ML products in production, beyond just experimentation or research.

  • Strong business and commercial exposure, with direct ownership or leadership of a customer-facing, revenue-impacting AI/ML product.

  • Strong experience with ML system build, production architecture, and real‑world operational challenges.

  • Demonstrated success leading senior technical teams, including performance evaluations, mentoring, and org scaling.

  • Ability to engage deeply with product partners and debate technical and product tradeoffs in fast paced environments.

  • Experience working directly with external customers and understanding customer‑facing production realities.
     

Preferred Background

  • Proven track record of building AI/ML products in startup or startup-like contexts that prioritize rapid market introduction.

  • Background in external, customer‑facing platforms or products, particularly AI‑first offerings.

  • Familiarity with domains such as marketing technology, sales technology, or customer experience platforms.
     

Leadership Attributes We Value

  • Hands‑on, credible technical leadership with the ability to go deep when needed.

  • Strong product intuition paired with engineering rigor.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building structure for scale.

  • Ability to earn trust quickly with senior engineers, product leaders, and customers.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Firefly
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity 

Adobe Firefly is Adobe’s AI-first creative studio, and this role sits at the center of it. As a Principal Product Marketing Manager for Firefly for creative professionals, you'll define what Firefly means for professional designers, video editors, photographers, and other professional creatives: how it fits into the tools they already use, what value it unlocks, and how we tell that story in ways that drive real adoption. You'll build and lead a small team of PMMs and own strategy and execution in equal measure, working across product, marketing, and go-to-market teams to connect Firefly's capabilities to the moments that matter most for creative pros. 
 

What you'll do 

  • Own positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Firefly with creative professional segments — translating complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling customer value 

  • Partner with inbound PMM teams to translate customer insights and use cases into outbound Firefly marketing strategy for Creative Cloud desktop app users, including integration with existing workflows and AI-native evolution of Creative Cloud desktop apps 

  • Own marketing strategy for Firefly for creative professionals — from awareness and discovery through usage and retention — in close partnership with channel owners and cross-functional marketing teams 

  • Own and orchestrate unified launch plans; write creative briefs and maintain a critical eye on channel execution across social, Adobe.com, email, and paid 

  • Develop and own post-launch optimization strategies informed by usage data — identifying where customers are in their Firefly journey and what interventions accelerate adoption 

  • Contribute to the PMM perspective on Firefly's business performance, connecting marketing strategy to adoption and engagement outcomes 

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure messaging is coherent end to end, across broad product surface area and strategic partnerships 

  • Enable GTM and marketing teams to understand, articulate, and amplify Firefly's value 

  • Influence the roadmap using customer insight and market analysis — champion the customer's needs within the product process  

What you'll need to succeed 

  • 8+ years of experience in product marketing, marketing, or a related field driving strategy and execution for innovative products  

  • Passion for new technologies, creative products, and the creative industry, with deep knowledge of the GenAI landscape  

  • End-to-end PMM skills: positioning, messaging, launch, and post-launch optimization 

  • Proven ability to develop compelling, evergreen product positioning that translates technical capability into customer value and drives engagement and adoption 

  • Experience launching AI or technically complex products, with an ability to differentiate in a fast-evolving competitive space 

  • Strong product instincts — you engage meaningfully with roadmaps and advocate for the customer throughout the product lifecycle  

  • Ability to toggle between high-level strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment 

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and rapidly evolving environments, with a bias for action and problem solving 

  • Data-driven and insight-led, with genuine customer curiosity — you dig into research and talk directly with users 

  • Strong POV — you bring a clear perspective, push back when it matters, and operate effectively within a large and complex organization 

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with executive presence and the ability to craft narratives that resonate across audiences 

  • Ability to mentor and help develop more junior team members

title: Senior Renewals Sales Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe’s Enterprise Renewals team is on the lookout for a driven, strategic, and customer-obsessed Senior Renewals Sales Specialist to help shape the future of our Enterprise relationships. This is more than a sales role, it’s a chance to influence Adobe’s long-term customer success and revenue growth.

You’ll be responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value accounts, driving renewals with a target of +30% growth, expanding product adoption, and collaborating with product specialists to generate new pipeline. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about delivering value to customers, we want to hear from you.

Marketo, an Adobe Company, provides easy-to-use, powerful and complete marketing software that propels fast-growing small companies and global enterprises, turning marketing from a cost center into a revenue driver.
