title: Senior Manager, Risk Advisory & Assurance Services (JAPAC)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity

Adobe's Risk Advisory & Assurance Services (RAAS) team is looking for a Senior Manager to lead audit and advisory engagements that strengthen oversight, risk management, and internal controls across the company.

This role combines strategic leadership, business partnership, and technical expertise to help Adobe anticipate emerging risks, improve business performance, and enable informed decision making. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Internal Audit, you will partner with leaders across the business to deliver objective insights, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the continued evolution of the RAAS function.

How You'll Make an Impact

Strategic Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by providing objective risk insights that support strategic decisions and business outcomes.
  • Build strong partnerships across the organization to understand evolving business priorities, emerging risks, and opportunities to bring value.
  • Partner with RAAS leadership to deliver against a risk-based audit and advisory portfolio aligned with Adobe's strategic priorities and evolving risk landscape.
  • Expand RAAS's advisory impact by finding opportunities to help the business navigate risk, change, and growth.
  • Contribute to the evolution of RAAS by improving methodologies, collaboration, and business impact.

Audit & Advisory Leadership

  • Deliver complex global audit and advisory projects that enhance governance, improve controls, and provide leaders with actionable insights to make informed business decisions.
  • Focus teams on the risks that matter most by defining clear engagement strategies using a top-down, risk-based approach.
  • Influence business outcomes by delivering practical recommendations that improve performance, strengthen resilience, and enhance governance.
  • Communicate enterprise risk themes through concise, executive-ready presentations that build alignment and inspire action.
  • Partner with business teams to monitor remediation efforts and drive sustainable risk reduction.

People Leadership

  • Build high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Foster an inclusive culture where collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning thrive.
  • Empower teams to succeed by setting clear priorities, removing obstacles, and encouraging sound judgment and ownership.
  • Coach audit professionals, develop future leaders, and strengthen organizational capability through knowledge sharing.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve audit quality and business insight.
  • Anticipate evolving risks by monitoring changes across business strategy, technology, and regulation.
  • Lead initiatives that improve audit effectiveness, consistency, and scalability.

What You Need to Succeed

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • CPA, CIA, CISA, CFE, CA, or equivalent professional certification.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in public accounting, internal audit, consulting, or a combination of Big Four and large public company experience.
  • Proven track record of leading complex audit or advisory engagements across multiple risk domains.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience developing high-performing teams.
  • Software or technology industry experience is preferred.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strategic outlook that connects business priorities, risk insights, and data to influence decisions.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships and influence senior leaders across a global, matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading multiple priorities, navigating ambiguity, and delivering results through others.
  • Strong understanding of governance, risk management, internal controls, and audit methodology.
  • Experience applying data analytics and technology to enhance risk assessment, audit execution, and business insights.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to distill complex concepts, influence decision-making, and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • High degree of integrity, sound judgment, and professional skepticism.

descriptionHtml:
Our Company 

Empowering everyone to create is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours. 

The Opportunity  

The Adobe Sales Academy is a multi-phase world-class accelerated sales program designed to take top sales talent from a Business Development Rep (BDR) to an Enterprise Field Account Executive (AE). With multiple locations in North America, this program is crafted to see you grow, develop and succeed. At Adobe, we want to create the next generation of sales professionals, and that starts with you!  

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.   

What You’ll Do

title: Senior Software Development Engineer 5
descriptionHtml:
Be a part of Adobe’s Experience Platform (AEP); our fastest growing business in the Experience Cloud! AEP manages petabytes of data on behalf of our customers, allowing them to have a centralized and standardized data platform & applying data analytics to improve the design and delivery of rich & timely personalized experiences.  

AEP is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the AEP Core Platform team. We build scalable, performant services and tools to handle end-to-end customer lifecycle from building the platform for automated onboarding customers on the platform.  

This role requires extensive expertise in high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems. You will manage a wide technical area by driving architectural direction within and across multiple AEP platform teams. 

What you will do: 

  • Design and develop distributed services that are resilient, highly available, and scalable. 

  • Collaborate with business partners, architects, technical leads, product management and analysts to develop high-quality customer centric solutions. 

  • Guide multi-functional technical initiatives across related teams, establishing architectural direction for capabilities that cross service boundaries. 

  • Own feature development from inception to production rollout and postmortem & contribute to the development of engineering processes.  

  • Evaluate innovative technologies and incorporate them, heavily use AI for improved efficiency and iterate faster. 

What you will need to succeed: 

  • B.S. in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience, required; M.S. or equivalent practical depth preferred. 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience having built highly maintainable, scalable systems with Scala/Java or comparable, strongly typed language. 

  • Deep proficiency in Java or Scala — including the runtime: JVM memory management, GC tuning, thread scheduling, and how allocation patterns affect tail latency at high event rates. 

  • Proven ability to reason about system performance at scale — predict where a build breaks under load, profile production systems, and drive optimizations that improve real metrics  

  • Ability to multi-task simultaneously different projects, having a positive outlook, motivated learner with strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills. 

What will help you stand out from the crowd 

  • Unending curiosity, thoroughness, tenacity and focus on designing and building complex software systems with excellent quality to address customer problems. 

  • Experience developing backend distributed applications on Java/JVM and Spring (or similar framework). 

  • Shown experience using structured, focused approaches to solving technical, data, and logical problems.

title: Director, HR Business Partner & Japan EX Lead
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a strategic HR Director, responsible for enabling the continued growth of the Japan business. Reporting into the VP. Head of Employee Experience – JAPAC, this leader will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and exceptional partnership to the Japan President and business leaders across all functions and elevating the Employee Experience in Japan. 

S/he will be responsible for developing regional organizational and people strategies to support Adobe’s growth objectives through strategic partnering with the Centers of Excellence and functional leaders across Japan. Additionally, s/he will ensure operational rigor across all systems and processes, to enable the organization to scale in a highly efficient manner while ensuring ease of doing business. 

This leader will be responsible for overseeing and driving all HR Business Partner strategy across all client groups which are comprised of various Sales and Marketing teams, Professional Services, and Customer Experience. 

This role is a key member of the Japan Leadership Team.  In this role, this leader will drive our people and culture initiatives through the leadership team.  Additionally, this person will bring together the Exployee Experience team in Japan and partner to ensure that our Employee Experience priorities are aligned with the business and driving business performance. 

What you'll do 

  • Director, HR Business Partner & Japan Lead will be responsible for ensuring organizational alignment and effectiveness through effective partnership with the all of the business functions. 

  • Serve as a trusted senior business partner to our senior leader community (Senior Directors and above) to drive overall organizational effectiveness. S/he will provide thought leadership in the areas of: workforce planning, organizational design, resource/OpEx allocation, performance optimization, performance management, talent assessment & engagement, business integration (M&A), and change management leadership. 

  • Also, S/he will provide objective data-based perspectives on relevant organizational and People Resources issues and recommend and implement appropriate strategies to address the organizational issues. 

  • In addition, S/he will provide leadership in the areas of organizational design, organizational development, talent development, change management processes and process re-engineering. 

  • This person will partner with senior executives to diagnose complex organizational design and development needs, facilitating complex organizational discussions/problem solving while maintaining a high level of leadership engagement and involvement. This will include designing the strategy for employee and organizational capabilities. 

  • This person will drive the talent management process, alignment of resources to top priorities, and build capabilities needed to achieve a stated vision and strategy. 

  • Another key area of focus will be to sustain and advance positive organizational culture in alignment with adobe values. 

  • This person must be adept at advising and challenging senior leaders, in order to “stretch” the organization and build capability to support future growth. 

  • Instill a culture that resonates with Adobe’s values of Create the Future, Own the Outcome, Raise the Bar, and Be Genuine. 

What you need to succeed 

  • 15+ years of HR experience including team management and serving as an HR Business Partner to senior leaders in a global, matrixed organization.  

  • Strong business insight, connecting people strategies to company priorities. 

  • Proven experience operating in the Japan market, with strong understanding of local business dynamics, culture, and stakeholder expectations.  

  • Proven experience in organizational development and leading through change.  

  • Proven ability to develop relationships and partnerships (internal and external) at all levels of the organization, including influencing and coaching senior leaders.  

  • Ability to influence across levels, roles, cultures, and geographies Experience designing, implementing, and leading large initiatives.  

  • Strategic outlook with a proactive problem-solving approach. Agility to navigate ambiguity and prioritize effectively.

descriptionHtml:

From the moment you wake up in the morning, until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions or experiences was touched by an Adobe product.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Product Sales Specialist to join our Digital Experience teams in the Nordics, based in Stockholm!

What You'll Do

  • Run an enterprise sales territory across the Nordics, focusing on net new business for Adobe's Content, Workfront, and Semrush solutions
  • Sell the value of AI agents embedded across Content, Workfront, and Semrush, while using AI tools in your own workflow to research accounts, personalize outreach, and sharpen forecasts
  • Develop target named account strategies and tactical penetration plans
  • Develop and maintain relationships at the “C” and “VP” levels of the defined target named accounts
  • Develop compelling value propositions based on return on investment cost/benefit analysis

  • Contribute creative ideas and participate in marketing events
  • Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts

Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers appreciated.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.

  • 4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing three or more of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:

    • Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

    • Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage

    • Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager

    • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder

    • Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM

    • Adobe Target or Recommendations

    • Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)

    • Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion

    • GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)

  • Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.

  • Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.

  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.

title: Research Scientist (Applied) - IV
descriptionHtml:
Our Company 

Adobe is seeking a highly motivated and versatile Research Scientist to join our Media and Data Science Research (MDSR) Laboratory (https://adobe.mdsr.live/) in the Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) business unit. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to engage in world-class research that will craft the future of digital experiences. As part of our ambitious research team, you will tackle cutting-edge research challenges and develop innovative solutions that transform how businesses operate, engage with customers, market their products, and create impactful advertising experiences. You will have the unique opportunity to see your research evolve into products used by millions of users while also publishing your work at top-tier conferences and journals. Our research and products power the digital experiences of 1,900 of the Fortune 2,000 companies, giving your work the opportunity to create impact at an unparalleled global scale. 
 

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an outstanding work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe has been consistently listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are dedicated to supporting each other's growth. If you’re looking to make a difference, Adobe's the place for you. Learn more about our employees' career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the valuable benefits we provide. 

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to craft and deliver outstanding digital experiences. We’re passionate about redefining how companies connect with customers across every screen. 

Our goal is to recruit top talent and provide excellent employee experiences that prioritize respect and equal opportunity. We acknowledge that valuable insights can originate from any team member, including yourself. 

Responsibilities 

  • Develop and lead research initiatives in areas such as Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, and Machine Learning. 

  • Collaborate with product teams to turn research advances into impactful products. 

  • Design challenging evaluations related to creative intelligence and marketing performance. 

  • Develop scalable synthetic data generation and evaluation techniques. 

  • Manipulate and analyze complex, high-volume, and high-dimensional data from diverse sources. 

  • Train models and run experiments to study data and model quality. 

  • Iteratively refine research experiments and clearly communicate insights to the team. 

  • Integrate core machine learning models into the Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Experience Platform. 

  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to rapidly prototype and transition conceptual prototypes from research to production. 

Requirements 

  • (PhD degree and 3 years of experience) or (six years of experience) in industrial research in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or other relevant technical fields. 

  • Hands-on experience and a track record of deploying solutions in production environments. 

  • Multiple publications in top-tier conferences such as ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, PNAS, Nature, Science, ACL, EMNLP, CHI, WWW, KDD, CVPR, etc. 

  • Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, Behavioral Sciences, Agentic Workflows, Social Network Analysis, Causal Inference, Recommendation Systems, Multimodal Content Understanding. 

You Will Thrive In This Role If You: 

  • Experience in deriving concrete conclusions and actionable insights from large datasets. 

  • Ability to take research risks and solve hard problems independently. 

  • Are a great teammate who is willing to take on a variety of tasks to contribute to the success of the team 

  • Have a proven track record and an impulse for empirical research, answering complex questions with data. 

  • Are capable of leading ambitious projects and possessing clear communication skills. 

  • Have familiarity with crafting quality research experiments and evaluations with rapid iterations. 

  • Have experience working in complex technical environments and improving research velocity. 

  • Possess a flexible analytic approach that allows for results at varying levels of precision.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Executive Assistant to support our VP of Security. You will join a high-paced Global Safety, Security and Aviation team. This role is responsible for providing diverse operational and administrative support from daily calendar and meeting management to special projects and will play a critical part in driving our efforts to attract, develop and retain outstanding talent across every country and every region where we do business. The ideal candidate will become a critical part of the Employee Experience (EX) team, ensuring the smooth operations of events, metrics, systems, technologies and more. You'll be an organized self-starter that skillfully prioritizes and artfully juggles multiple demands with good judgment and attention to detail. You demonstrate a high degree of confidentiality and discretion, resourcefulness, timeliness, and ability to anticipate needs with a minimum amount of guidance in a dynamic environment. The work of this role will enhance the EX team’s impact globally. Come prepared for a lot of responsibility, ready to learn and grow, and plan to make a huge impact at Adobe! This opportunity is based out of our San Jose, CA office

What you’ll do

  • Provide administrative support to the Vice President of Global Safety, Security and Aviation and team

  • Calendar management - coordinate all meetings including but not limited to team meetings, offsite meetings, board and committee meetings, speaking engagements and meetings with internal and external business partners across global time zones

  • The candidate will understand the nuances of customer etiquette as well as how to engage both internal Adobe Executives and external contacts.

  • Possess a high degree of discretion and confidentiality; exhibit sound judgment in handling sensitive materials

  • Travel planning & support - domestic & international

  • Process business expense reimbursement requests, invoices and PO handling with precision

  • Leadership - Partnering with other Executive and Administrative Assistants, you'll create a harmonious support network for our leaders, amplifying their effectiveness

  •  Problem solving – anticipate and resolve challenges with initiative and efficiency; proactively identify ways to improve how we work

  • Project Management skills as well as prioritizing work and balancing several workstreams at a time

  • Partner closely with internal partners in preparation for meetings

  • Coordinate assistance with office space and equipment

  • Maintain organization distribution lists and charts, ability to review data with a keen attention to detail

  • Assists in coordinating and communicating about organization-wide engagement and social events

  • Supports and owns specialist projects on an as-needed basis

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 6-8 years of experience as an Executive Assistant.

  • Professional, completely discrete and able to work with highly confidential matters.

title: Pro Design Principal Product Manager, Growth
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

We're building the growth engine behind our professional design tools and emerging creative products. This is a newly created, growth-focused product management role, concentrated on acquisition, activation, and monetization for our apps. You'll report to the product director for this business line, building the growth function from the ground up, partnering closely with data science, product marketing, and the product, design and eng teams working on our apps.  

What You'll Do 

  • Own this product's growth strategy end to end: acquisition (including migrating an existing adjacent user base), activation, retention, and monetization, from private beta through the push to general availability. 

  • Build the growth measurement and experimentation foundation, partnering with a data science function to instrument the funnel, define metrics, and stand up an experimentation practice. 

  • Work with PMM to define and drive the monetization strategy, in partnership with that platform's product team. 

  • Run growth experiments end to end, from hypothesis through analysis through shipped change, balancing big bets that could shift the growth trajectory with quick wins that remove everyday friction. 

  • Ground growth prioritization in research the team already has (audience segmentation, competitive studies, beta-user profiling) rather than starting from a blank page, and commission new research to close real gaps. 

  • Partner with engineering, design, and marketing to ship growth work cleanly, and track how adjacent creative and design tools are moving so this product's growth story stays differentiated rather than reactive. 

  • As scope broadens, extend the same growth strategy and measurement discipline to a second product and the wider portfolio it sits in. 

What You'll Need to Succeed:

  • 6+ years in product management with a growth focus, including direct ownership of acquisition, activation, or monetization for a freemium or subscription product. 

  • A track record of running structured growth experiments (A/B testing, funnel analysis) and turning results into shipped product decisions, not just a readout. 

  • Strong analytical abilities and comfort partnering directly with data science to define metrics and build measurement from the ground up. 

  • Experience with monetization, pricing, or packaging strategy, ideally including usage-based or credit-based models. 

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. This role has dependencies on data science, engineering, design, and marketing, without formal authority over any of them. 

  • Familiarity with the professional design-tools competitive landscape is a strong plus. 

Bonus Qualifications 

  • Experience monetizing generative AI features or credit-based packaging. 

  • Experience taking a product through private beta to general availability. 

  • Prior experience in a large creative-software or design-tools ecosystem.

Group Manager and Lead - Motion Graphics & Editorial 

We’re looking for a highly skilled and very energetic candidate to come help us evolve & expand our internal Motion Graphics & Editorial team. This role sits within the Adobe Global Marketing Organization in the Video Production COE, and will lead and manage our in-house motion and editorial team. Initial focus is on building the team producing video content at velocity for lower to mid-funnel & rapid-response work, including shortform videos (usually :06 - :59) for product & feature releases, PR & Comms, advertising, paid and organic social, and more across a wide array of channels and specs. But this role will help evolve and lead our greater motion and editorial team as well. 

This is an important new role in a dynamic dept. The ideal candidate will: 

  • Be ready and able to build and manage teams and build & evolve team infrastructure, workflows, pipelines, and assets, and systems.  

  • Be very experienced in fast-turn motion and animation workflows, tools, methods, and storytelling, and working in a fast-paced, complex, deadline driven environment.

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity

Adobe is transforming customer experience by helping the world’s leading brands deliver seamless, intelligent and highly personalized interactions across every touchpoint. Through AI-powered Customer Engagement, Data Insights & Management, and Agentic AI, Adobe enables organizations to better

understand customer behavior, anticipate needs, and deliver meaningful, real-time experiences across every digital channel.

Today, Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally transforming how businesses acquire, understand, and engage their customers. Adobe is leading this transformation by combining AI-powered Customer Engagement, Data Insights & management, and Agentic AI capabilities to help the world's largest brands deliver intelligent, personalized customer experiences at scale.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Product Sales Specialist to join our Digital Experience Sales team in Rome.

We are looking for a high-energy individual with an ambitious spirit and a proven track record of success selling enterprise technology solutions. The successful candidate will drive the adoption of Adobe's AI-powered Data Insights, Customer Engagement, Marketing Automation, and Agentic AI solutions across Italy's largest enterprises.

The Product Sales Specialist will identify and develop new business opportunities, build executive relationships, create compelling value propositions, negotiate commercial agreements, and represent Adobe at customer and industry events.

What You'll Do

  • Run an enterprise sales territory focusing on net new business for Data Insights, Customer Engagement and AI solutions.
  • Develop target named account strategies and tactical penetration plans.
  • Develop and maintain relationships at C-Level and VP-Level within strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Develop compelling value propositions based on business outcomes and ROI.
  • Manage the complete enterprise sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, solution positioning, negotiation and closing.
  • Achieve annual software and services revenue targets.
  • Partner closely with Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Professional Services and Marketing teams.
  • Contribute innovative ideas and actively participate in marketing and industry events.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline management and sales forecasting.
  • Develop, maintain and strengthen strategic partner relationships.
  • Represent Adobe at executive briefings, customer events and industry conferences.

What You'll Need

  • Demonstrated enterprise software sales success with Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers (8–10+ years).
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives across enterprise organizations.
  • Knowledge of the Customer Engagement, Data & Insights, Marketing Automation and AI market landscape within Italy.
  • Experience applying consultative and insight-led selling methodologies.
  • Ability to understand complex customer business requirements and translate them into measurable business value.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to articulate complex AI and data value propositions in clear business language.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally, orchestrating multiple stakeholders throughout complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Successful experience selling strategic enterprise software solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong business development capabilities with a consistent record of quota achievement.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience and a proactive approach to identifying new opportunities.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives and industry influencers.
  • Executive presence with business, technical, IT and C-Level decision makers.

Why Adobe?

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment recognized globally among the

World's Best Companies to Work For. You will collaborate with talented colleagues who are passionate

about innovation and committed to helping each other grow through our Check-In culture of

continuous feedback and development.

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact while helping the world's leading brands transform

Customer Engagement through AI, Data and Digital Experiences, Adobe is the place for you.

title: Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe Digital Insights (ADI) has been a leading authority on the global digital economy since 2013, building its analysis on trillions of visits, billions of online transactions, and the prompts behind billions of AI-generated assets crafted with Adobe Firefly. ADI works with creators, marketers, and business leaders, up to C-level leadership at Adobe’s largest customers, to help them understand how the digital economy is shifting and how their business is performing relative to industry peers using Adobe’s unique data.

ADI’s mission is to inspire and delight all of Adobe’s audiences with leading, credible, differentiated, data-driven insights. We are transitioning to an agentic AI operating model, where LLM-powered agents are embedded across the end-to-end insights lifecycle, from raw data to business-ready insight products to audience-ready narrative. This role puts you in the middle of that work as a hands-on analyst turning Adobe’s data into the insights and stories our audiences rely on.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Scientist to support ADI’s digital economy work first and foremost. You will query and develop large datasets into trusted, repeatable insights. You will build the digital economy metrics and reports ADI is known for, and stepping in wherever the team needs analytical horsepower, from analysis of US dollar inflation to benchmarking critical web metrics. This is a hands-on analysis role for someone who loves finding the story in the data and getting it right.

This is a full-stack role: you will work end to end from raw data through processing and analysis to the data products downstream users depend on. Along the way you will collaborate with engineering, analysts, architects, product managers, and leadership, becoming a go-to ADI subject-matter expert.

What you'll Do

  • Own your work across the whole stack — from raw data and processing, through analysis, to data products downstream users and dashboards depend on.
  • Query, prioritize, and mine large structured and unstructured datasets (Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, CJA, and licensed sources) to produce accurate, defensible insights.
  • Build and maintain the recurring analyses, metrics, and indices behind ADI’s digital economy reporting, turning clean inputs into trusted outputs.
  • Flex to support any ADI topic as priorities shift across creativity trends, document efficiency, traffic based on data analysis, and product insights.
  • Turn analysis into clear narratives and visualizations that non-technical audiences can understand and act on.
  • Run ad-hoc deep dives and answer time-sensitive questions from collaborators across Adobe.
  • Work AI-natively using ADI’s AI tools and agents to speed up exploration, analysis, and drafting, while keeping a careful human eye on quality and consistency.
  • Partner with engineering to define data requirements and improve the pipelines and datasets you rely on.

What you need to succeed

  • A degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, mathematics, data science, or similar).
  • 4–6 years turning data into insight in an analytical, data science, or research role.
  • Strong data-analyst and insights skills querying with SQL and analyzing with Python to answer real business questions, not modeling for its own sake.
  • AI-native: proficient using AI and agentic tools to accelerate exploration, analysis, and drafting, with a careful human eye on quality.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable large-scale data platform).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving, forming hypotheses, testing them, and synthesizing clear recommendations.
  • A knack for data storytelling: explaining complex findings simply, in both writing and visuals.
  • Curiosity, care, and self-direction in a fast paced environment with shifting priorities; collaborative across teams and levels.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in economics, econometrics, forecasting, or time-series analysis.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, or Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or D3).
  • Experience working with survey data and methodology.
  • Familiarity with R or other scripting languages.

title: LOA & Benefits Program Manager US & Canada
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity  

Join Adobe’s Benefits Center of Excellence team and play a meaningful role in creating exceptional employee experiences through our Leave of Absence, Disability, Life, and Time Off programs. You’ll help design, deliver, continuously improve and measure the impact of benefits that empower our people to thrive both at work and in life. Our benefits philosophy is to design and deliver inclusive, competitive, and value driven benefits programs that enable peace of mind and productivity, with strategic balance between experience, scale, and financial stewardship.   

We are looking for an innovative thought leader for this role, someone who will help transform our Leave of Absence program into a world-class experience and mentor other Benefit analysts on the team. Someone who can make Adobe’s Benefits philosophy come alive by leading benefits programs across US & Canada. This role will be based in the US at our San Francisco or San Jose Office.  

What You will do 
 We identify the following primary responsibilities for this role. However, the list is not exhaustive as priorities might vary. 

Lead Benefits Program Management  

  • Support leadership in the execution of strategic goals, multi-year benefit planning, deliver on program objectives, supply industry best practices, conduct market benchmarking, and help with operational initiatives.  

  • Develop strong partnerships with Payroll, Legal, Employee Relations, HR Business Partners, Risk, EX/TR Operations, EX Tech, Accommodations team, Finance, VMO and other stakeholders.  

  • Financial management and oversight of the benefit programs, including overseeing self-funded plans, and annual fringe budget planning. Direct the annual POs process and ensure vendor invoice payment. 

  • Plan and execute special projects throughout the year, such as request for proposal (RFP) processes, vendor implementations, plan design changes, and ad-hoc projects with internal business partners. 

Compliance & Operations 

  • Supervise all compliance activities and set up statutory plans, ensuring the programs are meeting all state, federal and provincial compliance, as well as adherence to company policies and applicable leave laws. 

  • Setting up new state plans, responding timely to implementation deadlines, employee communications and annual notice requirements and filings. 

  • Track and analyze absence data and metrics, as well as operational trends, workflow efficiencies, service delivery, and program effectiveness. 

  • Ensure all operational compliance through program audits, employee communications, documentation reviews, Adobe pay practices, monitoring regulatory requirements. Using an innovative mind to address systemic issues with swift corrective action. 

Day-To-Day Activities 

  • Drive resolution on complex leave and life cases, including intermittent leave, extension requests, return-to-work and ADA-related leave requests. 

  • Oversee third-party vendor management including performance, service delivery, addressing operational concerns, renewals, and all the day-to-day leave administration providing a world-class white glove experience. 

  • Provide and maintain impactful training materials for managers, HR business partners, employees and employee resource center regarding leave policy and practice. 

  • Assist answering questions from people managers, employees and HR business partners, relating to leaves in US&C.  

  • Support Workers Compensation process by partnering with Risk and Global Security teams. 

What you need to succeed 

  • 7+ years of directly applicable and progressive benefit program management experience in leave administration, benefits management, consulting, or case management experience. 

  • Strong knowledge of leave practice and regulations for FMLA and ADA leave processes, state leave laws, VDI self-funded plan, military provisions, general provincial laws and rights, accommodations, other federal regulations, and return-to-work practices. 

  • Experience administering complex benefit programs for large, multi-state employer, implementing innovative operational business processes and practices. 

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex leave cases, implementing business process excellence, providing stellar employee experience, utilizing HRIS/leave management systems, monitoring compliance, and providing operational effectiveness and sound decision-making. 

  • Knowledge of Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) regulations, ADA, HIPAA, and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing benefits. 

  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and communication skills, as well as ability to exercise sound judgement, maintain confidentiality with sensitive employee information. 

  • Strong oral and written communication skills and attention to detail. 

  • Grounded in magical customer experiences, ability to see all aspects of the leave experience and continually evolve the program to maintain a high-quality end-to-end experience. 

  • Effective at multi-tasking while keeping calm and energetic. You can do hard things that deliver impactful results. 

  • Applying critical thinking to a highly complex program, partnering effectively with internal business partners and organizational leaders. 

  • Able to raise the bar on AI application in the leave space whether that is using AI agents, chat bots, or altering vendors' service delivery model. Having an AI-first mindset a plus. 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field. Required education may be substituted by additional years of experience. 

  • Certified Benefits Professional (CBP) or Certified Employee Benefit Specialist (CEBS) professional certification, a plus.

title: Principal Architect — Distributed Systems & Agentic AI Security, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Principal Architect — Distributed Systems, Agentic AI, Security, Privacy and Governance

Summary 

At Adobe, we are building enterprise-grade Agentic-AI systems that automate large-scale data access and workflow execution for business processes. These systems not only embody foundational enterprise security and privacy considerations but also provide robust and safety-preserving capabilities in the emerging world of agent identity, delegated access control and human-in-the-loop execution models.  

This is a multi-fluency role: you need the distributed systems and Agentic-AI depth to architect how agents reason, plan, and act at scale, and the security-and-compliance mechanisms that manage safe and trustworthy execution. You will partner with engineering, product, legal/privacy, and security leadership to turn fast-moving agentic AI capabilities into a governed, enterprise-ready platform. 

Key Responsibilities 

Agentic AI Architecture 

  • Define and drive the end-to-end reference architecture for how AI agents are authenticated and authorized to access enterprise data, tools, and systems across Adobe's Customer Experience Platform — covering agent lifecycle management, interaction protocols, memory/context handling, and action-execution frameworks. 

  • Evaluate and select frameworks, protocols, and platforms (e.g., agentic orchestration frameworks, MCP-style tool systems, policy engines such as OPA/Cedar-class authorization) that best support secure, governed multi-agent systems at Adobe's scale. 

Security, Compliance & Privacy by Design 

  • Own the security architecture for agent-to-system and agent-to-agent interactions: identity and workload authentication, least-privilege authorization, secrets and credential mediation, network egress controls, runtime isolation, and telemetry/audit evidence sufficient to satisfy internal audit and external regulators. 

  • Embed privacy-by-design and compliance requirements (data governance, consent, data residency, retention) directly into the agent architecture rather than bolting them on after the fact; partner with Legal/Privacy to keep architecture decisions ahead of regulatory expectations for autonomous AI systems. 

Cross-Organizational Leadership & Standards 

  • Lead architectural reviews and set standards for scalability, resiliency, observability, and cost efficiency — with security and compliance treated as first-class, non-negotiable design constraints rather than downstream signoffs. 

  • Contribute to or lead an Architecture Review Board function for agentic AI, ensuring new capabilities are evaluated consistently against Adobe's governance bar before they ship. 

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Evangelism 

  • Serve as Adobe's senior technical authority and encouraging leader on secure agentic AI architecture. Mentor senior engineers and architects. Elevate security and privacy proficiency across the broader engineering organization.  

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and threat models that are equally useful to implementation teams and to senior leadership. 

Executive & Customer Engagement 

  • Represent Adobe's agentic AI security and governance posture to executive leadership, enterprise customers, and — where relevant — regulators and standards bodies, with clear, bounded claims about maturity, open risks, and the evidence required before broader rollout. 

  • Provide thought leadership across the organization where agentic AI access governance is heading, and shape Adobe's roadmap accordingly. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering and security architecture, with a strong focus on distributed systems, platform engineering, and enterprise-scale access control. Recent experience in Agentic AI Security

  • Deep understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns: agent orchestration, tool/function calling, reasoning and planning loops, and multi-agent coordination, along with the risks specific to each. 

  • Expert-level knowledge of identity and access management, authorization models, and credential/secrets management (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, SAML, workload identity, policy-as-code approaches such as OPA/Rego or Cedar-class engines). 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous initiatives involving multiple functions across security, product, legal/privacy, and infrastructure teams, and to influence org-wide standards without direct authority.  

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Practical experience with agent-lifecycle governance, including audit evidence generation and anomaly/incident response for autonomous systems. 

  • Familiarity with privacy and compliance frameworks relevant to AI systems (e.g., data residency, consent management, and sectoral regulatory expectations for automated decision-making). 

  • Experience building or governing developer platforms, cloud-native services, or streaming data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Spark) at enterprise scale. 

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Security, or related technical field. 

  • Experience standing up or contributing to an enterprise Architecture Review Board or equivalent governance function. 

Success Profile 

  • Strong systems thinker who can simplify genuinely hard problems — you make governance transparent without making it burdensome. 

  • Comfortable operating at both hands-on technical depth and strategic, executive-facing leadership. 

  • High ownership, high bias for execution, and a track record of turning a working draft into a production-grade, adopted standard.

title: Manager Enterprise Sales (Creativity & Productivity)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The opportunity

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the ads you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions, every single one of those experiences, was touched by an Adobe product. 

Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity Team in the Western region is looking for a proactive Sales Leader, responsible for leading our Team of Enterprise Sales Executives inFrance. This leader should be familiar with selling enterprise software and have experience leading by example. title: Senior Security Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Detection & Automation Engineering operates Adobe's detection and response backbone, closing the gap between detection and containment.

As a Senior Security Automation Engineer, you'll design and build production-grade automation, orchestration, and agentic AI systems that reduce mean-time-to-respond and scale Adobe's security operations beyond human-speed triage. You'll partner with Detection Engineering to turn new detection rules into working response, engineer enterprise-scale APIs and orchestration services across the security stack, and deliver containment automation and identity/access response actions used in live incidents. This is a build role for someone who wants to reshape how Adobe automates security response, not simply administer a SOAR platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, develop, and maintain automation and orchestration systems spanning SOAR playbooks, custom services, and agentic AI workflows that automate enrichment, correlation, and containment across the security stack.
  • Partner directly with Detection Engineering on every new detection rule that needs a response action. They define the logic, you engineer and verify the automation, including autonomous/agentic response paths where appropriate.
  • Architect and build enterprise-grade APIs, connectors, and orchestration services that give security operations teams machine-speed enrichment and correlation, reducing analyst triage time and improving signal quality at scale.
  • Own containment and remediation automation for Incident Response, including identity-and access-related response actions used during live incidents.
  • Create and maintain policy-enforcement automation, ensuring upstream access and control decisions execute reliably, without gaps.
  • Integrate automation with ecosystem tooling, including identity providers, endpoint and EDR platforms, and ticketing systems, via REST APIs and custom connectors, and via SOAR platforms where they're the right tool for the job.
  • Design and deploy agentic AI systems, including multi-step autonomous workflows with agent orchestration and context engineering, to extend detection and response beyond scripted playbook logic.
  • Triage production automation issues as an operational priority, and track metrics for automation coverage, reliability, and time-to-remediate.
  • Contribute to Detection-as-Code integration within Detection Engineering's existing standards, and document automation logic for team-wide ownership.
  • Actively find ways to integrate AI into day-to-day work, including playbook development, script writing, enrichment logic, triage, incident summarization, testing, and documentation.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
Required:

  • 7+ years in security engineering, software engineering, or security automation, with a track record of shipping production-grade code, not just configuring vendor tooling.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale APIs, services, or orchestration systems, demonstrated through real delivered projects.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining SOAR playbooks (Splunk SOAR, Tines, XSOAR, etc.), including custom actions, connectors, and playbook logic in Python.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for production automation development.
  • Demonstrated experience building or deploying agentic AI systems, such as agent orchestration, prompt or context engineering, or autonomous multi-step workflows, applied to security or operational automation.
  • Practical understanding of incident response and security investigative workflows.
  • Experience integrating systems with detection/SIEM tooling, identity/access systems, and ticketing/case management systems via REST APIs.
  • Ability to work independently on unstructured problems, making defensible, risk-based decisions on containment/response logic.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You'll document system and automation logic for engineers and explain the same tradeoffs to non-technical collaborators.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor), and judgment on when they help.



Preferred:

  • Experience running agentic AI systems in production with real autonomy, where agents initiate containment or response actions with minimal human involvement, or building reusable agent orchestration frameworks adopted by other engineers.
  • Experience with identity/access systems (e.g., Okta, Entra ID) for containment actions like session revocation or account disable.
  • Comfort with both low-code playbook design and pro-code extensions, writing custom Python when built-in logic isn't enough.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and webhook-based integrations, beyond standard polling REST calls.
  • Proficiency in more than one scripting or development language (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Go) beyond Python.
  • Familiarity with Detection-as-Code practices and CI/CD for security content.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers or serving as a technical point of contact for automation work.
  • Background supporting compliance-relevant controls where automation failures have audit implications.
  • Relevant certifications a plus but not required.

title: Creative Strategist, Motion/3D
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Enterprise brands need more creative than any internal team can produce alone: dozens of branded variants a week, across every channel. Adobe's Firefly Creative Production platform can generate that volume, but it can't decide what to build, spot the real ask behind a request, or tell a quick workflow from a custom one.

That's the job: turning a rough brief into clear creative direction before anything gets generated. That means knowing motion, VFX, and 3D well enough to say what's achievable now, what needs a custom build, and what's not worth doing, and flagging platform gaps to product and engineering with enough detail to act on.

This isn't necessarily an execution role. It's about deciding what gets made, and making sure it's the right call.

What You'll Do

  • Turn rough briefs into clear creative direction and defined use cases before work starts.
  • Judge feasibility across motion, VFX, and 3D: what existing workflows handle now, what needs a custom build, what's out of scope.
  • Work with Forward Deployed Engineering to spec out requests that exceed current capability.
  • Set expectations directly with customer creative and marketing teams before production starts.
  • Stay sharp in motion graphics, VFX, and 3D to judge output quality without doing the execution.
  • Surface specific product and engineering gaps to internal teams, drawn from real customer requests.
  • Track tools like Firefly, Runway, and Veo closely enough to adjust direction as they evolve.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in motion, VFX, or 3D production, with real experience setting direction, not just implementing someone else's.
  • Proficiency in After Effects, Cinema4D or Maya, Substance 3D, and generative AI tools, enough to judge craft and feasibility without daily hands-on work.
  • A track record of turning vague requests into clear direction, from an agency, brand team, or client-facing role.
  • Comfortable pushing back on scope and timeline with customers directly.
  • Experience translating creative intent into technical specs with engineering or production teams.
  • A plus: familiar node-based workflows or generative AI pipelines at scale.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Prefers setting direction over delivering on specs.
  • Wants customer-facing, cross-functional work over solo, heads-down work.

title: Director and Associate General Counsel, Corporate Legal
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe’s Legal and Government Relations (LGR) team partners with business and functional teams to manage the company's legal and government affairs. Sub-teams within the organization include Policy, Compliance, Anti-piracy, Corporate Securities and M&A, Litigation, Intellectual Property, Privacy, Trademarks & Marketing, Employment, Real Estate, Security, Operations and Product and Sales support. Adobe’s LGR embraces groundbreaking approaches and best practices to align with Adobe’s business needs.

Against this backdrop, Adobe is seeking a Director, Corporate Legal to support key aspects of the company’s corporate legal needs, including public company securities disclosure and reporting, executive compensation, supporting Board of Directors and its committees, corporate governance, insider trading compliance, and treasury matters.


Reporting to the VP Corporate Legal, the successful candidate will be a lawyer with strategic and operational expertise in corporate and securities law,  and have strong demonstrated intellectual curiosity to develop a deep understanding of our business and products. The successful candidate will also have the ability to communicate effectively , proven success in working cross functionally, and a sharp focus on managing risk with a healthy risk appetite balance.

What You’ll Do

  • Work as a key member of the corporate legal team working on a broad range of U.S. securities law matters, including preparation and review of SEC filings (including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, registration statements, proxy statements and annual reports), annual stockholder meetings, and related matters (e.g., D&O questionnaires, no-action letters)
  • Provide legal advice and support on corporate governance matters, including preparation and review of agenda, materials, minutes/resolutions for Adobe Inc. board and committee meetings, and reviewing and maintaining corporate governance documents, policies and guidelines.
  • Provide legal advice and support on executive compensation and equity-related matters, including related disclosure issues.
  • Provide legal support on public disclosures (e.g., earnings releases, investor relation presentations) and stockholder engagement.
  • Provide legal support for finance/treasury activities, including capital market transactions, credit facilities and stock buyback programs.
  • Support insider trading compliance and reporting, including Section 16 filings and 10b5-1 plan matters.
  • Provide oversight and legal guidance on subsidiary management matters, including entity maintenance, formation of new entities, restructurings and intercompany agreements
  • Monitor, track and advise on potential impacts of new and proposed legal and regulatory requirements with respect to securities and corporate governance matters, including related trends, benchmarking and best practices.
  • Develop, implement, document  and continually improve corporate and team processes and procedures, including through the use of AI tools and legal technology.
  • Manage and mentor a small team of corporate legal professionals, fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture.

What Makes You Successful

title: Software Development Engineer 4
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) enables businesses to deliver the right experience at the right time to their customers. The Segmentation Service is one of the key AEP services, providing the ability to define customer segments and generate target audiences based on real-time customer profiles. Customer segment definitions are sophisticated queries over profile and event data capturing specific attributes or behaviors shared by a subset of users. With the need to perform trillions of audience segment evaluations per day, scalability and efficiency are paramount in segment evaluation. This is a great opportunity for engineers to solve extremely interesting challenges of scale and build core services that are used by all Adobe Digital Experience solutions. As part of building these services, you will work with an exceptionally talented and collaborative team, tackle complex query evaluation challenges, design & implement innovative algorithms and build highly performant services.

What you'll Do

· Collaborate with a team of engineers & product managers in building a high-performance segmentation engine. Own responsibility for design and implementation of key components

· Develop query compilation algorithms that transform and rewrite segment definition queries

· Develop query optimization and evaluation algorithms including multi-query optimization, incremental evaluation and streaming evaluation

· Work on cross functional themes involving advanced data pipelines using Apache Spark

· Build tools to monitor query performance and identify & debug potential semantic errors

· Deploy production services and iteratively improve them based on customer feedback

· Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines

· Participate in architecture, design & code reviews

What you need to succeed

· B.S. in Computer Science or a related field is required

· M.S. in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience is preferred

· Experience building a scalable query engine or equivalent practical experience is required. Experience in language design is a plus

· Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures

· Proficiency in Databases or compilers is preferred

· Strong programming skills with extensive experience in Java or Scala

· Proficiency in Apache Spark is preferred.

· Leadership skills to collaborate and drive cross-team efforts

title: Editorial Lead
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We're looking for a sharp, narrative-focused Editorial Lead to lead the Adobe Corporate Blog and shape the voice, standard and quality of all external written materials. This is a role for someone who thinks like a journalist, edits with a steady hand, and understands how editorial rigor builds audience trust and business impact! Prior experience as a reporter or editor at a publication or newsroom is strongly preferred.

What you'll Do

  • Develop and implement an editorial content strategy that aligns with the corporate narrative, brand goals, and target audiences. Implement a rigorous editorial calendar for the corporate blog while growing thought leadership.
  • Set high editorial standards, style guidelines, and a consistent "One Adobe" voice across all written content, including blog posts, press releases, and executive communications.
  • Commission, assign, brief, and edit content — from light copy edits to substantive rewrites — ensuring every asset meets Adobe’s editorial and reputational bar.
  • Apply strong news judgment to identify story angles, executive perspectives, and industry moments that meaningfully advance industry conversation and Adobe's role in crafting what's next.
  • Partner with the PR team to edit and elevate announcement narratives into clear, reporter-ready storytelling that holds up to scrutiny.
  • Write original articles, thought leadership pieces, and executive bylines when needed, grounded in data, customer stories, and real-world impact.
  • Manage full submission and review workflows (blogs, press releases etc), coordinating across collaborators to meet publication timelines.
  • Track and report on key performance metrics and use data to continuously raise editorial quality, reach and impact.

What you need to succeed

  • 10+ years of experience in editorial, journalism, content strategy, or corporate communications roles.
  • Exceptional writer and editor with the ability to develop compelling narratives for a range of formats — corporate announcements, thought leadership, success stories, and executive perspectives.
  • Deep understanding of SEO and GEO protocols, including structuring content for AI discoverability and answer engine citation.
  • Proven ability to manage contributors, editorial workflows, and multiple competing deadlines with precision.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe's GTM Finance Global HQ team as a Lead Financial Analyst and become a key FP&A partner to our business. You'll drive data-driven decisions, strategic insights, and support Adobe's Field Organization with seamless delivery across outlook, annual planning, and high-profile workstreams. title: Senior Security IAM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Position summary:

The Senior Security Engineer position will be part of the Enterprise Security organization consisting of IAM professionals across several technologies. This specific position will have a specialized role in directory services and SaaS applications! It will focus on large implementations of Entra ID with integrations with other directories, IDPs, applications, and automated workflows. We give technical direction, administer tools, and provide support for various security technologies. We participate in driving Enterprise Security projects that use our cloud directory services for various internal and external Adobe services. We work with other specialists, architects, security teams, and software engineer teams across Adobe and collectively provide services, guidance, and strategies that protect services and data as well as adhere to various global government regulations. You will work with business customers, management teams, infrastructure teams, development teams, project managers, and other security teams to help implement the vision, structure, standards, and plan solutions that support the future architecture.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world on Best Companies lists! You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe is the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

Primary Responsibilities May Include, but Are Not Limited To:

  • Managing deep and complex directory architectures and services span directories, IDPs, and federated environments.
  • Providing guidance and architecting solutions for directory service strategies across a variety of internal customers at Adobe.
  • We help test, implement, and support secure services used by end-users, devices, and application workflows to all of Adobe.
  • We engineer secure identity solutions for on-premises and cloud environments.
  • We are a team of Security Engineers that handle incoming requests, respond to issues, solve reported problems, and develop solutions.
  • We meet with teams to get business requirements, understand workflows, and devise solutions.
  • We help assess SaaS implementations for identity integrations and general security.
  • We generate useful metrics to help make decisions, identify issues, and manage our sevices.

Requirements:

  • Possess a Bachelor's or advanced degree in MIS, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Engineering OR 10+ years in IT or Cybersecurity
  • Comfortable working on and leading different projects with many teams at one time
  • In-depth understanding of Windows, Mac and UNIX/Linux based systems, permissions, and interoperability.
  • Strong knowledge of machine to machine and application to machine connections using MFA, certificates, tokens, and other methods.
  • Strong understanding of the identity lifecycle, secure by design, least privileged and zero trust.
  • An in-depth knowledge and understanding of managing and securing Entra ID cloud directories (AWS and Okta are beneficial) and integrating with traditional directories (e.g. Active Directory/389DS/ LDAP based directories).
  • Proficient in written and verbal communications, skilled at working alongside differing viewpoints to accomplish shared objectives.
  • Able to work independently and as a team member.
  • Capable of conveying technical concepts to diverse audiences including non-technical users, architects, and senior leadership.
  • Professional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills to engage with senior leadership.
  • A deep understanding of Cloud Directories, especially Entra ID, and how to secure it, use conditional access policies, and apply/create automation.
  • Ability to teach and mentor others while fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Can model leadership behavior and help to grow other’s leadership behavior.

Preferred:

  • Understanding of Desktop operating systems including Windows, Linux, and Mac
  • Experience or knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure
  • Strong abilities in programming/scripting languages for automating repeatable tasks like Python, PowerShell, etc.
  • Experience and/or Knowledge of dashboarding and log correlation engines such as Grafana, Telegraph, Splunk, etc.
  • Experience with SaaS Security Posture Management technologies.
  • Experience with developing PowerBI dashboards.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Join our dynamic team at Adobe as a Site Operations Manager and be part of an outstanding journey in facilities management. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to coordinate five sites approximately 130k sq ft across Germany and Switzerland, ensuring a world-class workplace experience. You will be instrumental in positive relationships with key partners and lead cross-functional meetings, driving flawless execution of strategies and solutions.  

What you'll Do 

  • Act as the primary contact for Workplace Strategy & Site Operations (WSSO) covering real estate, employee experience, projects, and site operations at designated sites. 

  • Execute the Global Site Operations (GSO) vision, encouraging deep business relationships with senior leaders and business unit teams to proactively address space and services issues.  

  • Lead and coordinate site vendors, including facilities management, food service, wellness, space & occupancy, finance, sustainability, and events teams.  

  • EMEA lead for mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) operations 

  • Manage financials, ensuring budget adherence and accurate forecasting. 

  • Balance customer-centricity with operational excellence in delivering site services. 

  • Implement sustainability strategies and lead site-level initiatives. 

  • Act as owner’s rep for all projects, ensuring business and operational requirements are met. 

  • Establish occupancy strategies and manage space utilization effectively. 

  • Collaborate with Employee Experience and IT organizations to improve employee productivity and experience. 

  • Partner with Global Safety and Security for incident management and safety, emergency response teams, and business continuity.   

  • Represent and drive the site requirements with landlords and building management  

  • Lead Adobe’s employee community and engagement program (Site Council).  

  • Lead facilities management operations with a hospitality mentality.

Education: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or another relevant field, or equivalent professional experience. Certifications are a plus.  

Experience: 

  • 10 years work experience, with at least 5 years in managing and leading site facilities independently, of which 3 years includes managing on the client side.

  • Strong collaborative skills with customers. 

  • Strong executive presence and cross-functional team management skills.

title: Western Region Sr. Security Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our company

At Adobe, we’re molding the world! How? We give people the tools to bring their ideas to life and design content that makes life more fun and work more purposeful. We give businesses and organizations the power to truly engage their customers.

We develop content that streams across your laptop, TV, phone, and tablet every day. We’re the ones who harness the power of big data to help companies move from data to insight and insight to action by delivering content that people desire most. If you’re passionate about leading from where you sit, join us!

The challenge

Based in Lehi, Utah, Adobe’s Western Region Security Manager supports the resiliency of Adobe’s offices on the West Coast. You will be charged with developing operational objectives, participating with other managers/teams in crafting, and supporting strategic plans for the western region. Moreover, implement various programs to reduce risk and build exceptional employee experiences. The Area Security Manager's responsibilities are:

  • Service delivery
  • Engagement
  • Support of investigations
  • Physical security management
  • Safety compliance
  • Security risk management
  • Event security
  • Incident management
  • Loss management
  • Physical security system management
  • Policy and procedure management
  • Contract oversight

The Area Sr. Security Manager for the Western Region will be responsible for the security operations across multiple locations in North America. Responsibilities include reviewing, implementing, and maintaining security policies and procedures to ensure the safety and protection of personnel, assets, and facilities. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of security risk management, emergency response, incident management, and coordination with local law enforcement and emergency services. The manager must proactively assess and respond to potential threats.

The role will model Adobe Values, exercising duties with discretion, nuance, and maturity. They should possess excellent judgment, problem-solving abilities, decision-making skills, agility and program management capabilities. This position is based at Adobe’s Lehi office in Lehi, UT, and reports to the Regional Director, Safety & Security – Americas & Global Security Operations Center.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with the Regional Director of Safety and Security to set objectives and lead security operations at regional sites
  • Work in unison with regional peers to establish uniformed, scalable programs that embody consistency
  • Build relationships with executives, site leaders, and cross-functional teams to influence compliance and improve security programs
  • Act as liaison between security and local teams to align on site and security objectives
  • Conduct security and safety audits at regional locations and address vulnerabilities
  • Perform Security and Health & Safety Assessments and manage corrective actions.
  • Manage the budget, security vendors, and approve invoices and expenses
  • Investigate policy violations, misconduct, and criminal activity
  • Lead and implement incident management programs and support business continuity during emergencies
  • Partner with facilities and teams to support employee programs and services
  • Coordinate safety committees, prepare reports, and supervise mitigation activities.
  • Respond to and report incidents such as theft, alarms, and injuries
  • Lead new employee orientation and assist with ergonomics and EH&S programs
  • Arrange emergency response and safety training programs
  • Provide security support for office projects and vendor coordination.
  • Ensure alignment with corporate policies and department guidelines
  • Build relationships with local law enforcement, fire departments, and emergency teams
  • Develop and conduct employee safety and security training programs
  • Oversee a safe and secure environment at corporate events

What you need to succeed

  • Experience making life-safety decisions, with demonstrated expertise in corporate security operations, corporate investigations, and security leadership preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required, with at least 10 years of related work experience, including 5 years in corporate security management
  • Ability to evaluate risks, influence leadership, and build solutions, think creatively
  • Strong customer service focus with a strive to build programs that improve brand reputation and employee experience
  • Proven track record managing security teams, vendors, and contractors, with expertise in security systems, incident response, and risk management
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, able to engage and to communicate effectively with senior leadership, site managers, and external partners
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of leading emerging security challenges
  • Familiarity with security technologies, including surveillance, access control, and alarm systems
  • Incident or crisis management experience, including coordinating with emergency services and law enforcement
  • Ability to respond to and handle security incidents, including site and risk assessments
