title: Vice President, Product and Software Security
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide. 

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio. 

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.  

What You'll Do 

Define and Implement Security Strategy  

  • Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems. 

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Engineering, Platform, and Security leaders, helping drive innovation, customer trust, and business growth. 

  • Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security. 

Drive Systemic Risk Reduction 

  • Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices. 

  • Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation. 

  • Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture. 

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era 

  • Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms. 

  • Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences. 

  • Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale. 

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization 

  • Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams. 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines. 

  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. 

Strengthen Customer Trust 

  • Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle. 

  • Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.  

  • Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust. 

What You'll Bring 

  • Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies. 

  • Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities. 

  • Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.  

  • Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe seeks a Head of External Reporting and Technical Accounting, ESG Controller to join our finance leadership team. This highly visible, critical role will report to the Senior Director, Global Accounting, Reporting and Revenue Assurance and lead our External Reporting & Equity Accounting, Technical Accounting, and ESG Regulatory Reporting teams. This role will also lead the full Mergers & Acquisitions (“M&A”) cycle for accounting, from advising on deal structure and performing due diligence to overseeing the accounting valuation process and advising the record-to-report finance integration workstream. Key to success will be your ability to partner and influence cross functionally with our Revenue, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, Corporate Social Responsibility and Employee Experience teams.

What you'll Do

  • Lead the external reporting team on drafting and filing all financial documents and SEC filings
  • Coordinate with Investor Relations, Corporate Legal and senior leaders to review our earnings documents, including drafting the most complex or unique matters in a simple, easy, and understandable way
  • Serve as trusted technical accounting advisor for complex transactions under existing or future rules, including overseeing policy updates for FASB pronouncements and SEC rules
  • Assess the impact of proposed accounting pronouncements and standards to ensure compliance with SEC and GAAP reporting requirements and provide educational trainings to impacted stakeholders
  • Own the global consolidated audit process to resolve issues and avoid delays
  • Advise corporate development and legal teams on the accounting treatment for potential deals and strategic investments (i.e., asset acquisitions, business combinations, and VIE/VOE considerations)
  • Cross-functionally manage the end-to-end financial due diligence for M&A transactions
  • Monitor the evolving global regulatory ESG reporting landscape and evaluate and determine the applicability of new reporting regulations globally
  • Build our capabilities in terms of people, processes, internal controls and systems to meet all mandatory ESG reporting requirements globally
  • Coordinate limited and reasonable assurance over ESG disclosures with external accounting firms where required
  • Support and coordinate with teams managing our voluntary ESG reporting to ensure we’re working in a collaborative manner
  • Identify annual strategic priorities for the organization which align with corporate priorities and have the biggest impact to Adobe
  • Develop, coach, and mentor the team to reinforce a strong team culture and to assist team members in reaching their individual development and professional goals

What you need to succeed

  • BA/BS in Finance/Accounting with active CPA license
  • 15+ years of relevant experience, including Big 4 public accounting firm experience and a global Fortune 500 company, preferably with high tech industry and controllership experience
  • Deep understanding and application of GAAP and SEC reporting requirements
  • Technical accounting expertise in business combinations, treasury-related activities, share-based compensation
  • Passion for continuous improvement of systems and processes
  • Proven experience leading a team of 7+ employees
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all functions and levels of the organization
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment;
  • Experience working with ESG reporting standards
  • SAP experience a plus.

title: Dir, Software Development
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

What happens when data, AI, and great engineering come together to solve problems at Adobe's scale?

Adobe is looking for a Director of Solution Engineering to help answer that question.

This team works at the intersection of business strategy, software engineering, digital experiences, data, and AI. The challenges are complex, the opportunities are significant, and the impact reaches across Adobe. From helping leaders explore new opportunities to building capabilities that become part of how teams work every day, the work is varied, collaborative, and deeply rewarding.

In this role, you'll lead a team focused on transforming ideas into solutions that can be reused across the company. You'll help shape how Adobe approaches data, automation, and AI while working alongside talented leaders in Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Platform organizations.

Just as importantly, you'll help build an environment where people can learn, grow, take ownership, and do meaningful work. If you enjoy developing leaders, solving difficult challenges, and influencing how technology enables business success, we'd love to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and grow a team of managers, architects, and solution engineers who help Adobe solve complex business and technology challenges.
  • Partner with leaders across Adobe to understand opportunities, define priorities, and identify where data can create meaningful impact.
  • Work with teams to transform business needs into data products, services, and capabilities that can be adopted and reused across the company.
  • Help shape trusted data foundations that make information easier to discover, understand, and use.
  • Guide the creation of AI-enabled and data-driven experiences that improve how teams work and make decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Platform teams to bring ideas from concept to adoption.
  • Encourage practical, thoughtful use of AI, automation, and modern engineering approaches that help teams spend more time innovating and less time on repetitive work.
  • Establish solution patterns, reference implementations, and best practices that help teams move faster while maintaining quality.
  • Support the growth of future leaders through coaching, mentorship, feedback, and career development.
  • Foster an inclusive environment where people feel empowered to contribute, experiment, learn, and succeed.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, product development, data and analytics, consulting, or related technology fields.
  • Experience leading technical teams, including managers and senior individual contributors.
  • A strong foundation engineering principles, system design, and modern development practices.
  • Experience working with mobile applications, client-side technologies, SDKs, instrumentation frameworks, digital experiences, or event-driven systems.
  • Familiarity with the full journey of data, from client instrumentation and event collection through reporting, analytics, automation, and AI experiences.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Typography is central to how ideas are communicated. If you're passionate about beautifully created design, have deep curiosity about what AI can do, and take personal responsibility for creating products that people love; then this may be the role for you. Adobe Fonts supports millions of creatives in choosing and using typefaces across fonts.adobe.com, Express, Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat, and more Creative Cloud platforms. Our Internal Services team provides the platform engineering and deployment backbone for all of these. We manage CI/CD, deployment approaches, the services and data layers our engineers depend on, our observability and security stance, and increasingly the agentic tools that transform how our entire organization delivers software.

We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead this exciting journey in our San Francisco location.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve our deployment platform. Lead strategy for CI/CD, PR environments, and release safety across a mixed fleet that includes containerized services, serverless services, and static front ends.
  • Build the foundation for AI-accelerated development. Help build our agent factory and grow our internal agentic toolkit and skill library.
  • Ship inference applications at scale. Take greenfield services from spec to production and standardize our ML/inference footprint.
  • Modernize our services for the AI era. Identify where an existing service is held back by its current build and lead the fix.
  • Rethink our security posture for agentic threats. Lead how we secure autonomous agents and their tool use.
  • Expose Adobe Fonts to the agentic ecosystem. Extend our Model Context Protocol (MCP) surface and conversational, intent-based font discovery.
  • Work higher up the stack, too. Contribute directly to search, browse, discovery, and the customer-facing experiences our platform powers.
  • Hold ownership over what you deliver to production, encompassing on-call support, incident management, and the reliability of the services and pipelines that the entire organization depends upon.
  • Set technical direction and multiply the team. Write the development docs, run the technical reviews, and mentor engineers.

What we're looking for

Software engineering

  • Deep full-stack fundamentals and craft — build, testing, code quality, code review — plus system development and production maturity: latency, scale, reliability, observability, and on-call ownership.
  • Ships and owns services end to end, and reasons fluently across the whole stack: front end (JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Web Components), application services (Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, and comfort picking up others), and the SRE/config/hardware layer beneath (Terraform, Chef, Kubernetes/Helm, AWS).

Platform & deployment depth

  • Strong CI/CD ownership (Jenkins or equivalent), containerization and orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and AWS (EC2/ASG, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront). Experience making deployment fast, safe, and self-service — ephemeral/preview environments, progressive delivery, rollback strategy.
  • Solid grasp of the data and messaging layers behind real services, including relational, caching, search, and event-driven/pub-sub. You know how to run migrations and upgrades without downtime.

AI/agentic proficiency

  • Hands-on understanding of building AI-enabled systems: agent runtimes, tool calling, MCP, LLM/inference serving, and the infrastructure around them — evaluation, feedback loops, observability, and sandboxed execution.
  • A security outlook for this new surface — you think about how agentic systems fail and get abused, and proactively build guardrails accordingly.

Leadership & scope

  • Track record of delivering high-impact platform work used across multiple teams, leading complex cross-team technical efforts, and balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, security, and operability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated senior-level impact.

Nice to have

  • Ruby on Rails at scale, and experience decomposing or modernizing a large monolith.
  • GPU/model-serving infrastructure and low-latency inference (e.g. SageMaker, Kubernetes GPU platforms); search-engine internals (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, vector/hybrid search).
  • Experience building developer platforms, internal tooling, or agent harnesses adopted by other teams.
  • Event-driven architectures and secrets-management platforms (Vault, CyberArk).
  • Front-end depth with modern component systems (Web Components/Lit, React/TypeScript, build systems).

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Observability
descriptionHtml:
The Team


We are a globally distributed team inside Adobe Developer Platforms. We own the observability platform Adobe's engineering ecosystem runs on – one of the largest logging deployments in the industry, spanning 50,000+ nodes, billions of OTel events daily, and an auth service we built in Go that handles 15,000 req/sec. Every Adobe engineer depends on what we ship.

We build it, we ship it, we run it.



The Opportunity


  • Compose, build, and run Adobe's observability platform at scale
  • Write Go and Python: extend OpenTelemetry Collector receivers, processors, and exporters, contribute to open-source, and build the internal services, APIs, and tooling around them
  • Drive cost optimisation: analyse pipeline data, build guardrails, and engage engineering teams
  • Build developer-facing tooling and services, including AI-powered insight from high-volume telemetry and observability for AI and agent-based systems
  • Own SLOs and SLIs for a platform thousands of engineers rely on every day
  • Own on-call, lead incident response for high-severity issues, and make every shift better than the last


What you'll Do


  • Strong, hands-on Go and/or Python. Our platform is predominantly Go — the OpenTelemetry Collector, Cortex, Prometheus, and Kubernetes all are — and Python carries much of our tooling. You should be able to contribute production code in at least one, and read the other
  • 5–8+ years building and owning production software at scale, ideally platform or infrastructure products used by other engineers
  • Build, code review, and automated testing coordinated into how you ship, not a separate phase
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry — not just configuring collectors, but extending them and instrumenting applications with the SDKs
  • Working knowledge of large-scale logging infrastructure — Splunk, ClickHouse, New Relic, Prometheus, LangSmith
  • Experience developing, deploying, and running distributed applications on cloud platforms; experience with container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Comfortable owning on-call across a multi-tool observability stack, including leading Sev 1/2 incident response


What you need to succeed


  • Experience evaluating and prototyping alternative Observability platforms, both commercial and open-source
  • Experience with other Observability tooling like Grafana, Cortex, ElasticSearch, DataDog, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir
  • TypeScript/React — we ship an observability plugin in Adobe's Developer Home (based on Backstage)
  • Experience instrumenting AI/LLM or agent-based systems, nice to have

  • Experience developing, deploying, and running distributed applications on cloud platforms; experience with container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Comfortable owning on-call across a multi-tool observability stack, including leading Sev 1/2 incident response


Nice to have


  • Experience evaluating and prototyping alternative Observability platforms, both commercial and open-source
  • Experience with other Observability tooling like Grafana, Cortex, ElasticSearch, DataDog, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir

title: Machine Learning Engineer 3
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.

In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.

The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.

  • Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.

  • Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).

  • Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.

  • Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.

  • Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.

  • Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.

  • 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.

  • Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

title: Head of Copy, Adobe Creative
descriptionHtml:
Our Company 

Empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences. 

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.   

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI. 

Our Team 

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.  

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency. 

The Opportunity 

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own writing and storytelling should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Copy to define the copywriting and narrative standard for Adobe Creative’s campaign and creative work, and to build the copywriting practice, teams and culture that bring that voice to life. You will lead language and narrative across Adobe Creative’s output, from campaign platforms and multi-platform storytelling to digital experiences, product narratives, brand films, and live moments. 

This is not simply a role responsible for reviewing copy or maintaining tone of voice. You will build a world-class internal copywriting practice designed for how brands communicate today: a versatile team able to move from hero campaign spots to scalable copy systems across audiences, channels, and markets. 

Working upstream, you will establish the verbal principles, frameworks, and working practices that help Adobe Creative find stronger stories and language earlier in the process. You will translate them into tools, systems, and AI-enabled workflows that can also create leverage beyond Adobe Creative through shared guidance, consultation and collaboration with teams across C&C, Adobe, and our agency partners. 

The Head of Copy drives Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system. You own the copywriting practice and creative writing standard across Adobe Creative’s work, partnering closely with Brand on how Adobe’s verbal identity is expressed through campaigns and creative. 

You are a writer first. You still find the line, rewrite the script, and shape the story. Your authority comes from your creative judgment, your cultural intelligence, and your ability to make writing better. 

What You'll Do 

Set the Standard and Build the Practice 

  • Define and hold the copywriting and narrative standard across Adobe Creative. 

  • Establish a clear point of view on world-class copywriting in the age of AI. 

  • Build shared principles for narrative, scripts, headlines and platform-native language, partnering with Brand on voice and naming. 

  • Ensure Adobe's voice feels connected and recognizably Adobe without becoming corporate, repetitive or predictable. 

  • Build frameworks, tools, and working practices that involve copywriters from the start rather than at the end. 

  • Partner with internal teams to document and encode craft into systems that support speed and scale. 

Lead Writing Across the Work 

  • Lead copywriting and narrative from early creative development through final execution. 

  • Shape Adobe's most visible global campaigns, product launches, and high-velocity work from Adobe Creative. 

  • Partner with the Head of Campaigns to create campaign platforms, headlines, scripts, and integrated language systems. 

  • Partner with the Head of Design to develop visual and verbal expressions as one connected creative system. 

  • Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s verbal identity, naming principles, nomenclature, and tone of voice into distinctive creative expression across Adobe Creative’s work. 

  • Ensure strong ideas can move across channels, formats and audiences without losing their clarity, humanity or impact. 

  • Direct agency copywriters, brand film screenwriters, and specialist collaborators from a clear internal Adobe point of view. 

  • Hold externally produced copywriting commissioned by Adobe Creative to the same standard as internal creative. 

Build a World-Class Writing Community 

  • Build and lead a multidisciplinary team of campaign, brand, and multi-platform copywriters. 

  • Build a strong leadership bench and clear pathways for copywriters to grow into creative direction and leadership roles. 

  • Recruit exceptional copywriters with diverse perspectives, distinctive voices, and strong creative judgment. 

  • Create a culture of direct feedback, high standards, experimentation, generosity, and continuous learning. 

  • Keep senior writing leaders close to the work and protect meaningful time for writing. 

  • Use flexible copywriters’ rooms within Adobe Creative for major campaigns and priority creative opportunities, bringing in partners from across C&C, Product and other teams when useful. 

  • Build relationships with writers across the organization, so language, tools, and creative learning are shared. 

Advance AI-Native Writing 

  • Define Adobe Creative's point of view on how AI changes writing, editing, authorship and creative development. 

  • Build AI-native workflows that expand creative exploration without reducing writing to generated volume. 

  • Establish principles for evaluating AI-assisted writing through originality, accuracy, voice, intention, and cultural intelligence. 

  • Define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and creative judgment remain essential. 

  • Partner with Product as a creative customer zero, testing emerging language capabilities through real work. 

  • Ensure teams understand responsible AI, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials. 

Represent Writing Across Adobe 

  • Represent Adobe Creative’s copywriting, voice, and narrative in executive and cross-functional forums. 

  • Translate narrative and language decisions into clear, actionable choices. 

  • Advocate for Adobe Creative’s writers to be involved earlier in brand, product and creative development. 

  • Connect exceptional copywriting to audience understanding, emotional impact, brand distinction and business value. 

  • Present work with clarity, confidence, and conviction. 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • 15+ years of experience in copywriting, narrative, or multidisciplinary creative leadership. 

  • A world-class portfolio spanning campaigns, multi-platform copywriting, brand voice, product storytelling, and experiences. 

  • Significant experience as an Executive Creative Director, Global Head of Copy, Creative Director, Head Writer or equivalent. 

  • Meaningful industry recognition through Cannes Lions, D&AD, The One Show, Clios or equivalent. 

  • A track record of building language and narratives for iconic global brands. 

  • Experience building and leading writing teams, not simply reviewing copy. 

  • Experience creating writers' rooms or collaborative writing models. 

  • Exceptional creative judgment and the ability to explain clearly why writing succeeds or falls short. 

  • The ability to move confidently between a headline, a script, a multi-platform response, a product story, and a verbal system. 

  • Experience developing brand voice, naming, nomenclature, and narrative frameworks. 

  • Experience directing agencies, campaign screenwriters, and specialist collaborators. 

  • Deep fluency with AI-enabled writing and creative development workflows. 

  • A clear point of view on how AI changes writing practice, authorship and creative scale. 

  • A commanding presenter who can communicate the value of language and narrative to senior executives. 

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, entertainment, technology, media, and creator communities. 

  • A track record of building multidisciplinary teams, developing future writing leaders and maintaining a high standard through speed, ambiguity and change.

The Opportunity  

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own creative work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Design to define design excellence for Adobe and build the practice, systems and culture that bring it to life across everything we create. 

You will lead design across our creative, content and experiences, from high-velocity everyday work to major global campaigns, product launches and Adobe’s most visible moments. You will raise the quality of the work at every scale, creating greater coherence without making it repetitive or predictable. 

Working upstream, you will establish the principles, frameworks, and practices that help teams make stronger design decisions earlier. You will translate them into tools, templates, and AI-enabled workflows that help internal teams and external partners deliver exceptional work at scale. 

The Head of Brand owns Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system. You own the design practice and creative expression across the work, ensuring the brand is interpreted and brought to life with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination. 

Design leadership at Adobe extends beyond traditional graphic design. It includes typography, image-making, art direction, motion, digital behavior, spatial experience, editorial thinking, emerging technology, and the creative use of AI. 

You are a maker first. You remain close to the tools, the teams, and the work. Your authority comes from your eyes, your judgment, and your ability to make the work better. 

What You’ll Do 

Set the Standard and Build the Practice 

  • Define and hold the design craft standard across Adobe Creative.  

  • Establish a clear point of view on world-class design in the age of AI.  

  • Build shared principles for typography, image-making, art direction, motion, interaction and emerging visual practices.  

  • Raise the design standard across everything we make, from high-velocity work to our most visible global moments.  

  • Ensure the work feels connected and recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.  

  • Build frameworks, tools, and working practices that enable strong design decisions from the start.  

  • Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s identity system into distinctive and adaptable creative expression.  

  • Partner with Production, Operations and Creative Technology to protect craft while supporting speed and scale.  

Lead Design Across the Work 

  • Lead design from early creative development through final execution.  

  • Set the art direction and design craft across Adobe’s creative, content and experiences.  

  • Shape Adobe’s most visible global campaigns, product launches, cultural moments and live experiences.  

  • Ensure strong ideas scale across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.  

  • Partner with the Head of Campaigns to turn breakthrough ideas into compelling visual worlds.  

  • Partner with the Head of Copy to develop visual and verbal expression as one connected creative system.  

  • Direct agencies, design studios and specialist collaborators from a clear internal Adobe point of view.  

  • Hold externally produced work to the same standard as internal creative.  

Cultivate a world-Class community of Designers 

  • Lead and develop Creative Directors, Associate Creative Directors, Art Directors, and Designers.  

  • Build a strong leadership bench and clear pathways for makers to grow.  

  • Recruit exceptional designers with diverse perspectives, multidisciplinary skills, and a deep commitment to craft.  

  • Create a culture of direct feedback, high standards, experimentation, generosity, and continuous learning.  

  • Keep senior design leaders close to the work and protect meaningful time for making.  

  • Build flexible teams around the creative opportunity rather than fixed structures.  

  • Connect designers across the organization, so knowledge, tools, and creative learning are shared.  

Advance AI-Native Design 

  • Define Adobe Creative’s point of view on how AI changes design practice, craft and authorship.  

  • Build AI-native workflows that expand creative possibility and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.  

  • Establish principles for evaluating AI-assisted work through originality, intention, taste, craft and brand distinction.  

  • Define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and judgment remain essential.  

  • Partner with Product as a creative customer zero, testing emerging capabilities through real work and translating learning into useful feedback.  

  • Ensure teams understand responsible AI, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.  

Represent Design Across Adobe 

  • Represent design in executive and cross-functional forums.  

  • Translate creative direction and craft decisions into clear, actionable choices.  

  • Advocate for design to be involved earlier in strategic, product and creative development.  

  • Connect design excellence to audience impact, brand distinction and business value.  

  • Present work with clarity, confidence, and conviction. 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • 15+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative leadership. 

  • A world-class portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across creative, content and experiences. 

  • Significant experience as a senior design leader, Executive Creative Director, Design Director or equivalent. 

  • Meaningful industry recognition through D&AD, Cannes Lions, The One Show, ADC, AIGA or equivalent. 

  • Experience leading design across both high-velocity output and major flagship work. 

  • A track record of building design practices, systems and teams, not only reviewing finished work. 

  • Exceptional taste and the ability to explain clearly why work succeeds or falls short. 

  • Deep expertise in typography, art direction and image-making, with strong fluency across motion, digital, spatial, editorial and emerging design practices. 

  • Experience translating brand systems into distinctive and evolving creative expression. 

  • Experience directing agencies, design studios, and specialist partners. 

  • Deep fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and generative AI workflows. 

  • A clear point of view on how AI changes design practice, authorship and creative scale. 

  • A commanding presenter who can communicate the value of design to senior executives. 

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, technology, art, fashion, entertainment and creator communities. 

  • A track record of building multidisciplinary teams, developing future leaders and maintaining a high standard through speed, ambiguity and change.

title: Senior Product Manager, Privacy Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager, Privacy Engineering

The Opportunity

Privacy is changing quickly. People are more aware of their privacy rights and want more control over their data, especially as AI has become part of our everyday work. Regulations are also evolving rapidly across many regions. These changes matter to Adobe as the company expands across consumer, professional, and enterprise markets worldwide. We are looking for a collaborative and innovative Lead Product Manager to guide the strategy and execution of our vision for experiential privacy. In this role, you will help manage privacy risks, identify new opportunities, and build transparent, user-centered solutions that support Adobe’s values and business goals.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will need to think strategically, influence others, and work closely with teams across Adobe, including Creativity & Productivity, Customer Experience Orchestration, Adobe Unified Platform Engineering, Digital Employee Experience, and Legal. To succeed, you are comfortable with change, act with urgency, take ownership, and deliver results while partnering with multiple teams and managing competing priorities.

What You'll Do

  • Understand needs around data protection and privacy compliance in our products, services and platforms.
  • Translate customer, business, and legal needs into clear requirements and engage with engineering teams to deliver outstanding solutions users trust with their data.
  • Help build features, capabilities, and tools composed to keep user and company data protected while offering transparency around how our company processes data.
  • Collaborate with experience design teams driving the creation of mockups and review user interface designs to help ensure all privacy controls are implemented in accordance with privacy policies and requirements.
  • Build, document and communicate key use cases as the basis for comprehensive, end-to-end features and user acceptance testing for privacy requirements and solutions.
  • Build privacy success metrics/criteria and supervise performance
  • Partner with legal to assist in the review of privacy impact assessments for different platforms, products, tools, and services.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations for higher-level management including Directors, VPs and Senior Leaders with progress, risks and opportunities for privacy-focused capabilities and processes.
  • Act as an advocate and evangelist for privacy and data protection, leading internal training and building awareness.

What is Needed to Succeed

  • 5+ years of relevant product management experience in either commercial or well-defined internal-facing products.
  • Understanding of technical environments, market dynamics and trends.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with AI technologies, models, tools, and applied agentic use cases.
  • Solid understanding of data platforms (e.g., data lakes and data farms), privacy enhancement technologies, and various industry frameworks geared around data privacy (e.g., IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform, etc.)
  • Strong product management thinking with a dedication to nail the “What and Why” before jumping into solutioning.
  • Proven track record in highly cross-functional projects, working with product and technical teams with multiple priorities.
  • Business-savvy teammate who can think out of the box, with a keen ability for switching between tactical execution to critical thinking!
  • Persistent appetite to learn quickly with a highly curious, problem-solving focused mind.
  • Exceptional communication skills with a phenomenal sense of humor and dedication to integrity.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field, electrical engineering, computer science or equivalent
  • Certified Information Privacy Technology credential is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
The opportunity


Join Adobe's Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RTCDP) organization and help businesses unify and activate customer data across channels. As an RTCDP Software Engineer, you will combine software engineering, analytical problem solving, and a customer-focused mindset to improve platform reliability and customer outcomes.


You will investigate complex platform and customer issues, develop internal tools and automation, and collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Support to turn recurring challenges into lasting improvements. You will use AI-assisted development thoughtfully, maintaining ownership of the quality, correctness, and reliability of your work.


What you'll do


  • Investigate and resolve complex RTCDP product and customer issues, identifying root causes and working with engineering teams on durable solutions.
  • Understand end-to-end RTCDP business flows and develop tools, scripts, and automation that improve diagnostics, observability, and issue prevention.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Support to prioritize customer-impacting problems and translate recurring issues into product improvements.
  • Develop and maintain reliable software and integrations, applying sound engineering practices to implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.
  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities and implementation decisions, explaining complex topics clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Document investigation findings and reusable solutions, and share knowledge that improves team effectiveness.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development tools to support implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review; validate generated outputs and retain responsibility for engineering decisions.
  • Evaluate where AI-assisted workflows add value, recognize their limitations, and apply appropriate human review and safeguards for sensitive information.

What you need to succeed


Software engineering and platform skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • • 5+ years of software development experience, including work on complex applications or platforms.
  • Strong programming experience in Java and/or Python.
  • Experience with SQL, NoSQL technologies, and data modeling.
  • Experience with big-data technologies and analytical workflows, including Apache Spark and Jupyter or Databricks notebooks.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, OAuth, and system integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud and distributed systems, including AWS and/or Azure, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk or ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana to investigate platform behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect technical findings to customer and business impact.
  • Clear communication and effective cross-functional collaboration, including the ability to explain technical issues to different audiences.
  • A proactive approach to ownership, continuous learning, and understanding enterprise products.


AI-assisted engineering skills

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted software development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent, to write, test, and debug code within established engineering standards.
  • Ability to provide clear instructions and relevant context to AI tools, review and test generated code, and recognize incorrect, incomplete, or unsupported outputs.
  • Ability to explain your own reasoning and engineering decisions, using AI as a supporting tool rather than a substitute for technical understanding.
  • Ability to evaluate the benefits and limitations of AI tools in real engineering workflows and describe how they improve productivity or quality.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate. 

The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion. 

This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives

  • Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes 

  • Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation 

  • Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems 

  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion 

  • Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution 

  • Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap 

  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion 

What Succes Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show: 

  • Customer-to-Solution Thinking — you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability 

  • Architecture with Execution — you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them 

  • Production Awareness — you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts 

  • Enterprise Navigation — you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility 

  • AI-Augmented Execution — you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver 

  • Adaptability Under Ambiguity — you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty 

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years. 

Your Domain 

  • AEP / RTCDP / AJO: Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation 

  • Enterprise Architecture: Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes 

  • Security & Compliance: Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR 

  • Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking 

  • Data Platforms: Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes 

  • Observability: Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring 

What We Value 

Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate: 

  • Agency - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution 

  • Product Judgment - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build 

  • Customer Empathy -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them 

  • Builder Mindset - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT 

Nice to Have :

title: Sr. Director, Engineering, Adobe Intelligence Platform
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe Intelligence Platform is the foundational AI infrastructure that powers agentic experiences across the Adobe product portfolio. The platform enables interoperability of agents, capabilities, and workflows across the Adobe Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Document Clouds, and future product lines. It is transforming Adobe from a suite of best-in-class tools into a unified, AI-native ecosystem. 

This platform encompasses agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, skill and capability catalogs, and the planning and reasoning layers that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows at enterprise scale. 

We are seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to own the engineering vision and execution of building the Adobe Intelligence Platform. This is a pivotal role to invent, embed, and scale the latest in AI innovation into Adobe’s products. This role is highly visible and key to executing Adobe’s vision to transform the way creators and their teams work and create. 

What you will do

  • Define and drive a holistic and full stack engineering strategy for the Adobe Intelligence Platform. 

  • Integrate platform components into web, desktop, and mobile surfaces, partnering with global teams to accelerate their timelines and unify the customer experience. 

  • Grow the organization, including hiring world-class talent, structuring teams, and developing the next generation of AI leaders within Adobe. 

  • Model and drive a new way of working, using the latest AI tooling to plan, review, and ship software. 

  • Own the technology strategy, pairing with senior architects, to define the roadmaps for agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, agentic harnesses, and skill catalogs. 

  • Set and run the operating rhythm with program and product partners: planning, prioritization, cross-team dependencies, and how the org measures its own progress. 

  • Partner with Research and Design to shape the future of applied AI by shortening the loop from cutting edge to production. 

  • Partner with Engineering, Program and Product leaders across the organization to understand their local needs and drive adoption of the AIP platform across Adobe. 

  • Align with Security, Privacy and Legal colleagues to ensure the platform has observability, security, and enterprise governance controls around safety and trust built into the end-to-end architecture. 

  • Define the adoption strategy and own the outcome for partnerships internally: ensure Adobe Intelligence Platform is serving the needs of application teams at all levels and across Adobe’s 3 cloud offering areas. 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

  • 12+ years of engineering experience, including significant time leading engineering organizations through ambiguity and change. 

  • Direct experience with platform or infrastructure work: building the layer other engineering teams depend on. 

  • Working fluency in AI/ML systems: evals, context management, model gateways, and adjacent areas. 

  • Technical depth with agentic frameworks and the operational patterns to manage them at scale. 

  • A track record of building or substantially reshaping an engineering org, including hiring, structuring teams, and developing leaders under them. 

  • Comfortable influencing progress with a platform in a shifting technical landscape. 

  • Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive adoption of a platform across global teams. 

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to inspire teams and express a compelling vision.

title: Senior Legal Counsel- Privacy
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

We're looking for great legal minds to help us build and drive the debate on privacy, marketing and advertising technology, big data, and AI. This is your chance to work for a global brand with an unparalleled culture where privacy really matters. This role will support Adobe’s CX Enterprise product portfolio.  

What you'll Do 

  • Collaborate with Product Legal, Engineering, Product, Security, and Marketing teams to guide the creation and application of Privacy-By-Design strategies for digital marketing products and technologies to manage privacy and security risks while fostering product innovation. 

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to business leaders to help make privacy a competitive differentiator for Adobe. 

  • Develop, apply, and evaluate privacy impact assessments for Adobe products and technologies, including new AI initiatives. Lead projects to simplify and improve the privacy assessment process. 

  • Support Sales Legal and other legal teams on privacy negotiations with customers, partners, and vendors. Provide regular training, develop privacy templates and playbooks, and offer direct support for strategic deals. Identify and lead efforts to simplify privacy negotiations. 

  • Be a privacy brand ambassador on enterprise customer calls and in meetings with external collaborators. 

  • Be a privacy evangelist inside Adobe to help grow our culture of privacy (e.g., conduct trainings, represent the privacy team in product strategy and development sessions). 

  • Assist with evaluating and implementing global self-regulatory and digital marketing requirements (e.g., NAI, DAA). 

What you need to succeed 

  • J.D. degree and membership in at least one state bar. 

  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant privacy experience, including prior in-house or law firm experience. 

  • Strong interest in privacy law. 

  • Proven experience in the technical components of digital marketing products and technologies. 

  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization. 

  • Strategic problem solver with excellent legal and business judgment. 

  • A meticulous, business-friendly teammate who can think creatively. 

  • Strong understanding and experience with both domestic and international privacy requirements.

title: Manager, Federal Government Relations (Legislative Branch)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

Our goal is to recruit top talent, and we are committed to building outstanding employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can arise from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity

The Adobe Government Relations and Public Affairs team seeks an innovative and well-connected federal government relations professional. The role offers a dynamic and enjoyable work environment. If you enjoy helping others achieve their goals, building an extensive network of relationships inside the U.S. legislative branch, advocating for a cause, and building consensus with other like-minded organizations, this position may be for you. A successful candidate will have knowledge of technology policy, federal appropriations, and federal agency IT budgeting and modernization processes. This role requires excellent communication and writing ability, high energy, and a curiosity about the constantly evolving technology policy, artificial intelligence, and the government IT modernization space.

The position reports to the Director of U.S. Federal Government Relations (U.S. Legislative Branch) in Adobe’s Washington, DC office.

What you'll Do

  • Serve as a key liaison between Adobe business leadership and U.S. congressional offices (House & Senate), driving impactful policy and business engagements.

  • Advocate for innovative technology policy solutions across the U.S. Legislative Branch in areas such as artificial intelligence, creators’ rights, consumer protection, and federal IT modernization.

  • Partner with US federal executive branch government relations team to assist in developing and advancing government relations advocacy objectives and public policy priorities.

  • Coordinate with the U.S. public sector sales team to promote essential US federal agency business aims. Aid in advancing federal budget and appropriations initiatives. Assist in coordinating and managing all components of the Public Sector Advisory Board.

  • Attend congressional hearings, government-industry events, and trade association meetings and report back to the business;

  • Build and manage advocacy efforts through active engagement with Congress, trade associations, consultants, and industry peers.

  • Assist in advocating for federal procurement and digital government policies that improve the customer experience and the digital service delivery provided by government.

What you need to succeed

  • 5 -10 years of proven experience.

  • Experience working with or within the U.S. executive and legislative branches of government.

  • Experience with technology and artificial intelligence policy and the federal appropriations process.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills – both written and oral.

  • Proficient in using artificial intelligence tools and MS PowerPoint to develop presentations and strategy documents for public affairs. Skilled at employing MS Excel, Word, and Adobe Acrobat to manage team tasks and write policy papers.

  • Interest in evangelizing responsible AI, content authenticity, and federal digital government policy issues.

  • Ability to think and act both strategically and creatively.

  • Strong program and project management skills to leverage in managing the advisory board for the government sector business.

  • Strong self-starter who is a phenomenal teammate and excels developing and completing their own work plan.

  • Ability to take complicated technical concepts and translate in a compelling and succinct manner on paper and in-person.

  • Knowledge of federal government agencies’ structure and functions.

  • Must be willing to register as a Federal Lobbyist.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Passionate about government service and the role of government in society.

  • Strong desire for success

Adobe's Legal & Government Relations (LGR) group is seeking a strategic and innovative Senior Manager, Legal Operations.

This highly visible, cross-functional leadership role is responsible for overseeing outside counsel and vendor management, legal spend and financial operations, operational intelligence, and core business operations. title: Senior Media Planner
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Ready to build the media planning playbook for one of the world's most recognized brands? Adobe is establishing a new in-house media planning function to take direct ownership of end-to-end media buying and develop an AI-driven engine for global advertising execution. As Senior Media Planner, this role will translate regional media strategy into tactical media plans for one or more paid channels — starting with Meta, TikTok, and Snap — converting strategy into plans the buy desk can implement directly. It's an early opportunity to help shape how Adobe plans and buys media for years to come!

What the Role Does

This role sits between the media strategy teams and the buy desk, making sure every plan is platform-native and ready to execute! The Senior Media Planner builds tactical plans for assigned channels — audience targeting, budget splits, flighting, and placement — based on regional media strategy, and stays in daily contact with the local strategy team to maintain alignment. Keeping pace with platforms that change their ad products and targeting tools every quarter takes staying current and applying that knowledge consistently across every plan.

Finished plans get handed to Adobe's India-based media-buying team for execution. This role flags blockers and resolves them against the team's established process. Where it fits, Adobe's own marketing technology — GenPem, AEP, RTCDP — gets built into the plan, putting Adobe's platforms to work on its own advertising. Before anything moves to the buy desk, campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked against Ops standards, with local nuance (language, regulatory, pricing) layered on top of consistent global planning practices.

This role will also partner with regional strategists and analysts to review campaign reporting and translate results into optimizations: budget shifts, targeting changes, and creative refreshes for their channel(s). Performance trends, platform changes, and new targeting or data-sharing opportunities get surfaced back to the Director of Media Planning and the broader team. The role also helps shape a consistent quarterly planning process and works directly with platform partners to identify testing and beta opportunities each cycle.

Scope & Reporting

This is an individual contributor role, one of a global team of seven Media Planners reporting to the US-based Director of Media Planning. The role works closely with, but does not manage, the India-based buy desk, analytics, media strategy, and engineering partners. Initial focus is paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap), with scope expected to grow over time.

First 90 Days

During the first quarter, the goal is to ramp fast and build trust. Become proficient in Adobe's audience segments, brand guidelines, and channel mix, and work on building relationships with regional strategists regarding media objectives and planning cadence. Complete the buy desk handoff process for at least one full plan submission. You will audit current tagging, naming, and QC practices against new Ops standards. You will establish a regular cadence with regional strategy counterparts and the India-based buying team.

What's Needed to Succeed

  • 5+ years in digital advertising or media planning/buying, with hands-on experience in at least one of Meta, TikTok, or Snap
  • Strong working knowledge of platform ad managers, audience targeting tools, and campaign measurement
  • Experience managing multi-market activations, including platform setup across a wide range of markets and languages
  • A track record of delivering performance-focused paid social campaigns
  • Comfort reading campaign dashboards and working with analysts to shape concrete optimization recommendations
  • Ability to translate strategic briefs into detailed, executable media plans
  • Clear communication across regional and offshore teams, holding to global standards while adapting to local needs
  • Strong attention to detail — comfortable owning QA, QC, and documentation for assigned plans
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI-driven media buying, including executing buys through LLM-based tools like Meta's MCP
  • Experience with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP)
  • Experience working with an offshore or outsourced buying/execution team
  • Background spanning both B2B and consumer advertising
  • Agency experience, or exposure to a newly formed team — ideally at a company insourcing media execution

title: Staff Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

At Adobe, securing the future of creativity is our mission. Our customers rely on our products every day to transform ideas into reality, and Adobe's security organization has built world-class security capabilities to protect that trust. The challenge is ensuring that expertise continuously develops the products and platforms our customers depend on.

We seek a Staff Product Security Engineer to act as a Security Partner for our most valuable products. In this position, you will develop deep product and business insight. You will analyze signals from the security ecosystem and focus them into a few clear priorities. You will convert security capabilities into practical guidance that product and engineering teams can follow. You will operate with significant autonomy, own the security narrative for your portfolio end to end, and grow your influence across the Security organization and the product teams you partner with. This is an outstanding chance to create a meaningful impact!

What you'll Do

  • Serve as the single point of contact for a portfolio of Adobe's most complex and highest-value products, owning evaluation and communication of the product's security posture.

  • Build and maintain deep context on each product's architecture, roadmap, and business drivers. Partner with your Technical Security Portfolio Manager (TSPM) to track assets, ownership, and open findings. Stay focused on the highest-leverage decisions!

  • Lead security design reviews and threat modeling for major releases, platform-level development, and new products or services, identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing security gaps across architecture, trust boundaries, data flows, and threat actor behavior.

  • Synthesize security signals, including threat models, vulnerability findings, and customer-identified concerns, into a curated set of top security priorities per product.

  • Direct the security activities needed for a successful release. These include threat modeling, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, and paved-road onboarding. Integrate security into the existing release readiness process instead of treating it as a final gate.

  • Identify systemic risk patterns across your portfolio, build mitigations, paved roads, and reusable security frameworks that address whole classes of risk at scale.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers on your team. Share knowledge beyond your portfolio through tech talks, blogs, white papers, and conferences.

  • Contribute to the Security organization's roadmap through research and proof-of-concepts, and share expertise on emerging threats in AI/ML and agentic systems.

What you need to succeed

  • 10+ years in Application or Product Security and a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • A demonstrable history of building end-to-end security solutions that were adopted across multiple engineering teams, and of translating product context into prioritized, actionable security guidance.

  • Proven ability to threat model complex, distributed, and AI/ML systems, and to make and defend risk-based decisions under uncertainty.

  • Solid knowledge of application architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and secure SDLC practices.

  • Broad knowledge of vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS) and authentication mechanisms (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, zero-trust).

  • A background in security code review across multiple languages and stacks.

  • Hands-on experience with standard security tooling (Burp Suite, Kali Linux) and the ability to build or customize tools when needed.

  • A track record of external technical communication, alongside clear and confident communication with senior leadership and non-technical audiences.

  • A collaborative approach to working across globally distributed teams and a genuine interest in helping developers ship features securely.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Senior Product Security Engineer

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about product security testing and vulnerability management? Adobe Product and Software Security is seeking a dynamic candidate with strong security testing expertise to join our expanding team. In this role, you will be the frontline responder for external vulnerability reports submitted through the Bug Bounty program, working closely with internal engineering and security teams to ensure timely, accurate triage and resolution, managing automation workflows, supporting live hacking events, campaigns, challenges.

This is a great opportunity to contribute to innovative work that will elevate Adobe Security to new heights!

What You'll Do

  • Triage, validate and reproduce incoming vulnerability reports submitted via the bug bounty platform, assessing validity, impact, and scope, including AI related reports.
  • Assign CVSS scores and severity ratings accurately, following Adobe’s internal severity guidelines and industry standards.
  • Reproduce proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to validate reported vulnerabilities across web, API, and mobile surfaces.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with external researchers: request clarifications, provide status updates, and manage expectations.
  • Coordinate with product engineering teams to route confirmed vulnerabilities for remediation.
  • Identify duplicate, out-of-scope, or informational reports and close them with clear, respectful explanations.
  • Contribute to internal documentation, triage runbooks, and severity calibration guidelines.
  • Flag systemic or critical findings to Bug Bounty team for partner concern as needed.
  • Develop dashboards in PowerBI to support data-driven analysis and remediation efforts.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of practical experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) and mitigation techniques.
  • Strong understanding of CVSS v3.1 scoring and hands-on experience applying it to real-world vulnerabilities.
  • Proficiency in common web vulnerability classes: XSS, SQL injection, SSRF, IDOR, authentication flaws, and business logic issues.
  • Ability to reproduce and validate PoC exploits using tools such as Burp Suite, browser DevTools, curl, and custom scripts.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty platforms and responsible disclosure processes.
  • Solid written communication skills — able to write clear, constructive responses to researchers of all skill levels.
  • Familiarity with attacker techniques used by external researchers against LLM systems and generative AI products.
  • Proficiency with JIRA and PowerBI.
  • Strong knowledge of LLM (Large Language Model) testing methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience in penetration testing of AI/ML and LLM-powered products, including chat interfaces, agentic workflows, and inference APIs.
  • Ability to design and complete AI-specific test cases.
  • Experience with attacker techniques used by external researchers against LLM systems and generative AI products.
  • Experience with a SOAR/orchestration platform (building or extending app connectors and playbooks, understanding action-based automation models)
  • API integration literacy (can read a vendor's REST API docs or an OpenAPI/Swagger spec and correctly implement authentication (OAuth2, bearer tokens, API keys), pagination, and error handling)
  • Scripting proficiency in Python (comfortable writing and maintaining small, production-quality integration code)
  • Event-driven automation (hands-on experience with webhooks, AWS Lambda, and API Gateway, turning real-time platform events into automated downstream actions)
  • Dependability: Demonstrates commitment, works independently, accepts accountability, adapts to change, sets personal standards, and remains focused under pressure.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and effectively.

title: Manager, Corporate Development (M&A Integration)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Corporate Development Integration (CDI) team in Adobe’s Corporate Development organization consist of a multifaceted core group of professionals responsible for pre-merger operational diligence, integration strategy and post-merger integration planning and execution. We will collaborate with Adobe’s senior executives and business unit leaders throughout the phases of the acquisition life-cycle to ensure a smooth transition of the acquired company into Adobe’s ecosystem.

We’re looking for an experienced individual who excels in partnering cross-functionally and influencing in a multifaceted, fast-paced environment. This individual is operationally focused and commercially experienced, with the skill to simultaneously drive integration efforts while ensuring acquisition targets meet/exceed deal value drivers.

The Challenge

  • Provide support to the acquisitions team within corporate development prior to close
  • Serve as active participant in diligence of target company to lead the evaluation of key issues, to assess integration challenges and to develop post-close plans
  • Partner with executives and function leaders to craft integration strategies that closely align with acquisition rationale and operating model!
  • Drive timely and objective decision-making with sound advice and good judgment to sustain the pace of integration and maintain alignment with the deal rationale
  • Document detailed integration planning with activities, timelines, resources, and costs required to achieve deal specific value drivers
  • Develop and measure specific financial measures and leading indicators throughout the integration/transition period to measure success of the integration
  • Present regular integration updates and ensure Adobe senior leadership is aware of critical issues/risks and drive them to resolution with constant and consistent objectivity
  • Build, empower, and encourage cross-functional teams that partner with leaders to successfully plan and complete integration roadmap
  • Own integration governance and manage decisions and progress reports for Integration team

What is needed to succeed

  • Undergraduate / Graduate degree, preferably MBA, or equivalent working experience
  • 5+ years M&A Integration experience in the industry or in consulting
  • Strong business acuity with experience in a SaaS environment; prior understanding of digital/consumer internet, digital marketing or digital advertising highly desired
  • Knowledge of end-to-end corporate development activities
  • Experience in pre and post-acquisition integration activities in technology companies
  • Exceptional program management skills with demonstrated capability in sophisticated and ambiguous environments
  • High level of operational focus, strong analytical skill, rigor and attention to details
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Expert in M&A tools, data rooms, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint
