title: Sr. Manager, Cyber Threat Research & Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
The Challenge

As the Senior Manager of the Cyber Threat Research & Intelligence team, you will guide Adobe's efforts to predict, identify, and respond to the changing threat environment. Your position is key to delivering high-quality intelligence at tactical, operational, and strategic levels. This intelligence helps Adobe's security teams and executive leaders make informed, proactive decisions. You will develop and enhance a leading threat research and intelligence program that transforms raw threat data into actionable insights. This program supports defenses based on adversary behavior and keeps Adobe ahead of advanced threat actors.

This is an opportunity to lead with purpose, build Adobe's intelligence strategy, and make a measurable impact on how the organization understands and responds to important threats.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and take responsibility for the strategic vision of Adobe's Cyber Threat Research & Intelligence program, covering tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence pillars.
  • Lead a senior team of threat intelligence researchers, balancing deep technical research with timely intelligence production and collaborator engagement.
  • Coordinate the full intelligence lifecycle — from collection and processing to analysis, production, and dissemination — ensuring intelligence outputs are relevant, accurate, timely, and actionable.
  • Build and manage Adobe's threat actor tracking program, maintaining profiles on advanced persistent threat (APT) groups, cyber criminal organizations, and hacktivists relevant to Adobe's industry and attack surface.
  • Produce and deliver intelligence products at multiple levels: tactical reports (IOCs, TTPs, YARA/Sigma rules), operational assessments (campaign analysis, actor attribution), and strategic briefings (threat landscape, industry trends, geopolitical risk).
  • Partner closely with Cyber Threat Hunt, CSIRT, Detection Engineering, and Red Team to ensure intelligence directly informs defensive operations, detection development, and incident response.
  • Drive Adobe's engagement with external intelligence communities, ISACs, government partners, and commercial threat intelligence providers to improve collection coverage and sharing.
  • Build a high-performing team through coaching, career development, and technical mentorship, while encouraging a collaborative and inclusive environment that promotes intellectual rigor and continuous learning!
  • Regularly brief senior leadership and key collaborators on the threat landscape, emerging risks, and intelligence program outcomes.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 8+ years in cybersecurity, with experience leading threat intelligence or threat research functions.
  • Deep expertise across the intelligence lifecycle, including collection management, all-source analysis, and structured analytic techniques (ACH, Kill Chain, Diamond Model, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Established background in developing and presenting tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence reports to technical and executive viewers.
  • Strong understanding of threat actor ecosystems — including nation-state groups, eCrime actors, and insider threats — and the tradecraft used to track and attribute them.
  • Experience operationalizing threat intelligence through SIEM, SOAR, and TIP integrations, and converting intelligence into detection logic and defensive controls.
  • Familiarity with a broad range of collection sources including OSINT, dark web monitoring, malware analysis outputs, and commercial intelligence feeds.
  • Demonstrated success in building partnerships across security, engineering, legal, and business teams, and with external government and industry partners.
  • Ability to distill complex threat analysis into clear, compelling narratives that drive executive decision-making and security investment.
  • Experience building or maturing cybersecurity programs, including intelligence requirements processes, metrics frameworks, and team operating models.

The Opportunity

Adobe's Global Marketing Finance organization is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support the Customer Marketing Group, within the Creativity & Productivity (C&P) marketing organization. descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking dedicated and curious Software Engineer interns to help design, build, and evolve the systems that power our products and platforms.  

As an intern, you’ll work in an AI-enabled development environment, where modern tools accelerate how software is built and tested. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and multi-functional partners, including designers and product managers, to contribute to real-world systems while continuing to build your technical and problem-solving skills.  

Software engineering opportunities at Adobe span a broad range of products, technologies, and technical problem spaces. Whether you're passionate about creating intuitive user experiences, building scalable systems, or solving complex engineering challenges, we'll consider your technical skills, interests, and team needs when identifying the best opportunity within our engineering organization. 

This role is designed for early-career engineers who are excited not only about writing code, but also about understanding how software works end-to-end, validating solutions, and connecting technical decisions to real user and product outcomes.

title: Group Product Design Manager, Systems
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

Do you see the design system as the engine that lets an entire design org move faster? In this role you’ll lead the team that turns craft into shared, reusable building blocks — the libraries, tokens, and components every other design team depends on, and the bridge that carries that work into code. When this team does its job well, every surface ships faster and our products feel like one Adobe.


As Group Design Manager, Systems, you’ll lead both sides of the practice: the design side — component libraries, tokens, specs, guidelines, and accessibility — and the creative-technology side — Storybook, engineering handoff, plugins, and foundations. You’ll set the strategy, grow the team, and drive adoption and education so the system is understood and used across the org, not just maintained.


Working closely with product management, engineering, and research, you’ll provide design direction, raise the quality bar, and connect the team’s work to the business decisions it’s meant to inform. You’ll turn a high-craft group into a force multiplier for everyone who builds on top of the system.


What you’ll do

  • Vision & strategy: Define and drive the direction for the design system across design and creative technology, and tie every initiative to the business or product decision it’s meant to inform.
  • Decision quality: For every initiative, clearly articulate the audience and behavior shift you’re targeting, the user value, the assertion the work tests, the metric that will move your confidence, and the decision the work informs.
  • Quality bar: Set and protect a clear standard of quality — across whether the work is useful, usable, and modern — and help the team know what level each piece of work needs to reach, from bare minimum to exceptional.
  • Team leadership & building: Act as a player-coach: delegate audit, spec, and token work across the team so delivery isn’t bottlenecked on any one person, and grow designers and technologists through coaching and clear ownership.
  • Execution & delivery: Own the design-to-code bridge end to end, keeping tokens, components, and specs moving cleanly from design into engineering, and holding the team to its schedules and quality.
  • Adoption & advocacy: Drive adoption and education across surfaces, and make the system’s value visible to leadership through clear narratives and a regular communication cadence.
  • Collaboration & influence: Partner with product management, engineering, and research on strategy, priorities, and staffing, and bring stakeholders along through high-stakes decisions.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 8+ years in design, including experience leading and growing teams — ideally in design systems, platform design, or a closely related space.
  • You live at the intersection of design and code: equally comfortable in Figma and a code editor, and able to translate designs into production-quality UI — or reverse-engineer code to inform design.
  • Strong front-end skills (TypeScript, React, CSS, animation) and the judgment to know what’s feasible, scalable, and performant.
  • A deep eye for craft and detail — you know what it takes to get a product from 90% to 100%, and you hold a pixel-perfect quality bar across implementation and interactions.
  • You think in systems and build reusable, maintainable component libraries — with tokens, variables, and accessibility baked in — that let the whole team ship faster.
  • You move fast, prototyping ideas in hours rather than days to validate concepts before full build.
  • You’re excited about AI and want to help define new interaction paradigms.
  • Strategy and product sense: you connect design craft to measurable business and customer impact, reason in assertions, evidence, and trade-offs, and frame problems before jumping to solutions.
  • A collaborative, people-first leadership style — coaching designers and engineers, influencing senior partners with clear narratives, and creating shared ownership of outcomes.
  • Nice to have: experience with developer tools or technical products, native or cross-platform UI (e.g., Electron), and an understanding of code editors and IDEs.

Why Adobe Design Systems

  • Sit at the leverage point of the whole design org — your team’s work compounds across every surface.
  • Shape the design-to-code foundation behind Adobe’s next-generation web experience.
  • Build and grow a high-craft team with real appetite for new tools and new ways of working.

About Adobe Design

Adobe Design creates tools that amplify the world’s ability to create and communicate. We’re a global team of designers, researchers, prototypers, content strategists, program managers, and more who work across Adobe’s three product lines: Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

descriptionHtml:
Group Manager, Global Customer Operations & Growth

Location: Delhi/NCR
Team Size: ~1,000 (in-house + vendor/partner)
Scope: Global Customer Base — B2C

About the Role

We're looking for a high-energy, aggressive, results-driven leader to own global customer operations for Adobe's global customer base across B2C. This role combines support, vendor management, and revenue growth — leading a large, distributed team to deliver excellent service while actively driving retention and sales outcomes. This is a scale-and-transform mandate, not a steady-state operations role.

What You'll Do

  • Own global support operations for Adobe's customers, ensuring consistent, high-quality service across all channels.
  • Drive AI-led automation and self-service to improve efficiency and reduce customer effort without compromising quality.
  • Manage a large network of vendor/partner teams, holding them accountable to SLAs, quality, and cost efficiency.
  • Lead a service+sales motion — identifying and converting upsell, cross-sell, and retention opportunities across the B2C base.

  • Lead, coach, and scale a large, multi-layered global team (in-house + vendor/partner) with an outcomes-first mindset.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

At Adobe, our mission is to empower creatives, marketers, and IT professionals with application-based products that transform their daily work and accelerate progress towards their business goals. Our Technical Pre-Sales (TPS) organization plays a critical role in preparing customers to purchase Adobe’s integrated solutions by understanding their business needs, defining and validating their technical requirements, and demonstrating their ideal future state with Adobe technology.  

Solutions Consulting (SC) is a team within the TPS group. This role will be supporting the Solutions Consulting team as an intern in TPS. 

Learn more about Solutions Consulting 

SCs act as a trusted technical advisor for prospective customers, combining technical expertise, strategic problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration to guide customers through the ways that Adobe solutions can transform their day-to-day work. Our SC team collaborates closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Enterprise Architecture teams to deliver tailored recommendations, impactful presentations, and dynamic product demos that help companies fully realize the value of Adobe solutions. 

The SC internship at Adobe provides interns with the unique opportunity to work directly with industry-leading experts on innovative Adobe solutions including Adobe’s AI and Agentic capabilities and gain hands-on experience that shapes real-world customer outcomes. You’ll build the storytelling and technical presentation skills that let an SC walk into any conversation and make Adobe’s solutions resonate with the customers in the room. By the end of the summer, you will have contributed to impactful projects while apprenticing alongside experienced SCs as they engage with clients in the field!

title: Group Manager, Product Marketing - Creative Cloud Portfolio and Monetization
descriptionHtml:
Creative Cloud is Adobe’s suite of creative tools including Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro, which are used by millions of creatives worldwide. AI is transforming how people create. There’s an opportunity to simplify our plans and packaging so customers can easily find and understand the plan that’s right for them.  

We are seeking a strategic Group Product Marketing Manager to own how Creative Cloud is packaged, new AI products get monetized, and AI features launch across Creative Cloud products. You will lead a team responsible for this work and set the direction for how it comes together. This is a horizontal role: you’ll work across Product, Finance, and Marketing teams to give Creative Cloud a single point of view on packaging, monetization, and launches. The right candidate will be comfortable with ambiguity, energized by big cross-functional problems, and confident enough to build and defend a point of view. 

What You’ll Do  

  • Develop the Creative Cloud offering strategy: Use customer and market insights to define how plans are structured and priced across the portfolio, balancing customer value with business goals.   

  • Define and oversee a testing roadmap: Build a roadmap for new packaging, pricing, and positioning concepts, and translate results into a go-to-market strategy.   

  • Drive GenAI adoption and monetization for creative professionals: Evolve Adobe's AI monetization approach for new AI-powered capabilities, including agentic. You will build product roadmaps, lead all aspects of customer-facing messaging, and track performance. 

  • Lead and develop your PMM team: Manage and grow a team of senior IC PMMs by fostering professional development, providing direction on execution, and removing roadblocks.   

  • Build cross-functional alignment: Partner with Product, Finance, Marketing, and other teams to drive initiatives forward without direct authority over them.  

 What You’ll Need to Succeed  

  • 10+ years in product marketing or a related strategy role.

  • 6+ years of experience in managing people. 

  • Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization strategy for a subscription or software business.  

  • Experience bringing new or emerging technology products to market.   

  • A track record leading cross-functional initiatives that span multiple product lines.  

  • Excellent executive communication skills and a passion for storytelling.   

  • You are data-driven, with the ability to interpret data to inform and use it to improve performance.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Marketing Finance
descriptionHtml:
POSITION SUMMARY 

Adobe's Marketing Finance organization is reinventing how it operates from the ground up, with workflow automation and AI at the center. This role makes that happen. You'll embed with our marketing finance teams, learn their craft, and design, build and maintain the tools, pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that change how they work, while shaping Adobe's IT systems to meet marketing finance needs. You'll measure yourself by one question: did I make someone’s job easier? 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Embedded Partnership & Workflow Transformation 

  • Embed with marketing finance teams to understand the real workflow, the friction, and the underlying goal, not just the surface-level ask. 
  • Rapidly prototype solutions, take immediate feedback, and iterate until the tool fits how people actually work. 
  • Train teammates to use what you built, so new solutions are adopted and become part of how the marketing finance team works. 

2. Building & Maintaining Automation, AI & Data Solutions 

  • Build, improve, and maintain the pipelines, data marts, dashboards, automation and agentic workflows that streamline spend management. 
  • Design your solutions to be scalable, reliable, and well documented. Train IT and marketing finance teammates so they can provide maintenance coverage. 
  • Test emerging AI capabilities hands-on and champion what is genuinely useful, not just what is hyped. 

3. IT Partnership & Scaling Across Finance 

  • Influence IT to improve upstream systems and data sources, to build sustainable support for marketing finance. 
  • Share what you build, reuse what others have built, and help establish the playbooks and patterns that scale good ideas across all of Finance. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 

  • 5+ years of technical experience in data engineering, business intelligence, or analytics. 
  • Expertise in Python and SQL, plus DevOps tooling such as Git, GitHub, CI/CD, and Jira. 
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, automations, or agentic systems. Familiar with evaluation of AI/ML systems. 
  • Experience translating business needs into requirements for IT or engineering teams and partnering with them to make the change. 
  • Strong communication skills, able to make technical ideas accessible to non-technical audiences at every stage of AI fluency. 
  • Genuine excitement about AI and a first instinct to get your hands on every new capability. Finance experience is not required. 
  • Preferred: experience with AI development platforms (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, agent frameworks, Azure, AWS) or building tools and playbooks that outlasted your involvement.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services, delivering robust security without degrading customer experience. It protects surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions.
As a Sr Staff Engineer on ARP, you'll set the architectural direction for risk mitigation across Adobe. You'll define the standards, patterns, and long-term technical strategy that let ARP and Adobe stay ahead of fraud and abuse as it evolves.

What you'll do

  • Architect systems built for the next three to five years of risk mitigation, while delivering impact iteratively and solving today's most important priorities along the way.
  • Push the platform to the forefront of AI and ML to strengthen fraud and abuse detection.
  • Lay the foundational building blocks of the Risk Platform that future risk-mitigation capability builds on, including the platform's shift toward event-driven, continuously-reasoning risk intelligence.
  • Set architectural standards for risk-decisioning services that other teams across Adobe adopt.
  • Share architectural thinking broadly, through design docs that become org-wide standards, white papers, tech talks, or cross-org design reviews.
  • Simplify complex, interlinked systems into designs other teams can build on with confidence.
  • Mentor senior and staff engineers across teams, growing the next generation of technical leaders.
What you need to succeed
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.
  • 12+ years architecting high-scale, highly performant platforms, and leading the technical teams that build them.
  • Deep understanding of AI and ML, both to strengthen fraud detection and to counter AI-powered attacks.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems and databases, including SQL, NoSQL, and DynamoDB-class stores.
  • Track record architecting systems with multi-year relevancy, not just solving today's scaling or reliability problem.
  • Experience with data lakes and large-scale data platforms like Databricks or Spark.
  • Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and Business Units without formal authority.
  • A track record of publishing or presenting technical work that shaped how others build.

Nice to have

  • Experience with graph databases or identity/relationship graphs applied to fraud or abuse detection (e.g., detecting rings, relay networks, or coordinated account abuse via graph traversal).
  • Device fingerprinting or AI agent design experience.
  • A payments, commerce, or fraud background.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints relevant to payments and fraud decisioning (e.g., PCI, regional payment regulations).

title: Data Scientist, Adobe.com
descriptionHtml:
About the Opportunity and Team

How do customers discover Adobe Firefly on Adobe.com? Which site experiences encourage them to try it, adopt it, and get lasting value from it?

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help us answer questions like these. We study customer behavior, test new experiences, and measure how Adobe.com contributes to Firefly adoption, engagement, and business results.

We share what we learn with Product, Marketing, Finance, Product Analytics, Engineering, and GTM so teams can make better decisions.

We also use AI and automation to reduce repetitive reporting and give analysts more time to investigate new questions. Join us and help shape how customers discover and adopt Firefly through Adobe.com!

About the Role

This is a hands-on individual contributor role responsible for leading web analytics and measurement initiatives for Adobe Firefly on Adobe.com. You will identify which web experiences influence Firefly discovery, adoption, and customer value.

You will work directly with clickstream and experimentation data, investigate questions that may not have an established analytical approach, and explain what the findings mean for the business. The role focuses on Adobe.com behavior and uses downstream customer, product, and business outcomes to evaluate the impact of web experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze how customers discover and engage with Firefly through Adobe.com. Identify performance drivers, journey friction, and changes that could improve acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
  • Answer complex business questions using Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, SQL, statistical analysis, and relevant customer, product, and business data.
  • Work with Product, Marketing, GTM, and analytics teams to develop hypotheses, shape experiments, analyze A/B tests, and turn the results into decisions.
  • Partner with team members to define critical metrics, cohorts, success criteria, and measurement approaches. Develop new approaches when direct attribution is limited or established measures do not yet exist.
  • Interpret weekly performance, investigate material changes, and respond quickly when the business needs analytical support. Present findings that inform Adobe.com priorities and decisions related to Firefly.
  • Turn successful analyses and experiments into repeatable frameworks and playbooks. Work with analytics engineering and platform teams to improve automation, reporting, and self-service

​What You Need to Succeed

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience—is required.

  • 5+ years of experience in growth analytics, web analytics, experimentation, data science, decision science, or a related field.
  • Experience analyzing customer journeys, conversion funnels, and large clickstream datasets using Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, or a comparable platform.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience using Python, R, or similar tools for statistical analysis and modeling.
  • Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, along with the judgment to work with incomplete data and questions without an established solution.
  • Ability to identify important questions, synthesize findings, communicate with senior leaders, and help teams turn analysis into decisions.

Experience with web-to-product adoption, cross-surface customer journeys, causal inference, incrementality measurement, or generative AI products is helpful but not required.

If you enjoy finding answers in complex data and helping teams decide what to do next, we’d like to hear from you!

title: Sr / Staff Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Adobe Security Engineering and help build the ML and generative AI capabilities that protect Adobe, our products, and our customers. Our team sits where cybersecurity, large-scale data, and AI meet, building models for anomaly detection, threat detection, investigation, and security analytics across some of Adobe's largest datasets.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you'll design, build, and scale production ML systems spanning deep learning, behavioral modeling, embeddings, and agentic AI. You'll write code, train models, run experiments, and help shape the architecture the broader team builds on. You'll also partner closely with data, platform, and security engineers across Adobe.

The Challenge

  • Architect end-to-end ML systems for high-volume security data, turning experiments into reusable capabilities.
  • Own the ML lifecycle, from feature engineering through training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Build LLM and agentic AI capabilities for security investigation, including retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Design evaluation frameworks that measure model quality and help analysts trust and validate results.
  • Work with data and platform engineers to scale pipelines and resolve system bottlenecks together.
  • Mentor engineers and help guide technical direction through design reviews and hands-on collaboration.

What you bring

  • Experience running production ML systems from early experimentation through sustained operation at scale.
  • A strong background training models with PyTorch and transformers, including behavioral modeling and anomaly detection.
  • Comfort with distributed compute like Spark, cloud platforms like AWS, and MLOps tools like MLflow.
  • Experience building with LLMs or generative AI, along with evaluating how they behave in production.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, and solid software engineering habits like testing and code review.
  • A collaborative approach to mentoring engineers and shaping technical direction across teams.
  • MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Background applying ML to cybersecurity, fraud, or similar adversarial problems.
  • Experience with vector databases, RAG, or multi-agent systems.
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions to ML or AI.

title: Senior Digital Manager, Creativity & Productivity
descriptionHtml:
As the expert on demand creation, acquisition, nurture and free and paid member engagement strategies within the Digital GTM Japan team, the Senior Digital Manager will drive the strategy that delivers growth and sales success for Adobe's creative and productive tools. A deep knowledge of digital marketing practices and mobile app business across customer segments will serve well as we partner with many internal Adobe teams to lead multi-functional initiatives that drive improved customer experience, increase new customer acquisition and greater customer retention.   

This team provides business critical insights using advanced analysis skills, ensures multi-functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We work cross-functionally to define our campaign and persona-level customer journey requirements across demand creation, acquisition, nurture, conversion and engagement by segment to enhance long term customer growth. Team members are highly analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done through positive relationships across the organization.

  • Analyze and forecast relevant metrics to understand trends in the business and develop business cases that translate into impactful recommendations for growth.

title: Senior Manager, Policy & Incident
descriptionHtml:
Leads consumer trust policy development and coordinates Adobe’s response to significant fraud, abuse, scam, account integrity, and other consumer trust incidents. Brings structure and cross-functional leadership to complex incidents and ensures lessons learned translate into scalable policies and systemic improvements. 

Partners across Adobe to strengthen incident response, reduce consumer harm, address recurring risks, and build policies and playbooks that enable faster and more consistent responses to emerging consumer trust threats. 

What you’ll do 

  • Lead policy development and incident management within Adobe’s Global Consumer Trust organization, helping protect consumers and Adobe from fraud, abuse, scams, account compromise, and emerging trust threats. 

  • Coordinate significant consumer trust incidents, bringing together teams across Adobe to assess impact, establish priorities and ownership, drive decisions, and ensure effective resolution. 

  • Partner across Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Legal, Security, GTM, and other teams to manage incidents and drive cross-functional action. 

  • Develop and maintain incident frameworks, severity criteria, escalation processes, playbooks, and governance that enable consistent and effective response. 

  • Lead post-incident reviews and translate lessons from incidents, investigations, customer experiences, and emerging threats into clear, scalable policies and systemic improvements. 

  • Develop and evolve consumer trust policies and decision frameworks covering areas such as fraud, abuse, scams, customer harm, remediation, and enforcement. 

  • Partner with Product and operational teams to translate policies into processes, controls, product requirements, training, and customer experiences. 

  • Identify recurring risks and advocate for improvements that reduce consumer harm and prevent recurrence. 

  • Establish metrics and executive reporting that provide visibility into incidents, emerging risks, policy effectiveness, and remediation progress. 

What you need to succeed 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Economics, or a related field, plus 10+ years of hands-on industry experience.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make effective decisions in complex, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving situations. 

  • Experience in fraud prevention, trust & safety, risk management, incident management, policy, customer protection, security, or a related field. 

  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority. 

  • Experience developing policies, decision frameworks, governance models, or scalable operational processes. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify broader trends, root causes, and systemic risks. 

  • Ability to balance fraud and consumer protection with customer experience, business impact, operational feasibility, and risk. 

  • Strong program management discipline with a structured and methodical approach to execution and follow-through. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex issues into clear executive-level recommendations.

title: Senior Manager, Adversarial Fraud Testing — Global Consumer Trust
descriptionHtml:
Builds and leads Adobe’s Adversarial Fraud Testing function within Global Consumer Trust. Proactively simulates and recreates real-world fraud and abuse attacks against Adobe’s externally facing products and fraud controls to identify weaknesses and validate defenses. 

Partners across Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Security, and other organizations to translate adversarial findings into stronger controls, product improvements, and systemic risk reduction. Establishes repeatable testing methodologies and ensures remediation is validated through ongoing adversarial testing. 

What you’ll do 

  • Build and lead Adobe’s Adversarial Fraud Testing function within Global Consumer Trust, proactively testing how fraudsters and other bad actors may exploit Adobe’s products, services, and fraud controls. 

  • Develop an adversarial testing strategy and methodology that safely simulates real-world fraud and abuse across customer journeys, APIs, account creation, payments, entitlements, and other externally facing product experiences. 

  • Lead the recreation of significant fraud attacks to understand how controls were bypassed, identify weaknesses, and determine opportunities to strengthen Adobe’s defenses. 

  • Partner with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams to design adversarial tests, evaluate controls, and prioritize remediation of identified gaps. 

  • Build repeatable testing capabilities using automation, APIs, scripting, and other technical approaches to simulate fraud and abuse at scale. 

  • Validate new and existing fraud controls by testing whether mitigations effectively disrupt attack paths and reduce opportunities for circumvention. 

  • Establish clear processes for documenting findings, assessing risk, communicating recommendations, and tracking remediation through completion and retesting. 

  • Identify patterns across adversarial tests and real-world incidents to surface systemic weaknesses and influence Adobe’s fraud prevention strategy and product roadmaps. 

  • Build and develop a high-performing team with the technical, fraud, and adversarial expertise needed to anticipate and reproduce evolving attack techniques. 

What you need to succeed 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Economics, or a related field, plus 10+ years of hands-on industry experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams in fraud prevention, adversarial testing, security, abuse prevention, risk engineering, or a related field. 

  • Strong understanding of how fraudsters and other bad actors exploit digital products, customer journeys, APIs, identity systems, payments, and business processes. 

  • Technical fluency with APIs, automation, scripting, data analysis, and modern web and cloud architectures, with the ability to effectively lead highly technical testing. 

  • Must have: Python/similar programming, APIs/HTTP, automation, debugging, Git, data/SQL, ability to understand product architecture. 

  • Useful: JavaScript, cloud services, browser automation, authentication/identity systems, CI/CD, security testing tools. 

  • Strong adversarial mindset with the ability to think creatively about how controls and intended product behaviors could be circumvented or abused. 

  • Experience developing structured testing methodologies and translating findings into actionable product, engineering, and fraud-control improvements. 

  • Proven ability to influence Product, Engineering, Fraud, Security, and senior leaders without direct authority. 

  • Strong judgment and ability to balance effective adversarial testing with customer, business, security, legal, and operational considerations. 

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex attack paths and technical findings into clear business risks and executive recommendations.

title: Adversarial Fraud Engineer — Global Consumer Trust
descriptionHtml:
Designs and executes adversarial testing to identify how fraudsters and other bad actors may exploit Adobe’s externally facing products, APIs, customer journeys, and fraud controls. Uses software engineering, automation, data analysis, and adversarial techniques to recreate real-world attacks, test defenses, and identify control gaps. 

Partners with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, and Security to translate findings into stronger defenses and retests mitigations to validate their effectiveness against evolving fraud and abuse techniques. 

What you’ll do 

  • Conduct adversarial testing of Adobe’s externally facing products, services, APIs, and fraud controls to identify how they may be exploited by fraudsters and other bad actors. 

  • Recreate real-world fraud and abuse attacks to understand attack paths, identify control gaps, and determine how defenses can be circumvented. 

  • Design and build automated testing tools and scripts using APIs, Python or similar languages to simulate fraud and abuse scenarios at scale. 

  • Develop creative test scenarios across account creation, identity, payments, entitlements, APIs, and other customer and product experiences. 

  • Partner with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams to understand threats, communicate findings, and recommend mitigations. 

  • Test new and existing fraud controls to determine their effectiveness and identify opportunities to strengthen detection and prevention. 

  • Retest mitigations to validate that identified attack paths have been effectively addressed and identify potential alternative methods of circumvention. 

  • Document attack methodologies, findings, and recommendations and help build repeatable adversarial testing capabilities. 

  • Stay current on emerging fraud, abuse, automation, and AI-enabled attack techniques and apply those learnings to Adobe’s products and defenses. 

What you need to succeed 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 8+ years of hands-on industry experience.

  • Strong software engineering or technical automation skills, with proficiency in Python or a similar scripting/programming language. 

  • Experience working with REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, web applications, automation frameworks, and modern cloud-based systems. 

  • Experience building scripts, tools, or automated workflows to test complex systems and behaviors. 

  • Must have: Python/similar programming, APIs/HTTP, automation, debugging, Git, data/SQL, ability to understand product architecture. 

  • Useful: JavaScript, cloud services, browser automation, authentication/identity systems, CI/CD, security testing tools. 

  • Strong understanding of fraud, abuse, cybersecurity, adversarial testing, or digital risk, with curiosity about how bad actors exploit products and controls. 

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using SQL, logs, telemetry, or other data sources to understand system behavior and evaluate test results. 

  • An adversarial mindset with the creativity and persistence to identify alternative attack paths and methods of circumventing controls. 

  • Ability to understand complex product architectures and work effectively with Product, Engineering, Fraud, and Security teams. 

  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate technical findings into clear risks and actionable recommendations. 

  • Strong judgment and commitment to conducting adversarial testing safely, responsibly, and within established authorization and testing boundaries.

title: Head of Government Relations & Public Policy, UKI and Middle East
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe seeks a leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team to advance our efforts in the UK, located in London. This leader will also support Adobe’s policy involvement in Ireland and the Middle East.

The team fosters a vibrant and enjoyable work atmosphere with outstanding opportunities to interact directly with governmental organisations, formulate policy positions, and assist Adobe’s operations. This role includes working alongside senior leaders, advising them, and designing engagement plans when appropriate. The position will report to the EMEA Director based in Germany.

We are seeking a creative and well-networked government relations professional who demonstrates initiative. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of digital policies in the UK as well as technology procurement policy procedures. This position demands outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, enthusiasm, and a keen interest in technology policies, government IT modernisation, and the customer experience field.

What you will do

  • Development, coordination, and implementation of a successful government relations engagement strategy, including engagement planning for senior leaders.

  • Take ownership of Adobe's engagement with UK regulatory authorities on sensitive, active matters, working closely with Legal and senior collaborators and managing confidential communications.

  • Advocate for policy changes that are good for our employees, customers, and business generally.

  • Handle resources to accomplish the goals of the organisation including outside consultants and trade associations.

  • Work autonomously and engage with senior leadership to drive impact.

  • Ensure Adobe is well positioned and follows all relevant regulations and requirements.

  • Develop and advocate for external policy positions which improve Adobe’s position in the marketplace.

  • Develop monitoring and reporting processes to ensure policies and issues that impact Adobe are flagged and mitigated where possible.

  • Responsibility for delivering successful outcomes and maintaining high levels of internal and external partner happiness.

  • Assist Adobe’s local teams based in the UK in every aspect of their work.

  • Aid Adobe's local groups in the Middle East (with emphasis on KSA and UAE) whenever needed; this is not encouraged to be the main allocation of time.

  • Build on and deepen relationships with policy experts, internal teams, trade association personnel, and government decision-makers.

  • Align with Adobe's Global Public Policy team on overarching narratives and positions, tailoring messaging and engagement approach to fit the specific dynamics of the UK market.

  • Drive Adobe’s Government Relations involvement in public sector sales/procurement activities in UK/I & Middle East.

  • Promote procurement and digital government policies that advance the customer experience and the digital service delivery provided by government.

What you will need

  • 15+ years of confirmed experience in successful government engagement

  • Comprehensive, direct experience with government policies and procedures in the UK

  • Experience engaging with government or regulatory bodies on a sensitive, high-stakes matter requiring discretion and confidentiality

  • Direct knowledge of political structures and functions, and sound understanding of how to appropriately engage with political and external policy development bodies and parties

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to translate complicated technical concepts into a compelling, succinct case for political outreach

  • Strong self-starter, comfortable working autonomously while building consensus and collaboration with top executives internally

  • Capability to guide through influence rather than official power: forming alliances and attaining outcomes with internal and external partners who are not your direct reports. You will think and act both strategically and creatively.

  • Dedication to quick results balanced with the vision to see how long-term strategies need to unfold

  • Genuine passion for the positive role government can play in society, and a strong desire to help improve it

  • Curiosity and adaptability to grow alongside Adobe's expanding business as it accelerates

title: Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer — Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer — Fraud Detection

The Opportunity

We are in search of an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to develop and broaden fraud and abuse detection systems. You will improve ML techniques in anomaly detection, user/device risk analysis, identity and service abuse, and evolving AI abuse scenarios.

This is a hands-on role spanning ML, data, and backend systems, with opportunities to apply LLMs, AI agents, and modern ML techniques to strengthen detection. You will own solutions end to end — from signals and modeling through production deployment and real-time decisioning. Join us in crafting best in class fraud detection systems that will make a significant impact!

What you'll Do

  • Build and deploy high-precision ML models for fraud and abuse detection, anomaly detection, and risk scoring.
  • Engineer risk signals from large-scale account, device, network, behavioral, velocity, and session data.
  • Integrate ML/AI features into real-time risk decisioning and automated enforcement systems.
  • Apply LLMs and AI agents to expand detection, investigation, and classification capabilities.
  • Translate emerging attack patterns and relevant research into new models, signals, and mitigations.
  • Evaluate solutions across accuracy, latency, cost, and customer impact.
  • Own model evaluation, monitoring, and drift as attacker behavior evolves.
  • Partner across engineering, product, and risk teams to ship production-ready capabilities.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 8+ years building and operating production ML systems, ideally in fraud, abuse, risk, identity, trust & safety, or other adversarial domains.
  • Solid ML background with practical experience in Python, SQL, and current ML frameworks like PyTorch.
  • Experience guiding ML systems from feature engineering to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong software/data engineering skills across ML, backend, and data infrastructure.
  • Experience building with LLMs and/or AI agents, particularly for AI/generation-abuse use cases.
  • Strong technical judgment, ownership, and ability to solve ambiguous, adversarial problems.
  • Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • Device fingerprinting, identity verification, behavioral signals, network intelligence, or VPN/proxy detection.
  • Real-time risk evaluation and automated control systems.
  • Human-in-the-loop or AI-assisted evaluation systems.
  • Distributed systems and high-scale data pipelines.
  • Strong adversarial approach — anticipating how attackers adapt to mitigations.

title: Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience M&A
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


Adobe's Employee Experience (EX) M&A team owns the people-related dimensions of every transaction—from due diligence through close and post-close integration. As deal volume and complexity have grown, we are adding a Senior Program Manager to bring dedicated capacity to the integration workstreams that most directly shape the acquired-employee experience: change management, culture integration, onboarding, and leadership/manager/team enablement. 


Working alongside our existing program leads, you will run defined workstreams end-to-end—designing the plan, coordinating cross-functionally, and driving execution against timeline and quality bars—while building the mechanics and playbooks that let the team scale.  


What You'll Do 

  • Design and lead deal-specific EX change management strategies, including onboarding (leadership onboarding through team onboarding), post-onboarding monitoring, and retrospectives. 
  • Assess cultural gaps between Adobe and target companies, and build practical bridging programs that ease the transition for acquired employees and leaders. 
  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement activities; guide managers and leaders through periods of significant organizational change.  
  • Design and act on employee pulse surveys during organizational change, translating signals into interventions. 
  • Partner with target-company and Adobe leaders to align integration plans, and connect structural design (org and operating model) to the lived employee experience (culture, onboarding, enablement). 
  • Align EX change and culture initiatives with the broader communications strategy so messaging and action reinforce each other. 
  • Coordinate across Corporate Development / Integration, Legal, Finance, ATS/Systems, HRBPs, and business leaders to keep EX integration workstreams on track. 
  • Independently manage workstream mechanics - timelines, tracking, documentation and and prepare clear, executive-level status reporting. 
  • Develop and track integration metrics and pulse-survey signals to measure EX effectiveness and inform leadership decision-making. 
  • Build a network of external standards and industry benchmarks to continuously refine EX M&A playbooks. 

What You Need to Succeed 


Required 

  • 7+ years in HR, with M&A experience focused on integration, change management, or culture work; exposure across all deal phases is ideal. 
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering change-management or culture-integration programs in a deal context. 
  • Strong data proficiency, including comfort working with employee census and workforce data and HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) to identify trends, flag risks, and inform integration decisions. 
  • Experience designing onboarding programs and delivering leadership onboarding post-close. 
  • Experience designing and acting on employee pulse surveys during periods of organizational change. 
  • Strong facilitation skills—comfortable leading workshops and driving alignment in rapidly changing, ambiguous environments. 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver clear, well-structured, and impactful executive level presentations that distill complex integration work into insights for senior leadership. 
  • Skilled at partnering with communications and cross-functional teams to align messaging and action. 
  • Strong program management fundamentals; able to independently own workstream mechanics (timelines, tracking, documentation) across concurrent priorities. 
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in handling highly confidential, deal-related information 

Preferred 

  • Consulting experience (management, HR, or M&A advisory), bringing a fungible, deploy-anywhere skills the team can apply across transformation work. 
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-volume, high-pressure environment with competing priorities across multiple time zones and geographies, maintaining quality and composure under tight deal timelines. 
  • Experience with complex-structured, stock, or asset deals. 
  • Experience coaching managers and leaders through significant organizational change. 
  • Breadth to operate as a utility player—able to move across M&A and broader transformation initiatives as priorities shift. 
  • Willingness and ability to travel on short notice to support critical deal moments throughout the transaction lifecycle, from diligence through integration, as deals require.

title: Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Detection & Effectiveness

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Machine Learning Data Scientist to build fraud and abuse detection models and measure how effectively they work. This role combines hands-on modeling with deep experimentation, evaluation, and analytics to improve detection and quantify business impact.

You will work across the fraud lifecycle — from modeling and ground-truth definition to performance measurement, monitoring, and executive-ready insights!

What you'll Do

  • Build and tune ML models for fraud and abuse detection using statistical and classical ML techniques.
  • Develop robust evaluation frameworks, datasets, and metrics to measure model and mitigation effectiveness.
  • Analyze false positives/negatives, model drift, and emerging fraud patterns to continuously improve detection.
  • Define ground truth, labeling approaches, and fraud taxonomies that support reliable model development and evaluation.
  • Design experiments and evaluate tradeoffs across precision, recall, customer impact, and fraud loss.
  • Build dashboards and metrics that translate detection performance into measurable business impact.
  • Pressure-test models and data for leakage, bias, data-quality issues, and other sources of misleading results.
  • Partner across engineering, product, policy, and risk teams to turn insights into detection improvements and business decisions.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 8+ years in applied Data Science / ML, with experience building and evaluating production ML models.
  • Strong foundation in statistical and classical ML, experimentation, model evaluation, and performance measurement.
  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with model monitoring, drift, false-positive/false-negative analysis, and imperfect or delayed labels.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills — able to translate complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong analytical judgment, ownership, and ability to operate independently through ambiguity.
  • Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in fraud, abuse, risk, identity, trust & safety, or other adversarial domains.
  • Experience with anomaly detection, clustering, behavioral modeling, or prevalence estimation.
  • Experience with labeling frameworks, weak supervision, active learning, or human-review systems.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted evaluation/analysis.
  • Experience evaluating multi-layered risk controls and automated decisioning systems.

title: Director, Employee Experience M&A
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Director, Employee Experience M&A leads the end-to-end people strategy for Adobe's transactions—from early diligence through close and post-close integration. This is a senior, high-ownership individual-contributor role for someone who can run deals independently, from beginning to end, rather than support or coordinate a single workstream. You will serve as the people lead on assigned deals, translating deal rationale into an actionable EX integration strategy and owning the outcome.

The role demands broad HR expertise, solid commercial insight, and the judgment to operate independently in complex, ambiguous, and often global environments. It requires making informed decisions while knowing when to bring up issues for validation. You will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the connective tissue between deal strategy and the lived employee experience. As with the rest of our team, this is a utility role. Between deals, and as we drive transformation across EX and the business, you will flex to lead high-priority initiatives beyond M&A.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full people lifecycle for assigned deals, independently leading EX diligence, integration planning, and post-close execution.
  • Translate deal rationale and value drivers into a concrete, measurable integration strategy and plan.
  • Provide the early voice on people-integration risks, complexity, and cost during diligence, and shape how those insights inform the integration approach (and vice versa).
  • Define and drive integration priorities, workstreams, and timelines across all phases; assemble and direct cross-functional effort without formal authority.
  • Lead organizational transition, cultural assimilation, onboarding, and leadership/manager/team empowerment for acquired organizations, including complex and groundbreaking deals.
  • Partner with Corporate Development / Integration, Legal, Finance, ATS/Systems, HRBPs, and business and target-company leaders to align on org design, operating model, and people plans.
  • Advise senior leadership—including as needed the CHRO and business executives—with clear recommendations grounded in diligence findings and integration realities.
  • Build and continuously improve the EX M&A playbook in partnership with the team, raising the team's ability to run more deals concurrently at consistent quality.
  • Between and across deals, lead select transformation priorities—operating as a senior utility player deployable to a range of work beyond M&A.

What You Need to Succeed

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR, organizational strategy, or a related field, ideally within global enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise across the full M&A deal lifecycle, with a track record of independently leading deals end-to-end.
  • Broad HR knowledge across multiple fields: change management, culture and organization design, onboarding and leadership enablement, talent and workforce planning, and HR operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of compensation/benefits harmonization and retention levers
  • Proven ability to make high-impact decisions independently, influence senior partners, and lead cross-functionally without direct authority.

title: Senior Designer, Adobe Creative
descriptionHtml:
Senior Multidisciplinary Designer  

Adobe Creative

Our Company 

Empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences. 

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.   

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI. 

Our Team 

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.  

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency. 

The Opportunity  

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own design work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for an exceptional Senior Multidisciplinary Designer to create beautifully crafted, culturally relevant work across Adobe Creative’s output. 

You will work across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, motion and live experiences, moving confidently between early visual exploration, design development and polished final execution. 

Working alongside Design leaders, Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn ideas into distinctive visual expressions that feel recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic. 

You will combine exceptional design craft with curiosity for emerging technology. You will use Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled workflows to explore more widely, prototype more quickly and make stronger work without compromising taste, originality or human judgment. 

You are a maker first. You care deeply about typography, image-making, composition, and the details that make an idea feel fully resolved. 

What You’ll Do 

Design Across the Work 

  • Create high-quality design across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, and live experiences.  

  • Develop work from early concept and visual exploration through design development and final execution.  

  • Apply exceptional craft across typography, image-making, layout, composition and art direction.  

  • Work across high-velocity everyday output and highly crafted flagship work.  

  • Adapt strong ideas across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact. 

  • Create work that feels connected and recognizably Adobe while remaining fresh, distinctive and culturally relevant. 

Turn Ideas into Visual Worlds 

  • Partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors and Art Directors to develop visual territories and creative systems.  

  • Translate campaign and creative ideas into compelling art direction and design expression.  

  • Collaborate with Copywriters to develop visual and verbal ideas as one connected creative system.  

  • Create mood boards, prototypes, and design studies that help teams explore and align early.  

  • Know when to explore broadly and when to refine toward a clear, production-ready solution.  

  • Bring a strong visual point of view while remaining open to collaboration and critique. 

Build Scalable Creative Systems 

  • Create modular frameworks, templates and reusable design tools that support speed without losing craft.  

  • Help translate Adobe’s brand system into distinctive creative expression across real work.  

  • Test how design ideas perform across channels, formats and audience needs.  

  • Find opportunities to improve tools and workflows based on real creative applications.  

  • Balance systematic thinking with experimentation, surprise and flexibility.  

  • Document design thinking clearly so others can apply it effectively. 

Advance AI-Native Design 

  • Use Creative Cloud, Firefly and emerging generative tools throughout concepting, prototyping and production.  

  • Use AI-enabled workflows to expand visual exploration and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.  

  • Apply human judgment, taste and craft to all AI-assisted work.  

  • Help define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.  

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.  

  • Apply responsible AI practices, including provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials. 

Collaborate and Deliver 

  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.  

  • Present work clearly, explain design decisions, and respond constructively to feedback.  

  • Partner with Production to carry ideas into execution while protecting their creative intent.  

  • Collaborate with photographers, illustrators, artists, studios, and specialist partners when required. 

  • Maintain a high design standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.  

  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas and development of the wider team. 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • You consider yourself a maker first. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing. 

  • 6+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative practice. 

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional design craft across multi-platform campaigns and product storytelling. 

  • Deep expertise in typography, layout, image-making, and visual composition. 

  • Strong fluency across digital, motion, and emerging design practices. 

  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to carry an idea from exploration through final execution. 

  • Experience working across both high-velocity creative and highly crafted flagship work. 

  • Experience applying brand systems in ways that feel distinctive and alive. 

  • Strong systems thinking and experience creating modular frameworks, templates or reusable creative tools. 

  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled visual workflows. 

  • A clear perspective on how generative AI changes visual exploration, authorship and production. 

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and collaborating with Copy, Motion, Strategy and Production. 

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills. 

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, art, technology and emerging visual practices. 

  • The ability to balance speed, experimentation, and craft. 

  • A maker attitude, curiosity and a commitment to continuously improving the work.

title: Compliance Risk & Assurance
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe’s Business Ethics & Integrity organization is continuing to evolve our data-driven, risk-based approach to compliance - one that proactively identifies emerging risks, continuously evaluates the effectiveness of our controls, and uses data and technology to generate meaningful insights and drive continuous improvement.

We’re looking for a Compliance Risk & Assurance professional to help continue maturing these capabilities across Adobe’s global Business Ethics & Integrity program. This role will connect compliance risk assessments, monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, and analytics to help us understand where our most significant risks are, whether our compliance processes and controls are effectively mitigating those risks, and where we should focus our efforts and resources.

You’ll work across Business Ethics & Integrity and partner closely with Legal, Internal Audit, and other teams to develop scalable, risk-based assurance and monitoring capabilities. You’ll also support compliance due diligence in M&A and explore opportunities to leverage data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies - including AI - to strengthen risk identification, improve efficiency, and generate actionable insights.

This is an opportunity to help shape how a global technology company identifies and manages compliance risks, evaluates program effectiveness, and drives continuous improvement.


What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute compliance risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and prioritize ethics and compliance risks across Adobe’s businesses, geographies, and operations.
  • Design and implement risk-based compliance monitoring and assurance activities to evaluate the effectiveness of compliance processes and controls, identify gaps, and drive remediation and continuous improvement.
  • Build and enhance continuous monitoring capabilities, leveraging compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, trends, anomalies, and potential control weaknesses across key compliance risk areas.
  • Develop meaningful risk indicators, dashboards, metrics, and reporting to provide leadership with actionable insights into compliance risks, program effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Legal, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to evaluate findings, identify root causes, develop practical remediation plans, and strengthen compliance processes and controls.
  • Support M&A compliance risk assessments and due diligence, including identifying potential ethics and compliance risks and supporting post-close integration and remediation.
  • Leverage analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of compliance risk assessment, monitoring, and assurance activities.
  • Support broader Ethics & Compliance Office initiatives and priorities, including enhancements to compliance policies, processes, governance, and other program activities as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in corporate ethics and compliance, compliance risk management, or compliance monitoring and assurance, ideally within a global company or similarly complex environment. Experience in internal audit or risk advisory may be relevant when accompanied by substantive corporate ethics and compliance experience.
  • Strong understanding of corporate ethics and compliance programs, including key compliance risk areas, regulatory expectations, risk assessmentmethodologies, compliance monitoring, and approaches to evaluating program effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or executing compliance risk assessments, risk-based compliance monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, or compliance assurance activities.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, evaluate trends and anomalies, assess program effectiveness, and inform risk-based decisions.
  • Experience developing or leveraging metrics, dashboards, key risk indicators, and management reporting to support risk-based decision-making.
  • Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar technologies, is preferred. Experience applying automation or AI-enabled capabilities to compliance monitoring and assurance is a plus.
  • Knowledge of core corporate compliance risk areas, including anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, and third-party risk.
  • Experience with M&A compliance due diligence, integration, or risk assessment is preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking, professional skepticism, and sound judgment, with the ability to connect data, compliance observations, and business context to broader compliance risks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear, practical recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, Security, technical teams, and business functions.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and help build new capabilities in an evolving environment.

title: Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst
descriptionHtml:
The Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst identifies, investigates, and mitigates fraud, abuse, and monetization risks across Adobe's commerce ecosystem. Through data-driven investigations, payment risk analysis, abuse detection, and cross-functional partnerships, the team uncovers emerging threats, develops scalable mitigations, and delivers actionable intelligence that protects revenue, reduces customer friction, and strengthens trust in Adobe products and services. 

Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact - The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs. 

  • Payments Risk & Commercial Abuse Investigations 

  • Investigate complex payment fraud, monetization abuse, account misuse, and commercial abuse schemes impacting Adobe's commerce ecosystem, including unauthorized resale activity, synthetic identity abuse, payment instrument abuse, chargeback fraud, refund abuse, and the unauthorized use, distribution, or commercialization of Adobe products and services. 

  • Analyze transactions, customer behaviors, payment activity, subscription usage, account relationships, and associated signals to identify suspicious patterns, assess risk exposure, determine root cause, and recommend mitigation, enforcement, or policy actions. 

  • Evaluate escalations, emerging threat patterns, and high-risk activity to develop risk assessments and response recommendations. 

  • Analytics, Intelligence & Detection Development 

  • Utilize SQL, analytical tools, and investigative methodologies to identify trends, uncover fraud patterns, validate hypotheses, and generate actionable intelligence. 

  • Translate investigative findings into scalable detection strategies, risk signals, decisioning logic, and operational controls that reduce fraud while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. 

  • Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and AI teams to define abuse indicators, improve model performance, and enhance detection capabilities through investigator-driven insights and feedback loops. 

  • Produce intelligence assessments, trend analyses, and strategic insights on emerging abuse patterns, monetization risks, and evolving fraud trends across Adobe's commerce ecosystem. 

  • Commerce Risk Strategy & Optimization 

  • Balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience considerations when evaluating controls, policies, detection strategies, and enforcement actions. 

  • Provide recommendations to strengthen payment risk controls, fraud mitigation strategies, automation opportunities, and long-term commerce risk initiatives while balancing customer experience and business objectives. 

  • Collaborate with Product, Commerce, Risk, Customer Support, Trust & Safety, and Engineering teams to address emerging threats, improve platform resilience, and drive sustainable risk reduction strategies. 

Qualifications & Core Competencies: 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative findings, payment risk data, and abuse trends into clear, actionable recommendations. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and transform complex data into meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making. 

  • Experience using SQL/SPL and data analysis techniques to support investigations, validate hypotheses, identify trends, and generate actionable intelligence. 

  • A naturally inquisitive and investigative mindset, with a passion for understanding how malicious actors exploit commerce systems, products, and business processes. 

  • Strong understanding of payment and commerce risk concepts, including chargebacks, friendly fraud, account abuse, refund abuse, affiliate abuse, subscription fraud, identity risk, monetization abuse, and common payment ecosystem risks. 

  • Experience identifying risk signals, anomalous behaviors, and abuse patterns and translating findings into scalable detection, mitigation, or enforcement strategies. 

  • Creative and strategic problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to anticipate emerging risks and develop innovative, scalable solutions. 

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity while working independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams. 

  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to delivering thorough, accurate, and high-confidence investigative outcomes. 

  • Experience in payments risk, commerce fraud, fraud investigations, abuse prevention, trust and safety operations, fraud analytics, cybersecurity investigations, threat intelligence, or enterprise risk management is preferred. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts, risk models, AI-driven abuse trends, or the application of AI and automation to fraud detection and investigative workflows is a plus. 

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes when evaluating risk mitigation strategies.
