title: Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator
descriptionHtml:
The Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator identifies, investigates, and disrupts fraud, abuse, and adversarial activity targeting Adobe's products, services, and ecosystem. Through threat intelligence, reverse engineering, technical investigations, detection engineering, and AI-driven capabilities, the team delivers actionable intelligence and scalable mitigations that strengthen platform resilience and protect Adobe, its customers, and its ecosystem. 

Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact - The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs. 

Threat Intelligence & Adversary Research 

  • Monitor and assess adversarial activity, fraud, abuse, and emerging threats impacting Adobe products, services, and business operations. 

  • Assess threat actors, campaigns, and evolving adversarial behaviors to understand risk exposure and support proactive threat mitigation efforts. 

  • Leverage open- and closed-source intelligence, industry partnerships, intelligence-sharing communities, and emerging data sources to enhance threat visibility and intelligence collection capabilities. 

  • Produce intelligence assessments and threat reporting that inform detection, investigations, and operational decision-making. 

Reverse Engineering, Investigations & Detection 

  • Reverse engineer and analyze malicious tooling, automation frameworks, browser extensions, attack infrastructure, and other mechanisms used to target or abuse Adobe services, documenting attacker methodologies and identifying opportunities for disruption.  

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled attack techniques, adversarial tooling, and automation frameworks, to identify evolving threats and develop scalable detection and mitigation strategies. 

  • Conduct complex technical investigations into fraud, abuse, account compromise, platform misuse, and other malicious activity, including escalation analysis, attribution, root cause determination, and identification of coordinated threat activity. 

  • Discover exploited or potential vulnerabilities and partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies, remediation plans, and long-term risk reduction approaches. 

  • Translate intelligence and investigative findings into scalable detection, monitoring, prevention, and enforcement capabilities. 

  • Develop and maintain investigative methodologies, detection workflows, and operational processes that support effective threat detection, analysis, and response. 

  • Strategic Collaboration & Influence 

  • Partner with Product, Security, Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Trust & Safety, and other stakeholders to mitigate threats, improve platform resilience, and strengthen customer protection. 

  • Support incident response and emerging threat investigations by providing intelligence, attribution analysis, investigative expertise, and strategic guidance. 

  • Develop executive-ready briefings, investigative summaries, and risk assessments that communicate findings, business impact, and strategic recommendations. 

  • Advise stakeholders on intelligence-driven risk mitigation, fraud prevention, abuse prevention, and vulnerability management strategies. 

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on adversarial behavior, emerging threats, and fraud trends, helping inform long-term threat reduction and platform protection strategies. 

Qualifications & Core Competencies:  

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative, intelligence, and technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical, operational, and executive audiences.

title: Staff Security Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Adobe’s Security Data Platform team builds and operates a petabyte-scale security data lakehouse that turns enterprise telemetry into trusted data for threat detection, investigations, compliance, and security analytics.
 

As a Staff Security Data Engineer, you will own full-system designs and lead critical engineering initiatives across ingestion, storage, governance, orchestration, and data serving. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will write and review production code, build infrastructure, define test strategy, fix complex failures, and work with other engineers to deliver the architecture you help shape.
 

You will partner with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Compliance, Security Engineering, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical tradeoffs and deliver reliable, cost-effective platform capabilities. Your impact will come through engineering delivery, sound architectural decisions, and helping others become stronger technical leaders.
 

Help us evolve our team from petabyte scale toward exabyte scale!
 

Core responsibilities

Platform architecture and engineering

  • Own end-to-end designs that shape the Security Data Platform’s fundamental architecture on Databricks and AWS, using Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. Translate ambiguous needs into design proposals, implementation plans, and production capabilities.
  • Build and evolve distributed batch and streaming pipelines for EDR telemetry, network logs, identity events, cloud audit logs, and new security data sources. Design for throughput, fault tolerance, replay, schema evolution, and sub-minute freshness where use cases require it.
  • Write maintainable Python and SQL, develop complex platform features, and refactor unreliable code. Establish reusable engineering patterns, lead code and design reviews, and own test strategy and automation choices across pipelines and infrastructure.
  • Build and maintain tested, reusable Terraform modules for AWS and Databricks infrastructure, including S3, IAM, VPC networking, and Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA). Automate delivery through version control and CI/CD.

Data modeling governance and operations

  • Design layered lakehouse data models and reusable normalization patterns, including Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) mappings where appropriate. Preserve source fidelity and make datasets useful for investigations, analytics, and detection workloads.
  • Establish data contracts, quality checks, cataloging, classification, lineage, access controls, and retention policies with data owners. Use Unity Catalog to make data ownership and governance traceable from raw events to analyst-facing datasets.
  • Engineer and operate Airflow and MWAA orchestration, including dependencies, retries, backfills, alerting, and automated recovery. Define service level objectives with consumers and instrument data freshness, completeness, pipeline health, and query performance.
  • Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex production issues across Spark, storage, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure. Improve incident response, runbooks, recovery testing, and operational readiness to prevent recurring failures.

Performance and technical leadership

  • Profile workloads and lead measurable cost and performance improvements through query and Spark tuning, storage lifecycle policies, partitioning, and compute right-sizing. Establish baselines and dashboards that show savings alongside reliability, latency, and capacity.
  • Lead cross-team technical discussions, reconcile competing requirements, and build agreement on architecture and delivery priorities without formal management authority. Communicate decisions, landmarks, risks, and business impact proactively to your manager and partners.
  • Partner with detection and security analytics engineers to deliver the data interfaces, governance, and pipeline capabilities needed for SIEM modernization and automated detection deployment.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, technical reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Help others lead technical work, promote inclusive debate, and contribute to hiring decisions through technical assessment.
  • Evaluate and introduce useful platform innovations, including AI-assisted engineering and operational automation. Validate outputs, protect sensitive security data, measure improvements, and help partner teams adopt proven approaches.
     

Required qualifications

  • Substantial experience building and operating production data platforms, typically 10 or more years in data or software engineering, with demonstrated Staff-level scope and impact. Equivalent depth and outcomes are welcome; a prior Staff or Principal title is not required.

title: Sr Full Stack Engineer, Creator Services
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

This position where we will develop and launch a new product within Adobe working within an exciting org that is incubating next-generation ideas. Build the next generation agentic AI platform working with a research scientist, designers, and a venture lead to bring the new product to life.

This role is an outstanding opportunity to operate like a startup founding engineer while having the resources of an innovative, large Technology company. Join us for an opportunity to invent new technologies and power a brand-new product that serves emerging creators.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer to build Creator Services from the ground up. Creator Services is building AI-powered audience intelligence: given a content idea and creator context, predict whether it will resonate and surface the insights that help creators make smarter decisions. As Creator Services expands into brand deal discovery, negotiation, storefront management, and affiliate programs, the research agenda grows with it.

A core part of the platform will be agentic AI systems that automate the complex tasks creators face running their businesses. You will build and operate multi-agent pipelines. You will transform model outputs into interactive creator workflows. This will connect Creator Services to creator platforms and data sources that make the intelligence real. Collaborate closely with the Research Lead and Product & UX Lead as a peer collaborator.

Responsibilities

  • Product Build (Front-to-Back): Build the mobile-first creator app and micro-studio (front-end) and the services behind it (back-end/APIs), turning research and product vision into a live product creators use daily. Stack: React / React Native or Flutter on the front-end; Python and/or Node/TypeScript on the back-end.
  • Develop and manage multi-agent pipelines and prediction serving. This includes cost-efficient inference, caching, and graceful degradation when model providers falter. Also, include eval instrumentation to catch regressions in production.
  • Model Productionization: Collaborate closely alongside the lead researcher to transform model outputs into responsive, low-latency creator workflows. Support deployment of trainable model components alongside base model APIs (Azure OpenAI) on Colligo (Adobe's ML platform).
  • Integrations: Build integrations with external creator platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok via creator-authorized OAuth), Adobe's wider suite of creative tools (Express, Firefly, Adobe Creative Suite, IMS), Semrush, and internal Adobe services.
  • Data Pipelines: Build the data pipelines that feed the audience intelligence, insight, and prediction engines — including the outcome-feedback loop that lets the system learn from real creator results.
  • Architecture Ownership: Own architecture decisions as an early hire — from framework choices to data models to deployment pipelines
  • Observability & Reliability: Contribute to monitoring, observability, and evaluation frameworks that ensure AI-driven features behave reliably and transparently for creators.

What is needed to succeed

  • 5+ years shipping full-stack products end-to-end (front-end + back-end + APIs) — startup or 0→1 experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in a modern back-end environment like Python or Node with TypeScript is required. Experience with a contemporary app/front-end stack such as React, React Native, or Flutter is also necessary. Mobile-first experience is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs and agent frameworks; solid grasp of latency, cost, evals, and fallbacks in production — not just prototypes.
  • Experience designing and building scalable APIs, backend services, and data pipelines from scratch.
  • Comfort with cloud infra (Azure/AWS/GCP) and standing up services in a resource-constrained startup environment.
  • Ability to move fast under ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and work effectively in a small, flat team.
  • A genuine interest in the creator economy and the tools creators use to build their businesses.

Bonus

  • Experience with third-party social/platform APIs (YouTube Data API, Instagram Graph API, TikTok for Developers).
  • Familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem — Firefly APIs, Adobe IMS, Creative Cloud integrations.
  • Experience with recommender or ML-serving systems; Colligo or similar ML infrastructure.

title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) is a senior business-critical role responsible for overall solution health and maintaining a high standard of technical operational excellence to deliver customer value, accelerate solution use, and be the customer’s advocate with Adobe product and engineering.

eTAMs quickly grasp a customer's landscape, assess their maturity and solution lifecycle, and identify immediate, short- and long-term wins. You will share expert guidance grounded in Adobe and industry standards.

Consistent technical rigor, dependable solution health, and a focus on customer needs are central to this role. Building a clear technical engagement strategy — and following through on it — is how eTAMs help customers succeed.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver consistent technical excellence through early engagement and ongoing solution health monitoring
  • Lead capability roadmap and discovery sessions with customers to uncover both quick and larger engagements that increase adoption and product use
  • Identify technical risk by understanding customer use cases, and flag potential challenges proactively
  • Increase product adoption through measurable engagements that build customer understanding
  • Maintain regular communication with internal and external teams, consistently representing customer needs
  • Engage with Director and VP-Level executives to translate business needs into technical and operational plans
  • Manage all technical challenges and ensure customers tickets and issues are fully addressed and resolved with urgency
  • Work hands-on with cross-functional Adobe teams to ensure customers are provided with the highest level of proactive support and technical strategy based on Adobe/industry standards
  • Make sure customers are aware of opportunities available through the Ultimate Success program and customer alpha/beta programs, and help them take part
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and prelaunch planning. Present clear data and insights to customer leadership
  • Serve as the first point of contact for critical technical concerns, and coordinate resolutions with Adobe services, sales, product, and engineering teams
  • Assess and document customers’ technical environment to reveal ongoing insights, improvements, and optimization opportunities
  • Proactively recommend how new and existing features fit within customers’ environments, using industry and Adobe standards and proven methodologies
  • Participate in customer-requested meetings, as well as strategic and quarterly business reviews (on-site and remote)
  • Participate in project-based, consultant-led architectural and design discussions to ensure solutions are optimal for the customer(s)
  • Continue developing your technical and interpersonal skills, and help mentor team members as needed

Requirements:

  • 10 years of experience focused on building technology roadmaps, enablement plans, support and operations models in either a consulting setting or industry/client side
  • 5 years in a start-up-minded environment, Fortune 500 company, or direct customer-facing consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, information technology management, business, marketing/communications or related field
  • Track record of leading critical customer conversations and bringing opportunities forward to build value and positive sentiment
  • Experience building and delivering a technical health and enablement plan, and clearly articulate wins based on capability activation
  • Deep understanding of how Adobe products fit together to deliver integrated workstreams that support adoption and account health
  • Understand customer needs and organizational maturity, and tailor a technical adoption/enablement plan that fits
  • Deliver value through product activation activities such as office hours, deskside coaching, value accelerators, and field engineering engagements
  • Comfortable bringing opportunities to customers before being asked, rather than waiting to be prompted
  • Demonstrated presentation skills, including comfort on camera and in front of audiences of all sizes
  • Executive presence and direct experience building relationships with customer executives from Director to C-Suite
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  • Focus on resolving blocking and open technical issues quickly
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues thoroughly, using peers and internal resources as needed
  • Regular travel to client locations for planning sessions, QBR/SBRs, and relationship development (approximately 20-30 percent)
  • Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies.
  • Experience and familiarity with at least one of the Adobe capabilities including Content, Data, or Journeys
  • Experience with Adobe products such as: Adobe Analytics, Adobe Audience Manager, AEM, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Target, AEP, Adobe Realtime Customer Data Platform, etc. (certification preferred)

  • Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energized.
  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: A comprehensive compensation package intended to support and reward employees.
  • Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so can you. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.

Your Mission

Become a key consultant for our dynamic sales team, working with sales, marketing, finance, and other teams. Your knowledge will drive our LATAM business, at a time when the region's share of global sales revenue is growing quickly and its legal landscape is becoming more complex — spanning localized privacy requirements and sector-specific regulation in cybersecurity and AI across multiple LATAM jurisdictions.


What You'll Do

  • Principal LATAM Business Partner: Operate as the main Business Partner to the LATAM business leadership which is based out of Sao Paulo (LATAM HQ) and Mexico.
  • Draft, Review & Negotiate: Take the lead on a variety of agreements, licensing, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales, partnerships, and channel compliance matters. You'll keep us covered and keep deals moving.
  • Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!
  • Compliance Monitor: Be proactive in tracking and offering recommendations on the newest regulations and laws that affect Adobe across LATAM jurisdictions, with a focus on technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy/security.
  • Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help build scalable legal processes for the region. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.
  • Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it's needed most, and participate in regional and global initiatives aligned with Adobe's strategic priorities.
  • Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, liaise with LGR functions in the US and EMEA to manage litigation and regulatory compliance issues, and offer continuous support on key risks, building a culture of compliance and confidence.

Who You Are

  • Qualified Lawyer: You've trained and qualified with a reputable law firm or an in-house department of a comparable company, with significant post-qualification experience.
  • Commercial/IT/IP Experience: You possess a demonstrated history in these domains, and you grasp the complexities of software, technology, and data protection concerns.
  • Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.
  • Communication Ace: Your drafting and technical skills are outstanding, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.
  • Languages: Fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish is required to collaborate with global legal and business teams.
  • Flexible & Adaptable: You're quick on your feet, ready to adjust when the business demands change.
  • Sense of Humour: You know how to lighten the mood and keep spirits high, essential for our team!
  • Ready for Travel: Prepared and capable of traveling across LATAM and Mexico as necessary for sales support.

What Makes This Role Fun & Cool?

  • Build the Future: Play a key role in Adobe's evolution across LATAM, especially in this fast-paced tech and AI culture.
  • Tech Meets Law: Dive into brand new systems and technology incorporating AI, CLM, and automation to assist us in scaling smarter!
  • Room to Grow: Take on new challenges, lead projects, collaborate with a distributed team, and develop your own expertise as Adobe expands across the region.
  • Fun Perks: Celebrations, creativity challenges, and team-building events plus some of the best colleagues in the business.

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers in Mexico. You will build trusted relationships, help customers improve how they gain value from their Adobe investments, and maintain an outstanding customer experience throughout the engagement.

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with world-class technical teams and senior leaders. It involves translating customers’ business priorities into clear technical strategies, operational plans, and measurable outcomes. You will proactively identify risks, uncover optimization opportunities, and orchestrate the appropriate Adobe resources to help customers achieve their long-term goals.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor and point of coordination for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with practitioners, technical leaders, managers, directors, and C-level executives

  • Translate complex business objectives into actionable technical strategies, success plans, and operational priorities

  • Proactively identify customer needs, technical risks, and opportunities for optimization, adoption, and long-term improvement

  • Orchestrate the resolution of complex technical issues by coordinating across Adobe Engineering, TechOps, Managed Services, Support, Product, and other internal teams

  • Establish clear expectations and maintain consistent communication through regular checkpoints, status reviews, governance meetings, and planning sessions.

  • Conduct in-depth assessments of customers’ technical environments to identify architectural risks, performance concerns, integration challenges, and opportunities for improvement

  • Provide strategic advice on implementation approaches, technical guidelines, scalability, performance, integrations, and operational readiness

  • Co-lead Quarterly Business Reviews, executive briefings, and technical presentations, connecting the realities of the customer’s technical environment with business priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Maintain structured oversight of open actions, technical dependencies, risks, and critical issues, ensuring clear ownership and timely follow-through

  • Advocate for customers within Adobe while balancing their priorities with technical feasibility, product capabilities, and internal commitments

  • Collaborate across Adobe teams to deliver a coordinated and consistent customer experience

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • Seven or more years of experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, solution architecture, or another senior customer-facing technical role

  • Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customer relationships in a consultative capacity

  • Good understanding of marketing technology, advertising technology, and AI-powered solutions, including their application within complex enterprise environments

  • Strong knowledge of web technologies, including JavaScript, jQuery, Java, HTML/HTML5, CSS, REST APIs, and database technologies

  • Solid understanding of tag management, digital data collection, and enterprise implementation methodologies

  • Experience solving issues, performance-tuning, and optimizing web/app environments

  • Ability to read and interpret code, fix technical implementations, and understand third-party integrations at the API level

  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies

  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to communicate effectively with and influence senior technical and business leaders

  • Ability to develop and deliver clear, compelling executive presentations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English

  • Strong emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and the ability to navigate complex or sensitive customer conversations

  • Demonstrated ability to manage conflict, balance competing priorities, and drive alignment across multiple interested parties

  • Strong ownership and follow-through, supported by a structured approach to tracking, prioritizing, and closing complex technical and business actions

  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management skills

  • Willingness to travel approximately 15–20% of the time and availability for recurring onsite work at both Adobe offices and customer locations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions

  • Experience supporting large-scale digital experience, marketing technology, analytics, content management, advertising technology, customer data, or AI platforms

  • Experience working with distributed, multi-functional teams in a global enterprise environment

title: Senior Enterprise Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) is a senior business-critical role responsible for overall solution health and maintaining a high standard of technical operational excellence to deliver customer value, accelerate solution use, and be the customer’s advocate with Adobe product and engineering.
eTAMs quickly grasp a customer's landscape, assess their maturity and solution lifecycle, and identify immediate, short- and long-term wins. You will share expert guidance grounded in Adobe and industry standards.
Consistent technical rigor, dependable solution health, and a focus on customer needs are central to this role. Building a clear technical engagement strategy — and following through on it — is how eTAMs help customers succeed.
Responsibilities:
  • Deliver consistent technical excellence through early engagement and ongoing solution health monitoring
  • Lead capability roadmap and discovery sessions with customers to uncover both quick and larger engagements that increase adoption and product use
  • Identify technical risk by understanding customer use cases, and flag potential challenges proactively
  • Increase product adoption through measurable engagements that build customer understanding
  • Maintain regular communication with internal and external teams, consistently representing customer needs
  • Engage with Director and VP-Level executives to translate business needs into technical and operational plans
  • Manage all technical challenges and ensure customers tickets and issues are fully addressed and resolved with urgency
  • Work hands-on with cross-functional Adobe teams to ensure customers are provided with the highest level of proactive support and technical strategy based on Adobe/industry standards
  • Make sure customers are aware of opportunities available through the Ultimate Success program and customer alpha/beta programs, and help them take part
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and prelaunch planning. Present clear data and insights to customer leadership
  • Serve as the first point of contact for critical technical concerns, and coordinate resolutions with Adobe services, sales, product, and engineering teams
  • Assess and document customers’ technical environment to reveal ongoing insights, improvements, and optimization opportunities
  • Proactively recommend how new and existing features fit within customers’ environments, using industry and Adobe standards and proven methodologies
  • Participate in customer-requested meetings, as well as strategic and quarterly business reviews (on-site and remote)
  • Participate in project-based, consultant-led architectural and design discussions to ensure solutions are optimal for the customer(s)
  • Continue developing your technical and interpersonal skills, and help mentor team members as needed
Requirements:
  • 10 years of experience focused on building technology roadmaps, enablement plans, support and operations models in either a consulting setting or industry/client side
  • 5 years in a start-up-minded environment, Fortune 500 company, or direct customer-facing consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, information technology management, business, marketing/communications or related field
  • Track record of leading critical customer conversations and bringing opportunities forward to build value and positive sentiment
  • Experience building and delivering a technical health and enablement plan, and clearly articulate wins based on capability activation
  • Deep understanding of how Adobe products fit together to deliver integrated workstreams that support adoption and account health
  • Understand customer needs and organizational maturity, and tailor a technical adoption/enablement plan that fits
  • Deliver value through product activation activities such as office hours, deskside coaching, value accelerators, and field engineering engagements
  • Comfortable bringing opportunities to customers before being asked, rather than waiting to be prompted
  • Demonstrated presentation skills, including comfort on camera and in front of audiences of all sizes
  • Executive presence and direct experience building relationships with customer executives from Director to C-Suite
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  • Focus on resolving blocking and open technical issues quickly
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues thoroughly, using peers and internal resources as needed
  • Regular travel to client locations for planning sessions, QBR/SBRs, and relationship development (approximately 20-30 percent)
  • Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies.
  • Experience and familiarity with at least one of the Adobe capabilities including Content, Data, or Journeys
  • Experience with Adobe products such as: Adobe Analytics, Adobe Audience Manager, AEM, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Target, AEP, Adobe Realtime Customer Data Platform, etc. (certification preferred)

title: Trade and Compliance Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 


We're looking for an attorney to join Adobe's Ethics and Compliance Office, working to ensure Adobe acts with integrity across its business. The role will have a strong focus on trade compliance and will also stretch across other compliance matters, including anti-bribery and corruption. This role is part of a collaborative and tight-knit team, reporting to Adobe's Director of Trade Compliance within the Ethics and Compliance Office. You'll work with business and legal teams across Adobe to deliver business-centric advice and develop practical solutions that use technology to drive compliance.


What you'll Do 

  • Advise Adobe product teams on global trade regulations, including sanctions, export controls, customs, and supply chain rules.
  • Provide day-to-day trade and anticorruption compliance guidance and track emerging regulatory trends
  • Advise Adobe's restricted party screening function on controls, processes, and procedures, including supporting and developing automation.
  • Provide strategic trade and anticorruption compliance advice for complex commercial agreements, including drafting and negotiating terms.
  • Maintain strong relationships across the business to effectively spot and address trade and antibribery/anticorruption compliance risks.
  • Support trade and anticorruption compliance activities related to merger-and-acquisition due diligence and business-integration activities.
  • Provide training on trade compliance topics to cross-functional teams, including sales, product, engineering, and legal colleagues.
  • Handle regulatory inquiries and filings with U.S. and other agencies, as needed.

title: Sr Manager, Integrated Security Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Manager, GSS India- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model.
This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross-functional coordination. Day-to-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.



Key Responsibilities


1. ISOC Leadership & Governance
• Provide end-to-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
• Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
• Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
• Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
• Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.


2. JAPAC Regional Support
• Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage, handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
• Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in-country stakeholders to align ISOC support with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
• Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across
supported markets.
• Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country-specific
requirements.


3. Incident Management Team Readiness & Coordination
• Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria, and supporting documentation.
• Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and lessons-learned reviews.
• Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
• Support After-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
• Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management
Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
4. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
• Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1-AER), enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
• Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities, and testing or assurance activities.
• Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated response and recovery model.
• Maintain current, controlled, and audit-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
• Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.


5. Cross-Functional Partnership
• Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems & Technology, and Environmental Health & Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
• Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness reviews.
• Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
• Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen accountability.


6. Governance, Reporting & Improvement
• Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional leadership.
• Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
• Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and
investment needs.
• Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to ISOC and resilience.


Key Working Relationships


• Internal: Director, India Safety & Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems & Technology Lead;
Environmental Health & Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
• Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
• Cross-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe
Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
• External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and
specialist response capabilities.



Qualifications & Experience


• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.
• Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management, business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline.
• Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment.
• Experience coordinating cross-functional incident response, exercises, After-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs.
• Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities.
• Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added
advantge



Core Capabilities


• Operational leadership and disciplined execution
• Incident command support and decision-making under pressure
• Business continuity and operational resilience
• Intelligence-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis
• Executive communication and stakeholder influence
• Cross-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority
• Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership
• High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care
Measures of Success
• ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence.
• Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC.
• IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure.
• Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems & Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership.
• Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in-scope GSS functions and sites.
• Clear, timely, decision-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities.
• Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions.

title: Engineering Manager- C++
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe’s strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized and connected customer experiences at scale. 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a strong engineering team within Adobe Campaign, with a primary focus on driving the product's security strategy and initiatives while providing broader technical and people leadership. 

The Challenge 

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead technical execution, people development, and strategic engineering initiatives. Your role will focus on: 

  • Security Leadership: Own and drive key security initiatives for Adobe Campaign, working closely with Security and engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and continuously strengthen the product's security posture. 

  • Technical Leadership: Drive architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems. 

  • People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing engineering team. 

  • Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards across software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices. 

  • Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other stakeholders to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. 

Roles & Responsibilities 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers. 

  • Own and drive the security charter for Adobe Campaign, including security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and collaboration with internal security organizations. 

  • Provide technical direction and oversight across the team's engineering initiatives. 

  • Drive scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through strong engineering practices and technical decision-making. 

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define priorities, manage execution, and deliver high-quality outcomes. 

  • Identify and address technical, operational, and architectural challenges. 

  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices. 

  • Participate in hiring and career development of engineers. 

  • Work effectively with geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

Required Skills & Expertise 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams. 

  • Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, design patterns, and frameworks. 

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design experience. 

  • Application security & vulnerability management for enterprise SaaS: Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces. 

  • AI engineering leadership: Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software development practices, with the ability to leverage AI to improve developer productivity, code quality, and security review throughput. 

  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure and modern engineering tools and practices. 

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages. 

  • Experience building scalable and reliable enterprise software. 

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience driving security initiatives for enterprise software products. 

  • Familiarity with security scanning, CVE remediation, threat modeling, authentication/authorization, or security compliance. 

  • Experience working with large-scale enterprise SaaS products.

title: Enterprise Architect (Martech)
descriptionHtml:
Position Summary


As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will design and implement enterprise-level digital experience frameworks that incorporate Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML technologies, and contemporary cloud platforms. You will collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to develop strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operational models that produce measurable customer and business results.


The Opportunity


Digital innovation is transforming traditional business models and impacting every phase of the customer lifecycle. Leading organizations are adopting Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-enhanced experiences to maintain their edge.


What you'll Do


  • Partner with senior leaders to define digital experience, customer data, and AI/ML objectives.
  • Translate business strategy into multi-year architecture roadmaps across Adobe, data/ML, and cloud platforms.
  • Define business drivers, important metrics, and priority use cases, including personalization, journey orchestration, and next-best action.
  • Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and enterprise ecosystems.
  • Define customer data, identity, profile, AI, and data architectures.
  • Design cloud-native architectures using API-first, microservices, event-driven, and serverless patterns across Azure and AWS.
  • Establish secure, scalable reference architectures, governance standards, and operating models.
  • Align business, marketing, product, data, IT, Adobe, and partner teams throughout engagements.
  • Present architecture recommendations, options, and trade-offs to C-level and senior collaborators.
  • Lead architecture workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations.
  • Create reusable architecture patterns, templates, and accelerators.
  • Mentor architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, data, and cloud architecture.
  • Support pre-sales solutioning and position Adobe Enterprise Architecture services.

  • Demonstrated experience in developing enterprise architecture models using API, SOA, and TOGAF frameworks.
  • Experience with public cloud architecture, including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Experience designing AI-powered experiences using LLMs, prompt design, RAG, and model evaluation.
  • Understanding of AI solution patterns, guardrails, agentic workflows, tool-using agents, observability, reliability, and governance.
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or one or more of its solutions.

You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.


You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.


Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.


The Opportunity


Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.


As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:


  • Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
  • Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
  • Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
  • Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.


What You Will Do


Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy


  • Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
  • Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
  • See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
  • Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.

Lead Enterprise Architecture Build


  • Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
  • Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
  • Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
  • Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
  • Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.

Drive Alignment and Transformation


  • Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
  • Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
  • Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.

Influence and Encourage

  • Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
  • Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
  • Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
  • Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.

Contribute to Adobe's Growth

  • Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
  • Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.

What You Need to Succeed


Required Qualifications

  • Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
  • Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
  • Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
  • Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
  • Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across organizations.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Adobe Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 


Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate. 

The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion. 


This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers. 


What You’ll Do 

  • Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives
  • Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes 
  • Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation 
  • Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems 
  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion 
  • Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution 
  • Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap 
  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion 

What Succes Looks Like


We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show: 

  • Customer-to-Solution Thinking — you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability 
  • Architecture with Execution — you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them 
  • Production Awareness — you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts 
  • Enterprise Navigation — you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility 
  • AI-Augmented Execution — you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver 
  • Adaptability Under Ambiguity — you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty 

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years. 


Your Domain 

  • AEP / RTCDP / AJO: Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation 
  • Enterprise Architecture: Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes 
  • Security & Compliance: Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR 
  • Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking 
  • Data Platforms: Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes 
  • Observability: Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring 

What We Value 

Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate: 

  • Agency - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution 
  • Product Judgment - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build 
  • Customer Empathy -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them 
  • Builder Mindset - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT 

Nice to Have :

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target) 
  • Experience with similar platforms - CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms 
  • Background in regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government) and familiarity with their compliance and security constraints 
  • Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration patterns 
  • Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification systems 
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar) 
  • Track record of driving architecture decisions or technical strategy at team or org level 

Why This Team 

  • Work on complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact — your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks 
  • Operate inside autonomous, cross-functional Pods embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA accounts 
  • Combine architecture, strategy, engineering, and customer engagement in a single role — no two weeks look the same 
  • Shape a new engineering engagement model centered around rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution 
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams 
  • Build engineering credibility that earns expansion rights — from workshops to FDE to renewals

title: EHS Regional Manager (Americas)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

You will be responsible for leading Adobe's Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) initiatives and driving continuous improvement of our EHS management system to foster a safety culture across the Americas Region. This includes maintaining compliance with local, state, and federal regulations and company policies to ensure a safe and healthy work environment. This role will work closely with the Regional Director and Site Security Managers and will directly report to the Global EHS Senior Manager. It will also require regular travel within the region.

What you'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) contact for the Americas region and regulatory agencies.
  • Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive EHS programs to drive standardization and consistency.
  • Conduct regular audits and inspections to ensure EHS compliance with regional EHS regulations while maintaining up-to-date records and reports on EHS performance metrics across the region.
  • Lead safety investigations to identify and mitigate potential EHS risks and implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate the development and execution of emergency response plans and training programs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the EHS framework.
  • Integrate EHS considerations into overall business processes.
  • Communicate EHS policies and procedures effectively across the organization.
  • Manage the regional EHS budget to ensure efficient allocation of resources.

  • 10+ years of progressive EHS experience, including 5-7 years in a regional or multi-site management role

  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and implement successful EHS programs

title: 2027 University Graduate - Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.

By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.

Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to have a big impact?


The Opportunity

We are seeking a stellar individual for a high-impact role focused on defining monetization strategy within Adobe’s Creativity and Productivity business segment (historically referred to as Digital Media and home to such premier products as Creative Cloud, Acrobat, Photoshop, Illustrator and Firefly).  We are a highly visible team responsible for making strategic recommendations that have a significant financial impact.  

Our team leads development and refinement of Adobe’s monetization strategy, including monetization of GenAI and emerging agentic capabilities across segments and routes-to-market.  We do this by driving initiatives that optimize new and existing offerings via product innovation, product line determination, business model refinement, and changes to offering and pricing strategy.

As such, the right candidate will find this to be a strong foundation for growth and an outstanding opportunity to have a material impact on the business. 

What You’ll Do

Our team’s role is to influence the product roadmap to drive significant growth in customer acquisition, product usage, revenues, and profits.  This may involve the following activities:

  • Define and optimize the pricing and packaging strategy for offers within the Creativity and Productivity business segment.
  • Collect, synthesize and analyze industry and competitor data.
  • Develop and conduct qualitative customer research.
  • Design and complete quantitative market research including one or more of the following research methods: Build-Your-Own Conjoint, Discrete Choice Conjoint, Gabor-Granger.
  • Perform statistical analysis on empirical data (sales, usage, etc.)
  • Develop financial models that simulate customer behavior and project costs to complete scenario analysis that estimates the impact of proposals on market penetration, company revenues and margin.
  • Develop and present arguments that articulate the strategy and return-on-investment in order to acquire and incorporate cross-functional feedback and ultimately achieve executive approval.

We also ensure smooth execution of our proposals.

  • Engage with engineering, finance, and operational teams to ensure that proposed monetization strategies can be implemented within existing quote-to-cash systems, balancing proposals between ideal monetization potential vs. operationalization
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Product Marketing teams to define product roadmaps to better support monetization goals
  • Set guidelines for direct sales, develop sales plays and training as appropriate.
  • Complete post-mortems to ensure proposals are successful and/or refine.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

We are looking for an analytical wiz with high initiative, a strategic approach and quantitative talent.

  • Proven experience developing pricing and packaging strategies and successfully bringing them to market in a complex matrixed organization.
  • Understanding of emerging GenAI capabilities and their practical application across business processes, customer experiences and operational workflows.
  • The ability to simplify the complex, quickly define the core problem and frame the solution approach.
  • Attention to detail balanced by comfort with ambiguity.
  • Excellent deck-writing, communication, and upward-influencing skills.
  • Strong EQ and leadership ability. 
  • Intellectual curiosity.
  • Experience driving consensus in a large matrixed organization.
  • A background in strategy consulting, product marketing, and/or change-management, ideally in software/technology, are all big pluses.
  • Familiarity with creativity and document management solutions and workflows is a plus.
  • MBA or equivalent experience.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Marketing Intelligence & Consumer Insights
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe's Growth Marketing & Insights (GMI) organization is in the middle of a ground-up reinvention of how marketing teams operate. We're no longer adding AI tools to the margins—we're rebuilding workflows from first principles, with agentic AI at the center. The Forward Deployed AI Engineer role exists to make that happen.

As a member of the AI Strategy & Innovation (AISI) team, you'll be embedded with our marketing analytics and data science teams, working alongside them, learning their craft, and building tools and automations that transform the way they operate. You are both a builder and a partner who can rapidly prototype solutions and take immediate feedback to improve them.

You'll also be part of the connective tissue across the AISI team. You'll share what you build, incorporate what others have built into your own work, and help to establish the playbooks and patterns that scale good ideas across all of GMI. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with marketers across every function and measure ourselves by this question: did we improve the way that someone works?


Who you are

You have a deep knowledge of market dynamics, consumer behaviors, marketing analytics -- including measurement strategy, media experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, and performance insights, and strong opinions on how AI can transform it.

You are a pattern finder and a dot connector -- in terms of understanding how qualitative insights can complement analytics and data science models. You know all about data pipelines, business metrics, attribution, incrementality, audience strategy, and insight generation, and when someone walks you through their workflow, you immediately see where AI can help.

You derive fulfillment from seeing your insights in action and shaping the strategy of the business – with AI as a multiplying force. You are impatient to drive impact – for short term pivots and long-term thinking.

You have working fluency across growth channels—search, social, LLM, and emerging platforms—and the ability to synthesize performance data into holistic channel strategy and media recommendations.

You are a natural systems thinker who connects channels, funnel dynamics, content strategy, and commercial outcomes into one coherent picture rather than optimizing functions in isolation.

Genuine excitement about what AI can do right now and what it will do next. You're pulled toward new AI developments, not just keeping up with them. When a new capability surfaces, your first instinct is to get your hands on it. You have opinions about what's useful, and what's just hype, because you've tested enough of it to know the difference.


Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of technical experience and 2+ years building and deploying AI applications
  • Expertise in AI development platforms and tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, agent frameworks, API integrations, Azure, AWS, etc.)
  • Direct experience working with marketing analytics, product analytics, or consumer insights teams, with a clear understanding of how analytical questions are framed, data is prepared, models are built, insights are generated, and recommendations are operationalized
  • Understanding of customer journeys across organic and paid channels (i.e. search, social, LLM, SEO) to drive marketing recommendations
  • Expertise in Python, SQL, and at least one other common language
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, automations, or agentic systems that change how real work gets done
  • Demonstrated ability to coach or enable others, with evidence that people you worked with changed their behavior as a result
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to make technical ideas feel accessible to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple relationships and workstreams simultaneously, meeting people where they are across different stages of AI fluency

Preferred qualifications

  • Proven experience building AI tools specifically for marketing analytics and consumer insights workflows: automated insight generation, forecasting assistants, segmentation agents, metric monitoring, and other work of that variety
  • Fluency with modern marketing data ecosystems and analytics platforms, including customer data platforms, and APIs used to integrate workflows into custom tooling
  • Familiarity with Adobe's marketing technology ecosystem: Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Analytics, GenStudio for Performance Marketing, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Workfront, etc.
  • Experience building internal tools or playbooks that outlasted your involvement and spread beyond your immediate team
  • Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or client-facing technical roles where you had to earn trust quickly and deliver tangible value fast

title: Policy and Incident Specialist
descriptionHtml:
What you’ll do 

  • Lead the response to significant consumer trust incidents involving fraud, abuse, scams, account compromise, and other emerging threats, coordinating teams across Adobe to assess impact, establish priorities, and drive resolution. 
  • Provide structure and leadership during fast-moving incidents by establishing clear ownership, escalation paths, action tracking, decision-making, and stakeholder communications. 
  • Partner across Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Legal, Security, GTM, and other teams to coordinate response and drive cross-functional action.

  • Translate insights from incidents, investigations, customer experiences, and emerging threats into clear and scalable consumer trust policies and decision frameworks. 
  • Develop and maintain policies, playbooks, escalation criteria, and operational guidance covering fraud, abuse, scams, customer harm, remediation, and enforcement. 
  • Partner with Product and operational teams to translate policy into effective processes, controls, product requirements, training, and customer experiences.

title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead a blended AI engineering team building the agentic AI platform and the marketing solutions that run on top of it. This is a delivery-leadership role: you own the roadmap, execution, and quality bar for a team of platform engineers, applied-AI solutions builders, and data engineering — turning cutting-edge agentic AI into reliable, production systems that marketing and analytics teams depend on every day.

You will operate at the intersection of platform and product: hardening the agentic infrastructure (LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool/MCP integration, deploys, reliability) while making sure the AI solutions built on it deliver real marketing outcomes. You'll grow the people on your team, set a high engineering bar, and partner across a global AI organization.

What You'll Do

Platform & infrastructure

  • Own delivery and reliability of the agentic AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval/RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integration, model routing, and evaluation.
  • Drive engineering quality — test discipline, deployment safety, observability, cost and latency management — across everything the team ships.
  • Set technical direction with your senior engineers; make the hard architecture calls and unblock the team (design-level involvement; not expected to write production code day-to-day).

Applied AI solutions

  • Lead the team that builds AI agents and workflows for marketing use cases (analytics, paid media, content-to-intent, executive reporting) on top of the platform.
  • Ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes and adopted by stakeholders — not demos that stall.
  • Balance platform investment against solution delivery so both advance.

People leadership & delivery

  • Manage, coach, and grow a blended team; run hiring to build out the function.
  • Own the roadmap and quarterly planning; convert ambiguous priorities into committed, sequenced delivery.
  • Represent the team's work to leadership and cross-functional partners; drive alignment across a globally distributed AI organization.

The Team You'll Lead

A blended engineering team of:

  • Agentic AI / platform engineers — Python, LLM orchestration, RAG, MCP/tooling, cloud-native deploys.
  • Applied-AI solutions builders — wiring AI to marketing and analytics use cases.
  • Data engineering — the pipelines and semantic layer the AI grounds on.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • ~12+ years in software / AI/ML engineering, with 4+ years managing engineering teams (including hiring and growing engineers).
  • Demonstrated depth in agentic AI / LLM systems — orchestration, retrieval/RAG, tool use, agent frameworks, and evaluation of AI quality.
  • Track record of shipping production AI/ML systems at scale — reliability, deployment safety, cost/latency awareness — not just prototypes.
  • Strong Python and modern cloud-native / containerized delivery.
  • Ability to set a high engineering bar and make sound architecture decisions while leading primarily through the team.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management across a globally distributed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Marketing technology or analytics domain experience — AEP / AJO / CJA, adtech, or digital marketing analytics.
  • Experience with Databricks, vector databases (pgvector), graph stores (Neo4j), or similar data/AI infrastructure.
  • Hands-on with agent/LLM frameworks and MCP, prompt/eval tooling, and LLM cost governance.
  • Experience standing up or scaling a new AI engineering function.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • A team operating with a clear roadmap, predictable delivery, and a visibly higher quality/reliability bar.
  • At least one AI solution moved from concept to in-production use, adopted by marketing/analytics stakeholders.
  • Platform reliability, evaluation, and cost/observability practices established as the default, not the exception.
  • Key hires made; team members growing and taking on larger scope.

Leadership Behaviors

  • Candor and clarity — lead with the bottom line, disagree openly, separate fact from guess, flag risks early.
  • Ownership — own outcomes end-to-end, not just handoffs; the team ships things that work and says so honestly when they don't.
  • Bar-raiser — hire people better than the current team and hold a high engineering standard.

Builder's bias — move fast on real problems, cut scope ruthlessly, prefer working systems over polished plans.
