title: Digital Strategist
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Digital Strategist helps Adobe's customers translate ambitious customer-experience and digital-transformation objectives into practical strategies that create measurable business value.


Operating as a senior individual contributor within Professional Services, the role works directly with customer executives and cross-functional Adobe teams to understand business priorities, identify high-value opportunities, shape transformation initiatives and connect Adobe capabilities to customer outcomes.


The role bridges strategy and execution. It does not replace delivery, account management or Sales accountability. Instead, it creates clarity around what outcomes matter, where value exists, what should be prioritised and how Adobe can help the customer realise that value.


What You'll Own

  • Lead strategic customer engagements from problem definition through recommendation, value case and actionable roadmap.
  • Establish a clear understanding of customer business objectives, constraints, transformation priorities and measures of success.
  • Diagnose opportunities using customer insight, industry context, data, journey analysis, organisational assessment and Adobe expertise.
  • Develop clear strategic recommendations, business cases and prioritised initiatives based on customer value and execution feasibility.
  • Shape value-realisation approaches that connect Adobe technology adoption to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Build trusted executive relationships through credible advice, sound judgement and the ability to simplify complex issues.
  • Create high-quality strategic outputs that customers can use to make decisions and mobilise action.
  • Engage senior customer stakeholders to clarify desired business outcomes and create alignment around priorities.
  • Challenge customer assumptions constructively where strategy, organisational readiness or execution plans are unlikely to deliver the intended outcome.
  • Translate technology capabilities into business implications rather than leading with product functionality.
  • Identify adoption, operating-model, capability or organisational barriers that could prevent value realisation.
  • Help customers establish meaningful measures of progress and value.
  • Remain engaged at appropriate points through execution to validate that strategic intent is translating into business outcomes.
  • Help restore clarity and executive confidence where strategic programmes are under pressure or customer value is at risk.

Growth & Commercial Influence

  • Identify unmet customer needs and opportunities where Adobe capabilities or Professional Services can create additional value.
  • Shape strategic opportunities with Sales, Services Sales and account teams so customer demand is grounded in a genuine business problem and credible value case.
  • Influence Services pipeline, expansion and broader Adobe growth through strategic customer engagement.
  • Contribute to renewal and retention outcomes by helping customers demonstrate realised and prospective value from their Adobe investment.
  • Balance commercial opportunity with customer trust; recommendations must be driven by customer outcomes rather than short-term product or Services sales.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Orchestrate the right Adobe expertise across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Product and other functions to address complex customer priorities.
  • Create clarity on the strategic problem, intended outcome and respective roles of participating teams.
  • Connect strategy with downstream delivery so recommendations are actionable rather than theoretical.
  • Surface dependencies, risks and organisational barriers early and engage the right leaders to resolve them.
  • Influence without relying on formal authority.

Practice & Capability

  • Contribute reusable approaches, frameworks, insights and lessons from customer engagements to strengthen Digital Strategy capability across ANZ.
  • Help evolve how Professional Services demonstrates and communicates customer value.
  • Bring emerging practices, including AI-enabled transformation where relevant, into customer strategy conversations in a practical and credible way.
  • Coach colleagues informally through strategic engagements and contribute expertise across the wider Professional Services organisation.

What Success Looks Like

Success in the role is demonstrated when:

  • Customers have greater clarity on the business outcomes they are trying to achieve and the priorities required to achieve them.
  • Strategic engagements result in actionable recommendations, investment decisions or transformation initiatives.
  • Customer executives view Adobe as a credible strategic partner, not simply a technology vendor.
  • Adobe adoption is increasingly connected to measurable customer value.
  • Strategic engagement creates or materially advances appropriate Services and Adobe growth opportunities.
  • Customer value work contributes positively to retention, renewal or expansion discussions where relevant.
  • Cross-functional Adobe teams are aligned around the customer's strategic priorities and intended outcomes.
  • Strategic methods, insights and reusable capability improve across ANZ Professional Services.

What You'll Bring

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience advising senior executives on digital transformation, customer experience, marketing, business strategy or comparable enterprise change.
  • Strong consulting capability: discovery, structured problem solving, hypothesis development, synthesis and executive recommendation.
  • Experience converting ambiguous business problems into clear strategies, priorities and actions.
  • Ability to develop business cases and articulate value in commercial and operational terms.
  • Strong executive communication and facilitation capability.
  • Experience leading complex work across multiple stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Sufficient technology and digital literacy to connect business objectives with potential technology-enabled solutions.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively.

Valuable

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or comparable enterprise digital platforms.
  • Professional Services or management-consulting experience.
  • Experience with customer adoption, value realisation or organisational change.
  • Industry expertise relevant to major ANZ enterprise customers.
  • Experience working across Sales, Consulting and Customer Success organisations.

title: Computer Scientist 2
descriptionHtml:
What you’ll do

  • Own the cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform that hosts services end-to-end — provision, upgrade, and operate multi-cloud (AWS + Azure) clusters.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code — Helm charts, ARM/CloudFormation templates, cloud-init, and Python automation for cluster creation, CNI, node scaling, machine health checks, and workload identity.
  • Bake and harden machine images using Packer + Ansible for Linux and Windows, validate them with automated image tests (goss), and manage the container image supply chain.
  • Run observability and alerting — Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk (OTel collectors, saved searches/alerts)
  • Lead production support and on-call — triage incidents, perform RCA, remediate issues and manage node/pod health, capacity, and autoscaling.
  • Design and operate CI/CD and release pipelines using Jenkins and deployment pipelines.
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot platform services — Spring Boot services, node agents, and containerised engine workloads — across Kubernetes and clouds.
  • Optimize scalability, cost, and security — right-size clusters, tune autoscaling/workload placement, enforce network policies and admission control.
  • Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code.
  • Participate in code/infra reviews, cross-functional collaboration, and mentor junior engineers.



What you need to succeed

  • 6–8 years in software/platform engineering with strong DevOps / SRE / infrastructure focus and end-to-end production ownership.
  • Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience — Cluster API / kubeadm, Helm, networking/CNI (Calico), autoscaling, and Linux/Windows node/container workloads.
  • Strong hands-on AWS and/or Azure experience across compute, storage, networking, identity/IAM, and managed services; multi-cloud is a strong plus.
  • Infrastructure-as-code and automation proficiency — Helm, ARM/CloudFormation/Terraform, Packer + Ansible + Python
  • Proven production-operations experience — monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk/OTel, with on-call ownership.
  • CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions, including staged releases, rollbacks, and change management.
  • Database operations experience across relational/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB/DynamoDB/MongoDB, and Redis.
  • Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code.
  • Application and platform security fundamentals — OWASP, Vault/CyberArk, IAM/least-privilege, network policy, OAuth2/OIDC/SAML.
  • Messaging/micro-services familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/Service Bus, and event-driven operations.
  • Git proficiency, Agile/Scrum experience, excellent communication, and cross-functional/cross-time-zone collaboration.
  • Fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development/ops tooling to accelerate delivery and operations.

title: Program Manager, Workplace Design
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Adobe's workspaces are where creativity, culture, and business strategy come together. We're looking for a Program Manager, Workplace Design to help develop environments that reflect our brand and support how our people actually work, across EMEA and India, with reach into other regions as our footprint grows. This role sits at the intersection of craft, relationship-building, and program leadership.


What You'll Do

  • Lead decision making across the full project cycle in partnership with external firms and internal delivery teams
  • Own outcomes for FF&E, materials, colour, and lighting decisions, ensuring consistency with Adobe's brand and experiential graphics standards
  • Partner with cross-functional delivery teams to keep solutions on scope, schedule, and budget, and build guidelines that scale across sites

title: Mgr, Software Development

The Opportunity

Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe’s strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized, connected customer experiences at scale.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to guide a high-achieving engineering group within Adobe Campaign. Security will be the main emphasis of this position, encompassing efforts to enhance the product’s security stance and promote security projects. This position will also offer technical and personnel leadership for essential product development, guaranteeing the delivery of scalable, dependable, and high-quality customer solutions.

The Challenge

As an Engineering Manager, you will direct technical implementation, support people development, and advance strategic engineering initiatives. Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Security Leadership: Own and drive Adobe Campaign’s security strategy in an evolving threat landscape developed by frontier AI models and increasingly sophisticated attack techniques. Partner with Security and Engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and strengthen the product’s security posture. Help advance Adobe’s security practices and capabilities to address emerging AI-related risks while ensuring the continued protection of customer data and enterprise systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems.
  • People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing team.
  • Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices.
  • Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other collaborators to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.
  • Own and complete the security charter for Adobe Campaign, including security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and collaboration with internal security organizations.
  • Provide technical direction and oversight across the team’s engineering initiatives.
  • Deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through sound engineering methods and technical decision-making.
  • Direct application security and vulnerability oversight for enterprise SaaS products, involving threat modeling, secure code review, source/sink/escape analysis, and addressing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
  • Address security vulnerabilities across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, SOAP, and REST surfaces, including injection, broken authentication and authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and complex pre-authentication RCE chains.
  • Partner with teams across multiple functions to define priorities, manage execution, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Identify and address technical, operational, and architectural challenges.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices.
  • Participate in hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Required Skills and Expertise

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, architectural patterns, and modern frameworks.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system build experience.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure and modern engineering tools and practices.
  • Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience building scalable, reliable enterprise software.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software development lifecycles, with the ability to boost developer efficiency, code quality, and security review efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security, secure software development, vulnerability management, or security engineering.
  • Experience driving security initiatives for enterprise software products.
  • Experience with security scanning, CVE remediation, threat modeling, authentication and authorization, and security compliance.
  • Experience working with extensive enterprise SaaS solutions.

Good to Have

Application security & vulnerability management for enterprise SaaS: Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces.

title: Product Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a hardworking, inquisitive, and collaborative attorney to provide exceptional legal support to the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration business, including Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker. The ideal candidate will be a proactive self-starter who will build positive relationships with key stakeholders, partner with the business to identify and mitigate potential risks, and look for ways to optimize how we support the business. Additionally, this candidate will focus on counseling on a wide range of legal topics, including AI/GenAI/agentic AI technologies. This full-time position will be based in the United States in either our Lehi, Utah, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, or San Jose, CA-based location.

What you'll Do

  • Collaborate with internal business partners - including business strategy, operations, and pricing - on the review of Adobe products, services, and initiatives to assess legal compliance and provide practical advice.
  • Support and build positive relationships with product development, product management, product marketing, and engineering teams while advising on legal and business issues through all stages of development and marketing, from concept to launch.
  • Collaborate with legal team subject matters leads, including privacy, enterprise sales legal, AI ethics, and intellectual property attorneys to analyze legal risks and support the business.
  • Draft, negotiate, and support a wide variety of agreements, including inbound and outbound technology licenses, product documentation, and partnership agreements.

title: Sr. Director, AI, Data Science & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Director of AI, Data Science & Engineering to lead the technical organization responsible for building the next generation of AI-powered fraud, abuse, Trust & Safety, and consumer protection capabilities. This leader will oversee AI Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning, and Data Engineering, with responsibility for taking complex trust and risk problems from concept through production. This is an AI-first leadership role requiring deep AI/ML expertise, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to build and scale multidisciplinary technical teams.


This is not a traditional analytics or data science leadership role. We are looking for a technical leader who can connect AI, machine learning, data, and engineering into scalable systems and lead the organization responsible for building them. The Senior Director will define the technical strategy for applying AI across Consumer Trust, with a focus on agentic systems, machine learning, graph intelligence, anomaly detection, behavioral modeling, automation, and real-time risk decisioning. The role will also partner closely with Platform Risk and engineering teams responsible for capabilities such as browser and device fingerprinting, identity graph, bot detection, telemetry, risk signals, and shared decisioning infrastructure. A key responsibility will be connecting these capabilities with AI, ML, and data to create integrated end-to-end protection systems.


What you will do

  • Lead AI Engineering, Data Science/Machine Learning, and Data Engineering across Consumer Trust.
  • Define and execute the AI and ML technical strategy for fraud, abuse, Trust & Safety, and consumer protection.
  • Own end-to-end development of AI and ML capabilities from experimentation and modeling through engineering, deployment, monitoring, and production operation.
  • Drive development of agentic AI, graph intelligence, anomaly detection, behavioral models, and real-time decisioning capabilities.
  • Build the data, feature, evaluation, and ML infrastructure required to operate AI systems at scale.
  • Partner with Platform Risk and engineering teams on identity graph, browser and device fingerprinting, bot detection, telemetry, and shared risk platforms.
  • Bring together platform signals, identity intelligence, AI, ML, and data into cohesive detection and decisioning systems.
  • Establish strong engineering standards for AI systems, including evaluation, reliability, observability, scalability, and responsible AI.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead strong AI, ML, data science, data engineering, and technical leadership talent.
  • Translate technical investments into measurable improvements in fraud prevention, consumer protection, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

What you will bring

  • Significant experience building and deploying AI and machine learning systems in production at scale.
  • Strong technical background in modern AI/ML, including generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, model evaluation, and traditional machine learning.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary organizations across AI/ML, data science, and data engineering.
  • Strong production engineering and systems architecture experience, with the ability to take AI capabilities from prototype through production.
  • Experience with large-scale data platforms, telemetry, real-time systems, feature pipelines, and ML infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and the engineering requirements associated with high-volume, low-latency decisioning.
  • Ability to engage deeply with principal engineers, AI/ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and architects on technical strategy and design.
  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product, operations, policy, and senior leadership.
  • Experience in one or more areas such as fraud prevention, cybersecurity, identity, platform abuse, Trust & Safety, payments risk, bot detection, or other adversarial environments.
  • Experience with identity resolution, identity graphs, graph ML, browser or device intelligence, behavioral signals, reputation systems, or real-time risk platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Experience deploying generative AI or agentic systems into high-impact production environments is also highly desirable.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Front-end), Agentic Governance
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus to build the user experience of Agentic Governance services within Adobe's Experience Platform team in Bucharest.

Trust and Governance builds the services that enable our enterprise customers to trust us with their data: access control, data usage policies and lineage enforcement, catalog, privacy and consent, audit and security capabilities such as customer-managed keys. Agentic Governance extends these foundations to AI agents: who an agent is, what it may do, and a verifiable record of what it did.

You will own the governance admin experience: the console where customers and Adobe teams see which agents exist. Enterprises are putting AI agents to work on their data, and regulation such as the EU AI Act is setting a higher standard for governing them. How should people see and control what an agent may do? This is a new product surface, designed and built from Bucharest.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of the Agentic Governance UI: state management, performance, accessibility and component design.
  • Make complex governance concepts such as permissions, policies and audit trails clear and usable for administrators.
  • Build AI-powered experiences in the UI, such as natural-language policy authoring or audit explanations, with the right guardrails.
  • Build features and own the quality of what you ship: testing, monitoring and performance.
  • Use AI-assisted development responsibly, and help the team raise its front-end practice.
  • Partner with product, design and back-end engineers, and mentor peers on front-end architecture.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Deep front-end expertise in React and TypeScript, including ownership of state, performance and architecture in a production application, not only use of a component library.
  • Full-stack delivery: designing and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience shipping through CI/CD and deploying to AWS or Azure.
  • Strong testing habits for UI and APIs.

The Creativity & Productivity Enterprise Sales Team is responsible for selling the Adobe Creative and Productivity portfolio into accounts in Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe with a focus on new business. The Digital Strategy Group in EMEA is supporting Adobe´s enterprise business and both team together are looking for somebody to support them.

If you want to gain experience in selling complex software solutions into major accounts, winning new business, are a self-starter, and love working in a dynamic environment, then the Adobe Enterprise Sales team is for you.

As a working student, you would be working closely with the Account Executives, Value Consultants and the Management Team and will contribute to the success of the team.

The Creativity & Productivity Team in Central Europe is looking for a working student to support its creative content team. It is the working student´s main job to support the team in all of their sales and pipeline generation activities.

  • Be part of the account teams and help by assembling information and contributing to customer facing material

  • Contribute to special initiatives and bring in your own ideas and creativity

title: 2027 MBA Intern - Corporate Strategy
descriptionHtml:

The Corporate Strategy team collaborates with Adobe’s top executives and our business units: Creativity, Productivity, and Customer Experience Orchestration. We help keep the company on its fast growth path. Our team has contributed to major strategic decisions, including the move to cloud, growth in Digital Marketing leadership, and Adobe's market stance on Generative AI.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized for its collaborative, supportive culture. title: Sr Global Public Policy Manager
descriptionHtml:
Technology is changing faster than the public policies that govern it. As Senior Global Public Policy Manager, you will help us anticipate what's next, make sense of complex issues, and shape the conversations that influence innovation around the world.


The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a public policy leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team. We work across Adobe to understand new public policy challenges, decide where we should engage, and help leaders respond as technology, government, and society evolve. In this role, you will develop positions and strategies on issues including artificial intelligence, digital trust, creator rights, competition, privacy, consumer protection, and the future of work.


We are looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, connecting ideas, and turning uncertainty into action. You will work with colleagues across Adobe and with policymakers, industry groups, researchers, and other experts around the world. If you like building strategy, influencing decisions, and helping leaders prepare for what's ahead, we'd love to hear from you!


What You'll Do

  • Help us build Adobe's approach to technology and public policy issues around the world.
  • Spot emerging trends and explain what they could mean for Adobe, our customers, and our industry.
  • Turn complicated issues into clear recommendations, policy positions, and action plans.
  • Lead work from early research through strategy, internal alignment, and external engagement.
  • Advise senior leaders on risks, opportunities, and possible paths forward.
  • Work with Product, Legal, Engineering, Communications, Trust & Safety, and Government Relations to build shared plans and move work forward.
  • Develop policy positions, executive briefings, presentations, submissions, and advocacy materials.
  • Build relationships with policymakers, industry groups, researchers, and outside experts.
  • Represent Adobe in policy discussions and help shape outcomes in markets around the world.
  • Help our teams prepare for what's next.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • 8+ years of experience in public policy, government, business strategy, consulting, public affairs, political campaigns, or a related field.
  • An interest in technology and how it affects people, businesses, and governments.
  • Strong writing and speaking skills, with the ability to explain complicated ideas clearly.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make sense of incomplete or conflicting information.
  • Experience advising senior leaders and helping them make decisions.
  • A record of building support across teams with different priorities.
  • The ability to develop a strategy, put it into action, and adjust as circumstances change.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and moving work forward without a playbook.
  • The ability to balance long-term goals with near-term results.
  • A willingness to learn new subjects quickly and take ownership from problem definition through delivery.
  • Experience working across countries or adapting an approach to different political, regulatory, or market settings.

What Sets You Apart

  • You ask good questions and quickly identify what matters.
  • You connect policy developments to business goals and turn insight into action.
  • You build trust, listen to different views, and help groups reach decisions.
  • You are as comfortable drafting a memo as you are leading a meeting or briefing an executive.
  • You take ownership, follow through, and focus on results.
  • You are excited to help us shape what's next!

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a full-stack Senior Software Engineer at Adobe Workfront, you will play a key role in shaping the future by designing and delivering high-impact features that empower teams worldwide. You will work closely with your engineering team and partner with Product Management, UX, and other cross-functional experts to turn ideas into realized, scalable capabilities.


Our team is currently focused on the Asset management and Unified Approvals

experience, building a modern, extensible, and efficient approval system that impacts thousands of customers. You will collaborate on end-to-end projects—conception, architecture, experimentation, implementation, measurement, and iteration—and you’ll have opportunities to explore new technologies, influence engineering practices, and contribute to technical strategy.


What You’ll Do

While this role is primarily hands-on, you’ll also be expected to mentor others, guide small-to medium-sized efforts, contribute to planning, identify dependencies and risks, recommend engineering practice improvements, and help specialists grow in their craft.


  • Own the build, development, testing, fixing, optimization, and continuous improvement of software across platforms.
  • Develop new product features that delight and encourage marketers, IT professionals, and knowledge workers worldwide.
  • Guide discussions about emerging tools, technologies, and processes, and evaluate how they can be leveraged to improve our products.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, planning gaps, and opportunities to improve engineering practices.
  • Foster a strong team culture by encouraging contribution, collaboration, and collective problem-solving.
  • Explore and research new technologies, pitch solutions, and validate ideas through experimentation.
  • Partner with Product Management, Design, and other engineers to identify customer-focused solutions and deliver high-quality features.
  • Ensure features are thoroughly tested and perform well under significant load.
  • Interact with customers to refine requirements and identify improvements.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • More than 5 years of programming experience, including recent direct work with React and Node.js, and solid abilities in modern JavaScript technologies like TypeScript and ES6.
  • Solid knowledge of server-side technologies, including Java, Spring, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with data technologies including RDBMS, NoSQL, Kafka, and Elasticsearch.
  • Strong understanding of high-availability concepts and distributed or cloud-based systems (AWS, GCP, Azure).

title: Senior Enterprise Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) is a senior business-critical role responsible for overall solution health and maintaining a high standard of technical operational excellence to deliver customer value, accelerate solution use, and be the customer’s advocate with Adobe product and engineering.


eTAMs quickly grasp a customer's landscape, assess their maturity and solution lifecycle, and identify immediate, short- and long-term wins. You will share expert guidance grounded in Adobe and industry standards.


Consistent technical rigor, dependable solution health, and a focus on customer needs are central to this role. Building a clear technical engagement strategy — and following through on it — is how eTAMs help customers succeed.


Responsibilities:

  • Deliver consistent technical excellence through early engagement and ongoing solution health monitoring
  • Lead capability roadmap and discovery sessions with customers to uncover both quick and larger engagements that increase adoption and product use
  • Identify technical risk by understanding customer use cases, and flag potential challenges proactively
  • Increase product adoption through measurable engagements that build customer understanding
  • Maintain regular communication with internal and external teams, consistently representing customer needs
  • Engage with Director and VP-Level executives to translate business needs into technical and operational plans
  • Manage all technical challenges and ensure customers tickets and issues are fully addressed and resolved with urgency
  • Work hands-on with cross-functional Adobe teams to ensure customers are provided with the highest level of proactive support and technical strategy based on Adobe/industry standards
  • Make sure customers are aware of opportunities available through the Ultimate Success program and customer alpha/beta programs, and help them take part
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and prelaunch planning. Present clear data and insights to customer leadership
  • Serve as the first point of contact for critical technical concerns, and coordinate resolutions with Adobe services, sales, product, and engineering teams
  • Assess and document customers’ technical environment to reveal ongoing insights, improvements, and optimization opportunities
  • Proactively recommend how new and existing features fit within customers’ environments, using industry and Adobe standards and proven methodologies
  • Participate in customer-requested meetings, as well as strategic and quarterly business reviews (on-site and remote)
  • Participate in project-based, consultant-led architectural and design discussions to ensure solutions are optimal for the customer(s)
  • Continue developing your technical and interpersonal skills, and help mentor team members as needed

Requirements:

  • 10 years of experience focused on building technology roadmaps, enablement plans, support and operations models in either a consulting setting or industry/client side
  • 5 years in a start-up-minded environment, Fortune 500 company, or direct customer-facing consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, information technology management, business, marketing/communications or related field
  • Track record of leading critical customer conversations and bringing opportunities forward to build value and positive sentiment
  • Experience building and delivering a technical health and enablement plan, and clearly articulate wins based on capability activation
  • Deep understanding of how Adobe products fit together to deliver integrated workstreams that support adoption and account health
  • Understand customer needs and organizational maturity, and tailor a technical adoption/enablement plan that fits
  • Deliver value through product activation activities such as office hours, deskside coaching, value accelerators, and field engineering engagements
  • Comfortable bringing opportunities to customers before being asked, rather than waiting to be prompted
  • Demonstrated presentation skills, including comfort on camera and in front of audiences of all sizes
  • Executive presence and direct experience building relationships with customer executives from Director to C-Suite
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  • Focus on resolving blocking and open technical issues quickly
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues thoroughly, using peers and internal resources as needed
  • Regular travel to client locations for planning sessions, QBR/SBRs, and relationship development (approximately 20-30 percent)
  • Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies.
  • Experience and familiarity with at least one of the Adobe capabilities including Content, Data, or Journeys
  • Experience with Adobe products such as: Adobe Analytics, Adobe Audience Manager, AEM, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Target, AEP, Adobe Realtime Customer Data Platform, etc. (certification preferred)

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity   

Adobe is seeking an exceptional Senior Director of Engineering to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Growth Apps for Customer Experience Services (CES). In this high-impact role, you'll shape and scale the next generation of enterprise-grade AI applications—defining how our customers interact with intelligence-driven interfaces and workflows.   

This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned engineering leader who thrives in a fast-paced, 0-to-1 product environment and is passionate about crafting intuitive, AI-powered user experiences at scale. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to bring bold ideas to life, continuously pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. 

What you’ll do

CES Growth Apps are Adobe’s scaled growth engine—turning customer experience intelligence, AI, and orchestration into repeatable systems that drive adoption, retention, and expansion at enterprise scale. They are a critical bridge between Adobe’s AI first product innovation and sustained customer and revenue outcomes.  

Customer Experience Services (CES) Growth Apps represent the growth execution layer between Core platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, GenAI services, orchestration layers), Product led capabilities (Experience Cloud, GenStudio, AI driven workflows) and Go-to-market and Customer Success motions. They help ensure Adobe is not just shipping powerful products but is also systematically converting those products.  This leader will own the Engineering strategy for CES Growth Apps and partner closely with Product, Design, AI/ML to deliver deeply integrated, user-centric solutions that meet enterprise-grade standards.   


The successful leader will: 

  • Foster a high-performing, inclusive, and creative engineering culture focused on iteration, design excellence, and technical rigor.   
  • Mentor and grow a world-class team of engineering leaders and ICs, attracting top talent and enabling career development at all levels.   
  • Serve as a visible thought leader both within Adobe and externally—representing the team at key industry events, conferences, and developer communities.   
  • Maintain a strong technical grasp of the team’s architecture and engineering decisions; be ready to dive deep and guide high-stakes decisions.  

    What you'll need to succeed 

  • 5+ years leading Engineering Directors and Senior Managers in a matrixed, high-growth environment.   
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant leadership of teams building complex, AI-powered web applications at scale.   
  • Proven success delivering 0→1 product experiences, especially within AI, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS.   
  • Learning from launching Marketing agents, Ad tech or Sales tech products   
  • Demonstrated ability to drive user experience excellence through engineering, partnering effectively with product design and research teams.   
  • Strategic thinking with hands-on technical depth—you can articulate trade-offs, evaluate system architecture, and influence at all levels.   
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills  
  • Able to translate complex technical ideas to executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams  
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.  

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.


The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.


The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.

You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  • Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  • Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  • Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  • Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  • Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.

  • Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  • Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  • Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  • Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  • AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  • Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
  • Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
  • Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
  • Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

Why This Team

You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.

You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.


Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!

title: Executive Protection Officer / Global Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


The Executive Protection Officer (EPO) / Global Security Specialist will join Adobe’s growing Global Safety and Security (GSS) Executive Protection (EP) program and work in the areas of Executive Close Protection, Travel Security, Residential Security, Protective Intelligence, along with other EP assignments and activities. The person in this role will report to the Director of Executive Protection. They will belong to a team that safeguards Adobe’s Executive Team (E-team) and other senior leaders! This includes VIPs visiting Adobe facilities or attending Adobe-sponsored events. The incumbent will also support other GSS programs such as Investigations, Major Event Security and Crisis Preparedness / Business Continuity Planning. The incumbent is encouraged to demonstrate Adobe Values and handle the position’s duties with discretion, nuance, and maturity. They need excellent judgement, decision-making, and program management skills. 


What you'll Do 


  • Contribute to the expansion of Adobe’s Global EP program which includes Close Protection Operations, Travel Security, Residential Security, and Threat Monitoring. Coordinate contract team members and work in close partnership with Adobe's E-team, their immediate staff, and family members.
  • Establish and maintain trust-focused professional relationships with the Adobe leadership team and key partners.
  • Continuously improve global law enforcement and security liaison efforts with government and private sector contacts to address crime, political unrest, terrorism and violent individual with grievances.
  • Contribute to continuous training and professional development for EP personnel and contracted staff, implementing programs on situational awareness, surveillance detection, digital security, and emerging protective technologies to ensure preparedness for evolving and emerging threats.
  • Review key performance indicators, including response times and risk mitigation success, seek feedback from executives, partners and provide recommendations for improvements.
  • Contribute to regular program reviews, continuously assess and improve EP program’s strategies, protocols, and operational efficiency. 

What you need to succeed 


  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of experience in protective services at the operational and leadership level (senior supervisory experience preferred).
  • Extensive practical experience in protective operations (site advances, route planning, protective intelligence, security vehicle operations, etc.) across both local and international settings. Experience in high-risk locations a plus. 
  • Extensive Dignitary/Executive Protection training in both soft skills (assessment, planning, mentality, conflict resolution, diplomatic negotiations, etc.) and hard skills (protective formations, motorcade operations, counter-terrorism driving, evacuation to safety, threat detection and mitigation, etc.)
  • Ability to walk long distances and remain alert and focused for extended periods of time per executive’s schedule and activity!
  • Demonstrated effectiveness leading a team of security contractors. Skilled at facility / residential security technology deployment and management. 
  • Established track record managing foreign security teams in non-English speaking, and multicultural environments strongly preferred (foreign language ability desired). 
  • Proven capability to collaborate with security and law enforcement partners at all levels, jurisdictions and global locations. Ability to leverage networks / connections and diplomatically engage and develop new support networks in unfamiliar or foreign environments.
  • Effective and appropriate communication with exec and staff and family. Demonstrated ability to brief senior leaders with credibility and confidence. Outstanding people skills, negotiation skills, and ability to work well with others outside of the security or law enforcement profession.
  • Demonstrated outstanding judgement and decision-making during crisis situations involving life-safety matters. Additional training, certifications and life-saving skills preferred.
  • Professional training and extensive experience in investigation, major event security, crisis preparedness and business continuity planning. 
  • Professional training and expertise in surveillance detection and counter-surveillance in domestic and overseas environments preferred.
  • Willingness to relocate and live in the area around corporate headquarters in San Jose. Available for worldwide travel at times on short notice. Ability to expertly navigate international travel, international borders, ports of entry, Embassies and Consulates for traveling teams and Adobe executives.
  • Trustworthy in handling confidential information. Demonstrated discretion and skilled in protection of sensitive proprietary and personal information. Active or prior U.S. Government security clearance preferred.

title: Director of Engineering, Real Time Experience (RTX)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


Adobe's Digital Video & Audio (DVA) business builds Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Media Encoder, the tools that filmmakers, broadcasters, and creators trust to tell their stories. At the center of these products sits the Realtime Experience (RTX) team. RTX owns the rendering engine, GPU abstraction layer, compositor, video player, importer and exporter host, and Effects and Transitions SDK. Every frame our customers play, edit, and export passes through this stack.


The next 12 months will define the future of video creation at Adobe. RTX is finishing its GPU-first pipeline, moving to a modern graphics API, and designing how AI-native rendering fits in. Leader for this team will shape the engine under Premiere Pro and After Effects for years to come.


We are hiring a Director of Engineering for RTX. The team is senior and highly specialized, and it needs a leader with matching depth. The Director will own these modernization efforts and align the many teams that touch rendering, as Topaz and LTX integrations arrive.


What You Will Do


This role sets the technical vision for the rendering technology behind DVA's desktop products, with a near-term focus on Premiere Pro performance and stability. Architectural decisions come with clear investment plans for engineering and quality engineering.


  • Deliver the GPU-first rendering pipeline to improve playback, scrubbing, and dropped frames.
  • Choose and lead the move to a modern graphics and compute API such as DirectX 12, Vulkan, or Dawn/WebGPU.
  • Define how AI features and partner technologies such as Topaz and LTX fit the render pipeline while keeping quality and user experience high.
  • Unify rendering, effects, and transitions across desktop, web, and mobile.
  • Build lasting partnerships with technology leaders and shape our roadmap around their platform plans.
  • Work with media and format teams to modernize legacy components, and align partner teams on shared priorities.
  • Lead the engineering side of a Developer Relations effort to unify and document our SDKs and raise third-party plugin quality, protecting a key competitive advantage.

The Director also grows a team of managers, architects, and senior engineers, protects the quality bar, and coaches leaders as the organization changes.


What We Are Looking For (Must Have)


Are you a technical leader whose judgment shapes the product? The ideal candidate does not need to write shaders, but knows which paths lead to great outcomes and can defend that view to engineers, partners, and executives.

title: Executive Protection Officer / Global Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


The Executive Protection Officer (EPO) / Global Security Specialist will join Adobe’s growing Global Safety and Security (GSS) Executive Protection (EP) program and work in the areas of Executive Close Protection, Travel Security, Residential Security, Protective Intelligence, along with other EP assignments and activities. The person in this role will report to the Director of Executive Protection. They will belong to a team that safeguards Adobe’s Executive Team (E-team) and other senior leaders! This includes VIPs visiting Adobe facilities or attending Adobe-sponsored events. The incumbent will also support other GSS programs such as Investigations, Major Event Security and Crisis Preparedness / Business Continuity Planning. The incumbent is encouraged to demonstrate Adobe Values and handle the position’s duties with discretion, nuance, and maturity. They need excellent judgement, decision-making, and program management skills. 


What you'll Do 

  • Contribute to the expansion of Adobe’s Global EP program which includes Close Protection Operations, Travel Security, Residential Security, and Threat Monitoring. Coordinate contract team members and work in close partnership with Adobe's E-team, their immediate staff, and family members.
  • Establish and maintain trust-focused professional relationships with the Adobe leadership team and key partners.
  • Continuously improve global law enforcement and security liaison efforts with government and private sector contacts to address crime, political unrest, terrorism and violent individual with grievances.
  • Contribute to continuous training and professional development for EP personnel and contracted staff, implementing programs on situational awareness, surveillance detection, digital security, and emerging protective technologies to ensure preparedness for evolving and emerging threats.
  • Review key performance indicators, including response times and risk mitigation success, seek feedback from executives, partners and provide recommendations for improvements.
  • Contribute to regular program reviews, continuously assess and improve EP program’s strategies, protocols, and operational efficiency. 

What you need to succeed 

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of experience in protective services at the operational and leadership level (senior supervisory experience preferred).
  • Extensive practical experience in protective operations (site advances, route planning, protective intelligence, security vehicle operations, etc.) across both local and international settings. Experience in high-risk locations a plus. 
  • Extensive Dignitary/Executive Protection training in both soft skills (assessment, planning, mentality, conflict resolution, diplomatic negotiations, etc.) and hard skills (protective formations, motorcade operations, counter-terrorism driving, evacuation to safety, threat detection and mitigation, etc.)
  • Ability to walk long distances and remain alert and focused for extended periods of time per executive’s schedule and activity!
  • Demonstrated effectiveness leading a team of security contractors. Skilled at facility / residential security technology deployment and management. 
  • Established track record managing foreign security teams in non-English speaking, and multicultural environments strongly preferred (foreign language ability desired). 
  • Proven capability to collaborate with security and law enforcement partners at all levels, jurisdictions and global locations. Ability to leverage networks / connections and diplomatically engage and develop new support networks in unfamiliar or foreign environments.
  • Effective and appropriate communication with exec and staff and family. Demonstrated ability to brief senior leaders with credibility and confidence. Outstanding people skills, negotiation skills, and ability to work well with others outside of the security or law enforcement profession.
  • Demonstrated outstanding judgement and decision-making during crisis situations involving life-safety matters. Additional training, certifications and life-saving skills preferred.
  • Professional training and extensive experience in investigation, major event security, crisis preparedness and business continuity planning. 
  • Professional training and expertise in surveillance detection and counter-surveillance in domestic and overseas environments preferred.
  • Willingness to relocate and live in the area around corporate headquarters in San Jose. Available for worldwide travel at times on short notice. Ability to expertly navigate international travel, international borders, ports of entry, Embassies and Consulates for traveling teams and Adobe executives.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Agentic Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Opportunity 

Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices. 

This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time. 

What you'll do 

  • Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web. 
  • Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience. 
  • Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure. 
  • Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process. 
  • Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment. 
  • Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them. 
  • Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve. 
  • Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding. 
  • Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale. 
  • Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering. 

What you'll need to succeed 

  • Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production. 
  • Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer. 
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier. 
  • Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms. 
  • Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows. 
  • Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines. 
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand. 
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products. 
  • Familiarity with the quality, trust, and reliability requirements of shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience, including responsible AI considerations specific to generative and agentic systems.

title: Software Engineer - Big Data (Compute/Data Distiller), Adobe Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

From the moment you wake up until you go to bed, chances are that most of the media, ads, apps, websites and online shopping you interact with were touched by an Adobe product. Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) is the backbone that powers these experiences: it helps enterprises such as Verizon, Nike, AT&T and Disney centralize and standardize their customer data, build 360-degree customer profiles, and drive real-time personalized experiences. AEP processes terabytes to petabytes of data and serves billions of requests every day.

We are expanding our Compute / Data Distiller team in Bucharest. The team owns two core AEP capabilities:

• Data Distiller – a SQL engine on top of the AEP data lake that lets customers run interactive, batch and scheduled queries, accelerated queries, templates and alerts, and connect BI tools through the PostgreSQL protocol, to derive datasets, audiences and insights. We are also building AI agents that generate and personalize SQL from natural language. 

• Compute Gateway – the multi-cloud, multi-engine compute layer that orchestrates data processing workloads with policy-based routing and support for long-running applications and jobs.

This position is for a key contributor who will help design modern data architectures and highly distributed cloud solutions, and take them all the way to production.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and operate complex features in a large-scale, multi-cloud, microservices-based SaaS product.
  • Own the outcome: lead application, framework and service design efforts, optimizing for quality, testability, scalability and performance.
  • Work on query execution, Spark SQL and query optimization, and the orchestration of compute workloads across multiple engines and clouds.
  • Prototype new approaches and deliver production solutions at scale; research new technologies and keep up with industry trends.
  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Data Science and engineering teams across domains, including our US counterparts on a shared roadmap.
  • Provide guidance in architecture, design and code reviews; mentor teammates and promote good engineering practices and continuous learning.
  • Take part in on-call activities on a follow-the-sun rotation with the rest of the team.
  • Contribute to open-source projects where relevant.

What You Need to Succeed

  • B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree, and/or 3+ years of relevant experience building software systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java and/or Scala, with a solid grasp of OOP, functional programming and design patterns.
  • Proven expertise with distributed data processing: Apache Spark (including Spark SQL), Databricks, Delta Lake or equivalent Lakehouse technologies.
  • Good understanding of SQL, query engines and query optimization, table formats and schema evolution.
  • Hands-on experience with performance optimization, large-scale cluster tuning and efficient big data architectures.
  • Experience building scalable, resilient backend services and REST APIs.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure).

  • Very good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Experience with Kafka, NoSQL databases (e.g. Cassandra, HBase) or Iceberg. 
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL / JDBC protocols or BI tool integrations. 
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana or New Relic. 
  • Experience with Agile / Scrum.

  • Solve hard distributed-systems problems at petabyte scale for some of the world’s largest brands.

title: 2027 MBA Intern - Digital Strategy Associate, Strategic Advisory
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 


The Digital Strategy Group (DSG) works with C-level leadership at Adobe's top customers to craft strategies for customer-experience transformation and digital innovation. As part of our Strategic Advisory team, you'll partner directly with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build the transformation roadmaps that elevate and transform our customers' digital experience.


What You'll Do


Take part in client-facing strategy engagements for customers. In each engagement, you'll join a dedicated team working to solve our customers' biggest digital transformation challenges. You'll work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product experts, and enterprise architects to deliver value for customers. We seek candidates who can contribute in one or more of the

following areas: 


  • Leverage data, research, and industry insights to help customers understand the current state of their digital experience and how their own customers experience their digital platforms 
  • Partner with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build transformation roadmaps that drive business outcomes 
  • Lead the development of innovation and discovery workshops that bring cross-functional stakeholders together to align on business priorities, surface challenges, and co-create transformation opportunities 
  • Translate customer goals and pain points into prioritized use cases and a sequenced roadmap for Adobe investment 
  • Drive high-value opportunities end-to-end, from account planning and qualification through deal closure 

Develop as a business leader! You'll learn about a wide range of Adobe products as you collaborate with people across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Professional Services. The Digital Strategy Group supports clients across the following industries: Retail & Consumer Goods, High Tech & Manufacturing, Financial Services & Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communications, Media & Travel, and Public Sector. You'll complete a survey close to your start date to determine your industry team, where you'll deepen your subject matter expertise as you execute strategy engagements.

  • Currently enrolled full time and pursuing an MBA, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028

title: 2027 Intern - Experience Researcher
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

What does it take for the people who sell to and host Adobe's customers to do their best work? Which tools, technology, and spaces help them build strong customer relationships, and which ones slow them down? As an Experience Research Intern on the Workplace Digital Experiences team, you'll help us find out!


Our team designs and runs the technology behind how Adobe works together, from meeting spaces and customer briefing centers to Lab82, our workplace experimentation program. This summer, you'll lead a UX research project with Adobe's sales and customer-facing teams around the world, including our international markets, and turn what you learn into clear personas and needs. Your findings will help leaders decide where to invest, so you'll see your work shape real decisions!


All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.


What You’ll Do

  • Plan and lead a research study, from research questions and recruiting through a final readout with leaders across Technology Services and Sales.
  • Conduct interviews, observation sessions, and a survey with sellers, solution consultants, and the teams who host customers.
  • Partner with our data analyst to compare what people tell you with usage and service data.
  • Build journey maps and personas, then turn them into a ranked list of opportunities, including concepts to test in Lab82.
  • Use Qualtrics, Miro, AI tools, and Adobe products to plan, analyze, and share your research.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Information Science, Cognitive Science, Psychology, Anthropology, Design, or a related field, with an expected graduation date of December 2027 to June 2028.
  • Ability to participate in a full time internship between May and September.
  • Experience with qualitative research methods such as interviews, contextual inquiry, and synthesis, through coursework, projects, or internships.
  • Experience crafting journey maps, personas, or similar research outputs.
  • Familiarity with survey design and basic quantitative analysis.
  • Clear writing and speaking skills, including turning research into stories that help people make decisions.
  • Curiosity and comfort working through open-ended problems with people across teams.

title: 2027 Intern - Emerging Technology & Innovation
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture & Emerging Technology team is part of Digital Employee Experience (DEX). We explore what’s next for how people work and turns the most promising ideas into something real. Our incubator looks at AI, data, and new ways of working to figure out what Adobe should build, test, and bet on next!


As an Emerging Technology & Innovation Intern, you will bring the perspective of someone entering the workforce just as it is being reinvented. You will own a prioritized emerging-tech challenge end-to-end: frame the problem, research it, generate ideas, prototype the strongest one, and present your findings to senior leaders. We will agree on the specific challenge together at the start of your internship so that it reflects the most relevant questions at that time and your own strengths and interests.


This is a role for an ideas person who is curious about where technology is headed, thinks in terms of people and problems rather than tools, and is eager to make ideas tangible. You will work alongside a team spanning architecture, AI, and incubation. You'll receivewit mentorship and visibility you rarely get this early in a career!


All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.


What You'll Do

  • Research emerging technologies and trends in AI, data, and the future of work, and assess which matter most for Adobe
  • Use design thinking to frame problems, interview employees and partners, and uncover unmet needs
  • Generate and evaluate ideas, and make a clear case for the ones worth pursuing
  • Build quick, lightweight prototypes using AI tools, low-code approaches, or mock-ups to test ideas and make them tangible
  • Bring a fresh perspective on how the next generation of workers will expect to work, and challenge our assumptions
  • Share progress along the way and present findings and recommendations to leadership at the end of the internship
  • Leave behind something reusable: a prototype, framework, playbook, or set of design principles

What You Need to Succeed

  • Currently enrolled full-time and pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, information systems, design, human-computer interaction, data science, business, or a related field; or equivalent degree required with an expected graduation date of December 2027– June 2028
  • Strong working knowledge of AI: you use it regularly, understand what it can and can’t do, and have a point of view on where it is headed
  • Familiarity with design thinking or human-centered design, including research, ideation, and prototyping
  • Genuine curiosity and an ideas-first mentality, with the ability to spot patterns and imagine what could be
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can take an open-ended problem, define it, and move it forward
  • Innovative problem-solving skills driven by data analysis
  • You should have hands-on ability to prototype and test ideas using intelligent automation platforms or visual development environments. Mock-ups are also acceptable. Having a project or experiment with AI to show us is a plus.
  • Ability to explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences, in writing and in person
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to work with people at all levels
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced dynamic environment

title: 2027 Intern - AI & Architecture
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Adobe Data Science team is looking for a summer intern! The team applies AI and machine learning techniques to big customer data to address and challenge business problems, such as driving go-to-market strategies, sales prioritization, increasing product engagement and customer service improvement.


All 2026 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.


What You’ll Do

  • Turn business needs into architecture options. Work with architects and business partners to understand requirements. Then help write up solution options that weigh architecture standards, readiness, implementation effort and total cost of ownership.
  • Build AI tools for architecture work. Prototype AI assistants or agents that help with architecture reviews, risk analysis and documentation, such as summarizing designs, checking them against standards and flagging gaps early.
  • Make architecture guidance easier to use. Apply AI to our standards, reference patterns and architecture repositories (for example, LeanIX) so teams can find and use the guidance on their own.
  • Work across business domains. Partner with Adobe architects across Marketing, Sales, Post-Sales and Finance to design solutions that help customers get started, renew and get more value from Adobe.
  • Evaluate new technology. Research and test new AI and platform technologies, such as agent frameworks, MCP integration and AI observability tools. Share recommendations that feed into the Enterprise Architecture roadmap.
  • Share what you learn. Present your prototypes, findings and recommendations to architects and leaders at the end of your internship.

  • Strong technical background with analytical and problem-solving skills

title: 2027 Intern - Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Cyber Operations team is responsible for the most critical security platforms that help protect Adobe at global scale. We operate and evolve the technologies that enable vulnerability management, endpoint security, and security analytics across hundreds of thousands of systems. Our mission is to ensure Adobe's security tooling remains effective, scalable, and capable of helping defenders make informed decisions in a constantly evolving threat landscape.


As an intern, you'll have an opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, data, automation, and AI! Rather than being limited to operational tasks or classroom-style projects, you'll work on meaningful problems using real security data and enterprise-scale technologies. You'll be exposed to how a world-class security organization collects and acts on information from major security platforms.
