descriptionHtml:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Adobe's Customer Engagement portfolio helps enterprises unify customer data, orchestrate journeys, personalize experiences, analyze customer behavior and business impact, and accelerate work with AI-powered assistance.


This role leads the Customer Engagement solution specialists aligned to Industry-Led CXO sales. It is a third-line General Manager position that owns bookings performance and sets the strategic and operational direction for a large, multi-layered organization.


The successful candidate combines executive gravity, deep customer engagement expertise, and consistent operating rigor. You will shape the portfolio's go-to-market strategy, develop a strong leadership bench, and align Adobe's broad ecosystem around complex customer transformations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive the revenue target

• Run a predictable business. Own bookings performance and set territory and industry strategy, capacity planning, resource alignment, and measurement. Drive a disciplined, low-overhead cadence for pipeline, account planning, forecasting, product performance, competitive risk, and renewals.

• Manage the deal line. Inspect pipeline development and the balance across new, cross-sell, and upsell, and across OPG and Industry. Keep forecast accuracy, coverage, and risk visible.

• Keep evolving the model. Evolve charter, coverage, and operating model as the portfolio and market change.

• Serve as Executive Sponsor on the top deals for your business in any given quarter or year.


Build leaders who build leaders

• Develop second-line leaders who build independent first-line managers and specialist teams with real commercial authority.

• Set the standards for execution, customer-centricity, talent development, and a consistent performance culture across a distributed organization.

• Maintain an active leadership bench and talent development artifacts, with succession plans at every layer and a bench your leaders keep building through mentorship and observation.

• Set team culture: collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and high integrity. Act as an evangelist for specialists and ensure customers understand the value of all of Adobe, not only your own remit.


Be the executive voice of the field

• Bring sales rigor to roadmap, packaging, readiness, competitive strategy, and market gaps. Turn field evidence into decisions and strategy into customer outcomes.

• Serve as the customer advocate to the BU, aggregating feedback across customers and translating requirements into timebound, predictable revenue streams.

• Articulate the state of the business, headwinds, tailwinds, and the plan for target attainment. Lead with solutions when raising friction points, and offer a point of view on the market and competition.

• Executive gravity and communication. Demonstrated ability to influence the C-suite and internal executives, lead strategy, communicate to business and technology audiences, and secure alignment and investment for complex transformation programs.

title: Agentic Outcome Engineer (Customer AI Solution Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
Role summary

As an Agentic Outcome Engineer (Customer AI Solution Engineer), you will work directly with customers to turn agentic AI capabilities into useful, reliable, production-ready outcomes. You will connect business goals to technical implementation—scoping workflows, configuring and validating agent-powered solutions, resolving delivery challenges, and helping customers realize ongoing value.

You will partner across customer teams, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. This role combines hands-on technical delivery with customer communication, practical problem-solving, and a focus on measurable results.



What you’ll do

  • Work with customers to understand their goals, current workflows, constraints, and desired outcomes.
  • Identify suitable agentic use cases and translate them into scoped plans, success criteria, and implementation steps.
  • Configure and operate agent-powered workflows, including relevant tools, skills, data, context, and integrations.
  • Guide implementations from discovery and planning through testing, launch, knowledge transfer, and ongoing improvement.
  • Validate agent outputs and workflow behavior for quality, reliability, and fit to customer requirements; involve human review where appropriate.
  • Fix technical issues across configuration, data flows, access, integrations, and connected systems; coordinate customer concerns with the right teams.
  • Monitor adoption and outcome measures, identify improvement opportunities, and help customers increase value over time.
  • Coordinate work across customer collaborators and Adobe’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.
  • Share customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps with internal teams.
  • Create and maintain reusable documentation, implementation patterns, and automation that improve delivery.


What you’ll bring

  • Experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI or agentic systems, such as LLM-powered workflows, tool use, orchestration, or AI-assisted automation.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues using APIs, logs, configuration, and structured problem solving.
  • Experience integrating cloud software with customer data, services, or business workflows.
  • A practical understanding of testing and evaluating AI-assisted systems, including output quality, reliability, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Awareness of security, privacy, access control, and governance considerations when working with customer systems and data.
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, engage effectively with customers, and collaborate across global teams.
  • A delivery approach: able to prioritize, make progress with incomplete information, and connect technical work to customer outcomes. ]


Helpful additional experience

  • Experience with Adobe products or platforms relevant to the role.
  • Experience in customer onboarding, production deployment, technical account support, or managed services.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation, cloud platforms, data pipelines, observability, or AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Domain expertise aligned to the assigned product area—for example, AEM and Edge Delivery Services migration, or SEO/GEO, CDN configuration, and digital brand visibility.


How success is measured

  • Customers achieve agreed outcomes and reach production use effectively.
  • Agent-powered workflows meet agreed expectations for quality, reliability, and safe operation.
  • Customers adopt the solution and continue to realize value after initial implementation.
  • Technical blockers are resolved or brought up with clear ownership and momentum.
  • Customer feedback leads to useful product improvements, reusable guidance, or delivery automation.

title: Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Join Adobe Professional Services as an Enterprise Architect, assisting leading airlines and aviation organizations in crafting, delivering, and embracing innovative customer experience solutions with Adobe Experience Cloud.

Collaborating closely with airline clients to help them grasp their business objectives and translate them into scalable, efficient technology systems. You will offer knowledge in customer data platforms (CDP), journey orchestration, campaign management, content management, analytics, and personalization.

In this role, you'll help airlines improve customer experiences, deepen dedication, grow direct bookings, and uncover new opportunities for ancillary revenue generation. You'll work alongside business and technology teams to deliver solutions that facilitate ongoing digital transformation!

What you'll Do

  • Offer airline sector expertise and technical advice within Adobe Experience Cloud, including Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Analytics, and Adobe Target.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and solution development discussions with business and IT collaborators.
  • Develop data architectures and integration methods that link Adobe solutions with airline technology ecosystems, including Passenger Service Systems (PSS), reservation systems, dedication platforms, and digital commerce channels.
  • Develop scalable solutions for customer data management, identity management, segmentation, journey orchestration, decisioning, personalization, and cross-channel engagement.
  • Advise collaborators on technical architecture, solution options, and implementation considerations, identifying risks and dependencies early.
  • Support airline digital transformation initiatives centered on customer experience, direct bookings, dedication, personalization, customer data, and ancillary revenue growth.
  • Direct technical architecture throughout projects, working alongside delivery teams to tackle integration issues and ensure solutions follow Adobe architecture standards.
  • Encourage the growth of consultants and architects by sharing knowledge, providing technical assistance, and evaluating architectural solutions.
  • Contribute to pre-sales activities and RFP responses by developing technical proposals, solution architectures, and recommendations.
  • Work with analytics teams to define success measures and evaluate customer engagement, conversion, personalization efficiency, and business outcomes.

What you need to succeed

  • 8+ years of experience in the airline or aviation industry, including consulting, enterprise architecture, or professional services delivery.
  • Experience working directly with customers to guide digital transformation and MarTech implementations.
  • Experience crafting enterprise architectures involving data integration, APIs, customer identity, data modeling, segmentation, and cross-platform solutions.
  • Experience in airline online channels, managing customer lifecycle, digital retail, dedication, or tailored experiences.
  • Experience with airline technology and data environments, including Passenger Service Systems (PSS), reservation and booking platforms, rewards programs, and customer data ecosystems.
  • Experience assisting or advising consultants and architects, or participating in pre-sales and RFP activities.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Aviation, or a related field.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity 

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions, every single one of those experiences, was touched by an Adobe product. 


We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in Riyadh - Saudi Arabia. 


As a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value. 


What you’ll do 

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability. 


Key Responsibilities 

  • Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales. 
  • Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution. 
  • Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls. 
  • Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans. 
  • Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators. 
  • Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives. 
  • Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution. 
  • Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums. 
  • Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes. 

What you’ll need to succeed 

  • Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution. 
  • Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments. 
  • Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems. 
  • The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives. 
  • Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives. 
  • Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms. 
  • Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity. 
  • Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution. 
  • A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption. 
  • Fluency in English is required.


Location: KAFD, Riyadh

Hours of work: 40 hours per week

Education requirement: Degree or equivalent qualification/experience

Experience requirement: Minimum 5 years in SaaS solution environment

Benefits: Private medical insurance; Employee stock purchase plan; Holiday & global well-being days; Allowances plus many more.

Help shape how AI transforms the way enterprises deliver customer experiences!  

CX Coworker is Adobe’s agentic AI layer across the Customer Experience portfolio, designed to help practitioners turn business intent into action across Adobe applications, within their organization’s governance controls.  

We have a fantastic opportunity to lead product strategy and discovery for CX Coworker Customer Pods! 

These time-limited co-development engagements pair enterprise customer practitioners with focused, cross-functional Adobe teams spanning product, engineering, design, and customer-facing functions. Together, they explore priority business problems, prototype agentic workflows, and validate product hypotheses in the customer's environment. The collaboration creates a direct feedback loop between customer experimentation and Adobe's product teams, helping inform our broader product strategy.  

As a Principal Product Manager, you’ll connect hands-on customer findings with Adobe’s broader product strategy. You’ll align customer and Adobe collaborators on the problems worth solving. You will guide prioritization across engagements and work with core product teams to develop reusable capabilities from validated solutions. Success means more than delivering a compelling customer pilot: it means identifying what should scale, influencing cross-product investment decisions, and building a repeatable path from customer experimentation to trusted, broadly valuable product experiences.  

The role spans Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), relevant AEP & Apps products, and Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker. 


What you'll do

  • Own the discovery, prioritization, and productization of agentic customer workflows validated through Customer Pods, translating customer co-innovation into scalable Coworker and AEP product investments.  
  • Turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product direction, requirements, prototypes, and acceptance criteria. Partner with engineering and design on feasibility, architecture trade-offs, and execution while maintaining a hands-on connection to the customer experience.  
  • Identify platform gaps required to enable scalable agentic workflows, including missing APIs, permissions models, governance controls, workflow primitives, and product capabilities. Partner with platform and application teams to define requirements and prioritize foundational investments.  
  • Own the AI evaluation framework across Pods, defining workflow success and task completion metrics, error rates, human intervention rates, and adoption metrics. Partner with engineering and design to establish evaluation datasets, quality thresholds, and instrumentation.  
  • Lead the definition of strategic workflows across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and CJA / Analytics, such as turning an analytical insight into an audience, activating a customer journey, and measuring its impact. Prioritize opportunities with repeatable value across customers and industries.  
  • Align Coworker and application product leaders on shared outcomes, roadmap dependencies, and investment trade-offs. Build evidence-based cases and distinguish scalable product opportunities from customer-specific implementation work.  
  • Shape product requirements for trustworthy AI-assisted and autonomous workflows. Partner with engineering, security, privacy, and governance teams on human approvals, permissions, evaluation, monitoring, and safe recovery when tasks cannot be completed.  
  • Drive the path from customer validation to productization with core product teams. Synthesize learning across Pods into reusable workflow templates, prioritized platform gaps, and explicit recommendations on what to scale, iterate, or stop.  
  • Influence customer and Adobe executives through clear product narratives, investment recommendations, and candid trade-offs. Partner with product marketing and field leaders to turn validated outcomes into enablement and compelling customer value stories. 


What you'll need to succeed


  • 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record of defining and delivering complex enterprise software products from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.  
  • Deep customer empathy and experience leading enterprise design partnerships or co-development programs. Earn executive trust, navigate competing priorities, and turn individual customer needs into broadly valuable product decisions.  
  • Strong domain expertise in customer data platforms, journey orchestration, marketing technology, or analytics, with depth in at least one area and a demonstrated ability to define connected experiences across products.  
  • Technical fluency in data ingestion, schemas, identity, APIs, integrations, and governance. Engage architects and engineering leaders on platform trade-offs, scalability, and extensibility, connecting technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.  
  • Practical experience shaping AI-powered products or workflows, with sound judgment about agentic capabilities, evaluation, reliability, human oversight, and enterprise deployment constraints. 
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries and build alignment among senior product, engineering, design, and customer-facing leaders without relying on formal authority.  
  • Strong strategic and analytical judgment. Develop compelling cases, make investment trade-offs with incomplete information, and balance near-term customer outcomes with long-term platform value.  
  • Excellent English communication paired with strong executive presentation abilities. You can articulate a clear vision, lead difficult prioritization discussions, and move confidently between portfolio strategy and detailed product decisions. 

Bonus


  • Hands-on familiarity with AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, or Adobe Analytics, and experience delivering use cases across more than one of these products. 
  • Experience productizing AI workflows, reusable integrations, or capabilities first validated with enterprise design partners. 
  • Experience establishing customer co-development programs or product operating models that scale across teams and regions. 
  • Experience with enterprise privacy, consent, security, and regulated-industry requirements.

title: Senior Product Designer, AI-powered Experiences (Adobe Experience Platform)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 


Adobe Experience Platform powers how enterprise brands understand, orchestrate, and deliver customer experiences at scale. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to define how AI-powered, agentic capabilities work across our enterprise products, and how the people who use them stay in control and know they can trust the result. 

Our users are practitioners: data engineers, marketers, analysts, and admins working in corporate, multi-stakeholder environments with real governance, permissions, and data complexity. Most of the job is defining flows rather than laying out screens: how a customer gets from intent to outcome when AI does part of the work. You’ll partner closely with global Product Management and Engineering teams to shape custom AI flows for specific customer needs and enterprise use cases, and you’ll move fast when hands-on work is needed. 


We want AI to make people more capable. If you like untangling complex problems and want a say in how AI becomes something enterprise users can trust, we’d love to hear from you. 

What you'll do


  • Define: own the experience flows for AI-driven capabilities across enterprise products, from the customer’s first intent to a verified outcome. That includes the tools practitioners use to set up and tune the system, and the experiences it delivers. 
  • Model: set up task models, conversation and interaction patterns, and frameworks for multi-step workflows, and decide where prompt-based interaction works and where structure is better. 
  • Build trust: design the moments where a human steps in, plus the transparency, confidence, provenance and evaluation cues and the error recovery that keep users in control. 
  • Connect: shape the handoffs between AI-driven flows and traditional UI so the experience feels like one product. 
  • Partner: work with Product Management and Engineering to shape custom AI flows for specific customer requirements and enterprise use cases. 
  • Prototype: move from idea to testable flow quickly using Spectrum, Figma, and AI design and prototyping tools, and use prototypes to align partners and make interaction decisions concrete. 
  • Structure: make permissions, governance, data-heavy workflows, and multi-persona journeys easier to understand and use. 
  • Elevate: share your craft and flow-thinking with peers through critique and pairing. 

What you need to succeed


  • 7+ years of product, UX, or interaction design experience, with a record of shipping complex products. 
  • 4+ years designing enterprise, B2B, or technical products, such as admin consoles, workflow tools, platforms, analytics, or governance and multi-persona systems. 
  • 1-2+ years designing AI-powered experiences in production or advanced prototypes, including flow definition, conversational or assistive UI, agent-style patterns, human-in-the-loop design, and handling uncertainty and errors. Personal use of AI chat tools doesn’t count. 
  • Expert-level Figma, proven experience shipping fast within a mature design system (Spectrum or equivalent), and active use of AI tools to accelerate design and prototyping. 
  • Ownership of flow definition for a product area with minimal guidance, and the confidence to lead design decisions in conversations with PM and Engineering, including working directly from customer requirements. 
  • Multiple complex features or flows shipped to enterprise customers, with measurable outcomes such as adoption, task success, or reduced support load, and comfort reasoning from behavioral data as well as user research. 
  • Clear communication at the flow level: diagrams, journey and flow maps, prototypes, and storytelling that works for both executives and engineers. 
  • A degree in Design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to have


  • Experience in data, marketing technology, CDP, analytics, or developer-facing products. 
  • Experience running customer-facing design workshops. 
  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration patterns or with integrating first- and third-party AI systems. 

How to apply


Please submit your resume and portfolio. We are particularly interested in seeing: 

  • Work where the starting point was a user problem, not a feature request. 
  • Flows you defined for AI-powered or agent-like experiences, including how you handled trust, uncertainty, errors, and user control. 
  • Enterprise work that shows how you structured complexity such as permissions, governance, or multi-persona journeys. 
  • Evidence that your work shipped to production and what changed as a result. 
  • How you partnered with PM and Engineering to get from idea to a testable flow. 

This position is based in Bucharest, Romania, with a hybrid work model.

title: Manager, Firefly FDE
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Join our “DevOps for Content” revolution, where we partner with global brands and agencies to transform their end-to-end creative workflows—from ideation through activation—to unlock the GenAI-powered Content Supply Chain.

As a Manager, Forward Deployed AI Engineering, you will lead, mentor, and inspire a team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers (FDEs)—creative technologists who prototype, build, and launch GenAI-powered solutions and products directly with customers. Your mission is to cultivate top engineering talent, instill a culture of rapid innovation and delivery excellence, and ensure every engagement drives measurable business impact.

This role requires strong, hands-on technical leadership, people mentorship, and the ability to scale GenAI adoption in enterprise environments. You’ll partner closely with the Director, Forward Deployed AI Engineering, to build a world-class product engineering org with customer-facing DNA. If you thrive on growing talent, scaling engineering excellence, and translating latest AI research into real-world solutions, this is your stage.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership

·       Recruit, coach, and empower a high-performing team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers (and select Forward Deployed AI Architects).

·       Act as both mentor and peer-level engineer—reviewing code, shaping architectures, and guiding engineers on technical depth, delivery velocity, and customer impact.

·       Cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, experimentation, and AI tinkering, ensuring the team stays at the frontier of generative AI and enterprise delivery.

·       Develop future leaders by strengthening technical judgment, customer-facing confidence, and multi-functional influence.

Customer Engagement & Technical Delivery

·       Sponsor and engage directly in strategic customer programs. Roll up your sleeves to build, prototype, and launch solutions and products with your engineers when customer concerns or critical achievements arise.

·       Ensure your teams apply Forward Deployed Engineering principles: embedded collaboration, rapid prototyping, iterative feedback, and production-grade handoffs.

·       Serve as the point of contact for technical and delivery challenges, balancing innovation with governance, reliability, and scale when addressing blocking issues.

·       Champion delivery excellence—every engagement must tie back to measurable value realization and customer adoption.

Technical Leadership & Standards

·       Define and enforce engineering standards across pods, including CI/CD pipelines, reusable frameworks, architecture playbooks, and model governance practices.

·       Partner with Directors of Forward Deployed Engineering and Architecture to align technical approaches across the org and codify patterns into scalable, reusable assets.

·       Funnel field-proven innovations and standards into Adobe Firefly and GenStudio roadmaps—ensuring product strategy is shaped by customer reality.

Thought Leadership & Cross-Team Enablement

·       Stay at the forefront of generative AI, creative automation, and enterprise integration—keeping your teams current and inspired.

·       Foster internal knowledge sharing—publishing playbooks, reusable modules, and lessons learned that accelerate the entire organization.

·       Represent your team in customer workshops, internal reviews, and external forums, showcasing the engineering craft and thought leadership of the FDE org.

What You Bring

·       Technical Credibility – 8+ years of software engineering, AI/ML, or technical consulting experience, with recent hands-on development in full-stack, cloud, and GenAI applications. You can dive into code, architecture, or delivery sprints when needed.

·       People Leadership – More than 3 years in managing people or leading technical teams. Experienced in mentoring, coaching, and developing engineers and architects into highly capable technical and customer-facing talent.

·       GenAI Mastery – Direct experience with modern AI technologies, including LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Llama, Mistral), diffusion models (Firefly, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E), RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).

·       Adobe Platform Fluency – Strong working knowledge of Adobe Firefly APIs, Creative Cloud SDKs, GenStudio for Performance Marketing, and enterprise integration patterns.

·       DevOps & Delivery Excellence – Expertise in cloud deployments (AWS, Azure), CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and enterprise-grade delivery with governance, security, and monitoring.

·       Customer-Facing Leadership – Track record of engaging directly with enterprise customers, simplifying technical complexity, and earning trust as both an engineer and a strategic partner.

·       Culture Builder – Ability to cultivate a high-performance, customer-obsessed culture grounded in engineering excellence, continuous learning, and open collaboration.

·       Startup DNA – Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; relentless about finding faster, better, more innovative ways to deliver impact for customers and scale patterns across the org.

·       Flexibility & Presence – Adaptable and energized by balancing hands-on engineering with people leadership. Willingness to travel up to 30% to support customers and teams in person.

title: Director Cybersecurity and Fraud Public Policy
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a leader to join our Public Policy Team and lead Adobe’s cybersecurity and fraud public policy engagement. The position will be based in Washington, DC, and will report to the Vice President Public Policy. They will partner closely with Adobe’s Chief Security Officer, as well as Adobe’s Vice President for Fraud.


What you'll Do

• Advance Adobe’s global cyber policy objectives in key markets around the world.

• Develop and implement strategic public policy outreach initiatives and advocacy campaigns to engage with key partners and government officials.

• Build and maintain positive relationships with government officials and influencers to promote Adobe’s interests.

• Keep informed of cyber-related policy developments and trends; coordinate with key collaborators to assess impact and provide updates.

• Proactively identify cyber-related policy opportunities and risks, work to mitigate emerging policy risks, and capitalize on opportunities.

• Develop messaging and content to support advocacy engagements and policymaking meetings.

• Collaborate internally across business functions and program manage cybersecurity policy projects, working with cross-functional team members.

• Participate in meetings with internal cybersecurity specialists, both within Cyber Legal, Cybersecurity, and Fraud teams, to understand the technical abilities and needs of our organization, and assess appropriate policy responses.

• Coordinate globally and regionally on policy developments, risks, and engagements.

• Working with technical teams, identify data and cyber information sharing opportunities, and craft new programs for sharing and teamwork that helps harden the cyber-defenses of the entire industry.

• Engage with industry partners, governments, and other team members to build coalitions and strategic public-private partnerships that support our cyber policy goals.


What you need to succeed

• 10+ years of extensive knowledge of the technical aspects of cybersecurity practices and the ability to translate those practices into policy positions.

• A distinguished track record of success.

• Ability to work with leaders in other subject areas to agree on appropriate and effective points of view on the hardest cybersecurity challenges.

• Political competence with an understanding of the political, legislative, and decision-making processes of governments.

• Familiarity with current political, legal, regulatory and market trends impacting cybersecurity policy

• Achievement in developing and advancing cybersecurity policy.

• Experience working with elected officials, community leaders, industry associations, consumer advocacy groups, national and international security professionals and corporate executives.

• Tact and judgment; strong negotiating skills; effective communicator; ability to engage diverse collaborators.

• Strong analytical approach to problem solving, ability to develop solutions to problems, able to deliver on time and work efficiently in high pressure.

• Ability to travel as needed globally.

• Professional level written and spoken English communication and interpersonal talents as a foundation for developing and maintaining strong internal relationships at all levels, cross-functionally, and across business units and geographies.

• A respected and trusted voice in public policy with success in developing and implementing effective policy advocacy strategies.

• Proven track record leading strategic relationships to advocate and influence public policy priorities.

• Deep experience collaborating with engineering groups.

title: 2027 Intern - Business Development Representative (Adobe Sales Academy)
descriptionHtml:
Internship Details  

Location: London  

Duration: 13 months  

Start date: 1st July 2027 

End date: 31st July 2028 

Eligibility: You’re currently an undergraduate pursuing your Bachelor's degree on your penultimate year of study, looking for a placement year/sandwich year - Graduating in 2029 

Hybrid: 3 days per week in the office, 2 days per week work from home  

 Annual Pay: £32,000  


About the role 


Curious about tech but not sure what sales really means? You’re not alone—and that’s exactly why this internship exists. 


You will join our Adobe Sales Academy as a Business Development Representative Intern - our development programme designed to help you build the skills and confidence to thrive in tech sales. In this role, you focus on generating new leads, (both inbound and outbound), as well as qualify and nurture opportunities through the early stages of the buyer’s journey. As a Business Development Representative, you are a critical part of the sales ecosystem supporting your account team and customers.


This role equips you with a fantastic foundation to progress to many other opportunities throughout the sales organisation.  


This isn’t just an internship—it’s your gateway into the world of innovation, customer engagement, and cutting-edge technology.  At Adobe, we’re committed to nurturing the next generation of sales professionals—and that journey begins with you. This program includes hands-on mentorship, immersive training from Adobe Sales Academy and seasoned BDRs, practicing through role plays, and access to developmental courses developed to strengthen your professional and communication skills. 

What you will do   


As a Business Development Representative (BDR) Intern you'll be part of the team that helps Adobe connect with customers at the start of their buying journey. You will be the first point of contact for people interested in our products - guiding them, asking smart questions, and helping them figure out what they need. You'll qualify these opportunities ready to be passed over to our Field Sales Executives.


This includes target market penetration, calling on senior-level executives, following up on marketing-generated leads, webinar and event follow-up, and more.

  • Begin with shadowing your mentor, progress to practicing through role plays and guided activities, and eventually take on more responsibility by contacting customers and leading conversations yourself.  
  • Start conversations with people who’ve shown interest in Adobe—through events, webinars, or marketing campaigns.  
  • Reach out to decision-makers (yes, even senior execs!) and help them understand how Adobe’s tools—like Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Marketing Cloud—can support their goals.  
  • Spot opportunities and pass them on to our sales team so they can take things further.  
  • Work closely with teammates across sales, marketing, and operations to keep things moving and make sure everyone’s in the loop. 
  • Hit your goals for generating leads and building pipeline—don’t worry, we’ll support you every step of the way.  
  • Grow your skills in communication, teamwork, and business—while staying true to Adobe’s values and inclusive culture. This includes participating in structured training sessions, practicing through real-world role plays, and developing both sales-specific and professional skills that will set you up for long-term success. 

​  

What you need to succeed  


We’re not looking for perfection—we’re looking for potential. If you’re curious, motivated, and ready to learn, you’re already off to a great start. 

  • You’re comfortable working towards goals and enjoy seeing results.  
  • You’ve shown drive—whether that’s through university projects, part-time work, volunteering, or anything where you’ve gone above and beyond.  
  • You’re a confident communicator and can write clearly and professionally. 
  • You’re organised, detail-oriented, and a good listener.  
  • You’re tech-savvy and keen to learn how digital tools can solve real-world problems.

  • Pre-Recorded Video Interview - A brief 10-minute video submission 
  • Soft Skills Interview - A competency-based interview. 
  • Presentation - Candidates will be asked to prepare and deliver a short presentation on a given topic. (virtual or in-person) 
  • Assessment Day (In person) - Candidates will participate in a mix of group and individual activities, such as a team exercise, short presentation, sales-focused role play and interview. This is an opportunity to showcase your skills, as well as your potential to succeed in a sales environment.

title: Dir, Enterprise Sales
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

This front-line leadership role is responsible for building and developing a team’s sales pipeline by guiding Product Specialists who deliver on their respective sales goals. You will lead specialist sellers across all products in our specialist organization, build a programmatic strategy for Canada, and shape the product packages and go-to-market plans that fit Canadian customers. Front-line leaders at Adobe have an incredible opportunity to be hands on, model best-in-class behavior, and take direct ownership of the team’s success in all areas. You will be physically present and engaged in the Canadian market, and you will think like a specialist while leading like a local.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead and mentor impactful sellers through sales and account management motions.
  • Coach and support Product Specialists with individualized plans. Give feedback and direction and be willing and able to jump in when needed with a focus on empowering reps to be successful and self-sufficient.
  • Build and execute a programmatic, Canada-specific strategy: tailor solutions, packages, and go-to-market plans to Canadian customers rather than reusing industry-led approaches from other territories.
  • Collaborate with business units and align with specialist leadership and product organizations to build the right regional packages and offerings.
  • Be physically present and engaged in the Canadian market, building relationships across the Toronto, Ottawa, and Montreal customer communities and cultivating customer references.
  • Engage and orchestrate the entire ecosystem team to drive consensus and action. Influence Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Industry Leaders, and partners, and work effectively alongside overlay teams.
  • Act as the CEO of your business. Own territory strategy, capacity planning, and forecasting; scale the processes of leading the team and inspecting deals; and support the team day-to-day across the book of business, including the balance of new, cross-sell, and upsell pipeline.
  • Drive revenue and quota across the team. Coach individuals to own, expand, and close deals, and ensure account and territory plans are in place.
  • Lead large, complex sales processes internally, involving legal, deal desk, product marketing, and more. Serve as Executive Sponsor on the most strategic deals in the business.
  • Articulate the Adobe story and its value proposition, and how Adobe’s solutions align with each customer’s vision and address their business issues.
  • Own how the team sells: review and approve the pitch, demo, materials, and processes, and partner with Enablement to keep onboarding and ramp time sustainable.
  • Influence as an innovative and resilient problem solver who can critically think through and take charge of complicated blockers so Adobe can better serve customers and get deals done at scale.
  • Infuse Adobe’s best interests, values, and processes into all internal and external meetings, and champion all Adobe solutions, not only those in your remit.
  • Be the voice of Sales to leadership: articulate the state of the business, headwinds, tailwinds, and the plan for target attainment.

title: Senior Project Manager – Adobe Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Project Manager at Adobe Professional Services, you will lead the full delivery process for complex enterprise digital experience and transformation projects for key customers.


The role requires an experienced delivery professional with strong program management skills, commercial insight, and the ability to engage confidently with senior customer partners. You will act as the main delivery contact for the assigned customer account, ensuring successful project completion, customer satisfaction, and attainment of business objectives.


This is a senior individual contributor role requiring leadership through influence, collaboration, and strong delivery governance. The position does not carry direct people-management or project-team reporting responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Project & Program Management
  • Take complete responsibility for the full delivery of assigned projects and programs, making sure they correspond with customer business objectives and Adobe Professional Services delivery standards.
  • Serve as the main delivery single point of contact and reliable delivery partner for the assigned customer account.
  • Direct various concurrent projects and workstreams, maintaining seamless coordination, prioritization, and implementation.
  • Establish clear delivery plans, achievements, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria.
  • Promote delivery excellence by ensuring projects are completed on schedule, within scope, budget, and agreed margin targets.
  • Proactively monitor project health, identify delivery risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

2. Customer & Collaborator Management

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with senior customer collaborators, establishing credibility and trust through consistent delivery performance.
  • Lead customer governance forums, steering committee meetings, executive reviews, and critical issues.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for communication between the customer and Adobe's internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively with Account Executives, Services Sales, Solution Architects, Ultimate Success, Technology Office, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Manage complex collaborator dynamics and resolve conflicts through effective communication, negotiation, and decision-making.
  • Identify chances to advance customer experience, delivery performance, and value realization.
  • Show capability to work efficiently within a worldwide, matrix-structured setting that includes teams and partners spread across different locations.

3. Presales & Commercial Management

  • Support presales activities by reviewing proposed solutions, delivery approaches, effort estimates, assumptions, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Lead or contribute to project estimation, scope definition, delivery planning, resource planning, and commercial assessments.
  • Review and refine SOWs to ensure clarity of scope, deliverables, achievements, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and commercial terms.
  • Participate in RFP/RFI responses, proposals, solution reviews, and customer presentations as required.
  • Ensure effective sales-to-delivery handover and alignment between proposed commitments and delivery capabilities.
  • Manage project financial aspects, such as budgets, predictions, resource distribution, costs, and profitability results.
  • Identify and proactively manage scope changes, commercial risks, and potential delivery impacts.
  • Ensure engagements are organized around quantifiable business results and value achievement.

4. Delivery Governance & Execution Excellence

  • Lead the delivery of complex digital experience implementations and transformation projects using Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
  • Establish and maintain effective project oversight, reporting systems, delivery measurements, and processes for managing blocking issues.
  • Ensure consistent implementation across Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
  • Ensure efficient handling of project dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions.
  • Monitor delivery quality, customer satisfaction, achievements, financial performance, and overall project health.
  • Drive timely resolution of delivery challenges, engaging appropriate technical, functional, and leadership collaborators.
  • Ensure consistency with Adobe Professional Services methodologies, operational standards, and delivery guidelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, governance, and customer engagement practices.

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Provide delivery leadership and direction to cross-functional project teams without direct people-management responsibility.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, accountability, and delivery expectations across project collaborators.
  • Influence and coordinate architects, consultants, developers, technical leads, business analysts, and partner teams to achieve project objectives.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and accountability across distributed delivery teams.
  • Mentor and guide project team members through delivery challenges, sharing guidelines and promoting continuous improvement.
  • Proactively address resource constraints, delivery dependencies, and team alignment challenges.

What You Need to Succeed

Experience & Domain Expertise

  • More than 15 years of verified experience in directing and completing large-scale enterprise technology programs and intricate digital transformation efforts.
  • Solid background in delivering Professional Services, ideally within an international technology company or consulting setting.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic enterprise customers and complex collaborator environments.
  • Experience overseeing projects using Adobe Experience Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Experience Platform, and other comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Solid knowledge of digital experience, content management, marketing technology, customer data platforms, analytics, and personalization.
  • Experience coordinating multiple projects and workstreams within a large enterprise customer account.

Program & Delivery Management

  • Proven history of effectively managing complex programs through Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies.
  • Proven experience in project oversight, delivery scheduling, risk assessment, managing dependencies, and resolving blocking problems.
  • Solid grasp of Professional Services engagement approaches, including fixed-price, time-and-materials (T&M), and subscription-based delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project financials, including budgeting, forecasting, allocation of resources, expense tracking, and margin oversight.
  • Experience in defining project scope, developing estimates, preparing SOWs, and managing commercial commitments.
  • Ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining delivery quality and customer happiness.

Leadership & Collaborator Management

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior collaborators and drive outcomes in complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to lead through influence rather than formal reporting structures.
  • Experience collaborating with teams, customers, and implementation partners across different regions worldwide.
  • Strong customer-focused approach with the capacity to develop positive relationships and manage difficult customer interactions.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • High degree of ownership, accountability, adaptability, and attention to detail.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, or Agile/Scrum certifications are preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Successful delivery of assigned projects and programs within the agreed timelines, scope, budget, and margin objectives.
  • Strong customer happiness, collaborator confidence, and executive-level engagement.
  • Effective management of delivery risks, critical issues, dependencies, and project financials.
  • Consistent delivery governance, transparency, and operational rigor.
  • Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and implementation partners.
  • Attainment of agreed customer business results and value realization.

title: Multi Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

As a Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the senior technical authority across our Adobe Experience Cloud engagements, setting architecture direction and delivery standards across all Adobe projects, not just one. You will advise enterprise clients in banking, telco, airlines, hospitality, and retail on designing, delivering, and adopting MarTech solutions across Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Campaign, Experience Manager, Analytics, and Target. 


You will also lead how AI is used in delivery, using generative assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate design, documentation, and enablement, and building AI-driven decisioning into the solutions we deliver. 

What You’ll Do

  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent Adobe projects, ensuring architectural consistency, quality, and on-time delivery. 
  • Run architecture governance, including design reviews, solution assurance, risk assessments, and go-live readiness checks. 
  • Step into at-risk engagements to stabilize and recover delivery, targeting zero-escalation go-lives. 
  • Own end-to-end architecture for complex programs spanning CDP, journey orchestration, campaign, content, analytics, and personalization. 
  • Translate industry marketing strategy into data models, identity and segmentation strategies, decisioning frameworks, and personalization use cases clients can operationalize. 
  • Embed AI tools (co-pilots, LLM assistants, prompt-driven automation) across the delivery lifecycle, and design agentic solutions such as intelligent monitoring, anomaly detection, and next-best-action decisioning. 
  • Guide clients on responsible AI adoption, including governance, privacy, and consent. 
  • Lead workshops and hands-on enablement so client teams can extend, operate, and get lasting value from what we build. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor from technical leads to C-suite, surfacing risks early and steering through ambiguity. 
  • Mentor architects and consultants, contribute to pre-sales and RFP solutioning, and build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and AI-enabled playbooks. 
  • Identify opportunities to deepen Adobe adoption and expand client engagements. 

What You Need to Succeed

  • 15+ years of hands-on consulting experience delivering enterprise SaaS or MarTech solutions, with deep expertise across the Adobe Experience Cloud stack. 
  • Proven technical leadership across multiple concurrent programs, including architecture governance and delivery recovery. 
  • Track record of owning enterprise-scale architecture end-to-end and resolving ambiguous requirements and cross-team trade-offs. 
  • Deep marketing domain expertise in at least one vertical: banking, telecommunications, airlines, hospitality, or retail.

title: Principal Programme Manager  Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity


From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night, consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and the shopping you do online. Chances are that many of those experiences were touched by an Adobe product.


We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Programme Manager, Professional Services to join our team based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Regular travel across the Middle East, including Dubai and other customer locations, will be required, with occasional travel across UKI as needed.


This is one of Adobe Professional Services' most senior programme delivery roles. You will lead Adobe's largest, most strategic and complex customer programmes in the Middle East and act as the single point of accountability for everything Adobe delivers across the programme.


You will lead across Adobe's cross-functional organisation, bringing together our Customer Experience (CX) and Creative & Production teams as one integrated Adobe programme. This includes connecting CX capabilities such as Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Experience Manager with Creative & Production capabilities such as Adobe Firefly and Firefly Foundry, alongside Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Value, Enterprise Architecture, product and specialist engineering teams.


What you'll do

You will co-lead complex programmes with the customer's programme leadership, bringing multiple Adobe service constructs, workstreams, partners and customer teams together through one operating model. You will establish the governance, commercial discipline and delivery rhythm required to keep programmes healthy, predictable and focused on measurable customer value.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end programme leadership as the single point of accountability for Adobe delivery across complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes, co-leading with the customer's programme lead and establishing clear decision rights and one escalation path.

  • Mobilise programmes at pace, establishing the operating model, core team, integrated roadmap, quarterly plan, shared value-scored backlog, RAID and decision log, capacity plan, governance forums and systems of record.

  • Lead the Adobe Core Team, project managers and workstream leads, integrating delivery, architecture, Customer Success, transformation, change and value while ensuring every workstream has clear ownership, customer counterparts, dependencies, plans and acceptance evidence.

  • Bring Adobe's Customer Experience and Creative & Production teams together as one programme, orchestrating capabilities including Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Firefly and Firefly Foundry alongside Sales, Professional Services, Value, Enterprise Architecture, product, engineering and strategic partners.

  • Chair the Adobe programme leadership rhythm and co-chair customer governance, including the Joint Programme Board, quarterly planning, executive steering committees and business reviews, driving timely decisions, transparent prioritisation and committed capacity.

  • Maintain the programme in a healthy green state through active management of scope, schedule, budget, quality, resourcing, dependencies, assumptions, risks, issues and customer readiness, leading recovery and executive escalation where required.

  • Drive predictable services revenue and programme financial health through accurate forecasts, resource and capacity alignment, cost and margin awareness, invoicing inputs, commercial change control and early action on risks to revenue or delivery.

  • Manage contractual and financial milestones through timely customer acceptance and approval, ensuring evidence and acceptance criteria are clear and escalating delays to protect forecast accuracy and revenue.

  • Connect delivery to customer outcomes, KPIs, adoption and value realisation, ensuring capabilities transition successfully into business as usual and value continues beyond technical go-live.

  • Maintain trusted executive relationships and provide concise, transparent reporting on programme health, value, finances, decisions, escalations and required leadership action.

  • Support pre-sales and deal shaping by validating the delivery model, roles, governance, estimates, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance approach, risks and mobilisation plan before signature.

  • Coach project and programme managers across UKI and the Middle East, contribute reusable programme practices and lessons learned, and raise the standard of complex programme leadership across the region.

What you'll need to succeed


  • Extensive experience leading large, strategic, multi-workstream transformation programmes in consulting, enterprise technology or professional services, typically gained over 12+ years in programme delivery and leadership roles.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering successfully in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East, with a strong understanding of regional business culture, stakeholder expectations, relationship-led ways of working and the practical realities of mobilising teams in the region. An established local network is highly advantageous.
  • A strong record of owning customer outcomes, programme health, predictable revenue, financial milestones, delivery forecasts and commercial performance across complex enterprise engagements.
  • Exceptional executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with customer directors, VPs and C-level stakeholders, including during major decisions, escalations and programme recovery.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary, geographically distributed and cross-functional teams across CX, Creative & Production, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, product, engineering and strategic partners, often through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Deep programme management and commercial capability across mobilisation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, forecasting, resourcing, RAID, change control, milestone acceptance and executive reporting.
  • Experience connecting enterprise technology delivery to adoption, operating-model change, measurable business outcomes and sustained value realisation. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Firefly, Firefly Foundry or comparable enterprise platforms is advantageous.
  • A calm, inclusive and decisive leadership style, with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills in English. Arabic language capability would be advantageous.
  • A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PMI PgMP/PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent is desirable, together with substantial experience of Agile and hybrid delivery methods.

Location: KAFD, Riyadh

Hours of work: 40 hours per week

Education requirement: Degree or equivalent qualification/experience

Experience requirement: Minimum 5 years in SaaS solution environment

Benefits: Private medical insurance; Employee stock purchase plan; Holiday & global well-being days; Allowances plus many more.

Application start and end date: Starting 26th October, 2027 for approx. 4-6 weeks.


As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you'll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You'll be surrounded by colleagues committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach, where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you're looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you.

title: Mobile Engineering Manager - Adobe Scan
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe Scan is one of the world's most widely used document capture applications, helping millions of users transform physical documents into high-quality digital assets every day. As we continue to invest in our core product experience, we're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead the Android team responsible for delivering reliable, intuitive, and high-quality scanning workflows.

This role spans the core Scan experience—from capture and editing to organization and sharing—and focuses on delivering a roadmap that drives user value, performance, and stability. You'll lead an engineering team and partner across Product, Design, and Engineering to build impactful mobile experiences at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Lead and mentor a team of Android engineers, fostering ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

title: Engineering Manager - Observability
descriptionHtml:
Join a globally diverse team that both builds and finds best-of-breed tools to bring critical Observability services to all of Adobe. Our team embodies DevOps, as our responsibilities range from crafting new tools and UIs to maintaining and supporting one of the largest logging deployments in the industry, in partnership with other observability tools.

We’re a close-knit team dedicated to providing a robust platform, supporting both Adobe’s engineering teams and each other. We need an experienced Engineering Manager to lead this team, grow its talent, and drive Adobe’s observability strategy forward.

If you enjoy building high-performing teams and solving complex tasks where it’s easy to draw a line from your team’s efforts to real accomplishments, come talk to us.

Job Requirements


  • 10+ years of experience with distributed applications at scale in public and/or private cloud, including 3+ years managing engineering teams
  • Experience leading teams that architect and implement large-scale Observability platforms
  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Proven ability to hire, develop, mentor, and retain engineering talent in a diverse and distributed team environment

Must Have


  • Track record of leading teams operating internally hosted logging systems like Splunk, ClickHouse, Loki, Elastic, supporting clients and improving environment performance and stability
  • Demonstrated ability to drive ingestion cost optimization across a team through data-driven analysis, pipeline guardrails, and direct engagement with customer engineering teams to reduce unnecessary log volume
  • Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry — including collector configuration, pipelines, and instrumentation — and the ability to guide a team executing Adobe’s OTel-native observability strategy
  • Experience setting technical direction for AI agent development and integrating AI workflows into large-scale deployments; ability to steer teams building AI-assisted workflows that surface actionable insights from large log datasets and automate routine user interactions
  • Experience overseeing distributed environments with thousands of users
  • Familiarity with languages like Go and Python sufficient to provide technical leadership, review architecture, and guide engineers building integrations and applications for large-scale Observability environments
  • Experience guiding the design and implementation of systems for fault tolerance, scalability and stability
  • Experience leading teams that develop, deploy and run distributed applications on cloud platforms, including container and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Ability to establish and manage on-call coverage across a multi-tool observability stack, ensuring the team can triage and resolve issues across platforms
  • Accountable for the highest level of up-time and Quality of Service to Adobe’s customers through operational excellence
  • Experience defining service level objectives and service level indicators to represent and measure service quality
  • Knowledge of (public and/or private) cloud deployments
  • Partner with SRE and Engineering/Product leadership to drive critical initiatives and align roadmaps
  • Experience overseeing the design and maintenance of production monitoring systems
  • Ability to coordinate resolution of performance and stability issues using a wide variety of tools
  • Excellent communicator in and across teams, driving projects and people to successful outcomes
  • Impacts the organization through ownership of technical direction, strategic decisions, and team planning
  • Responsible for performance management, career development, and headcount planning for the team

Good to Have


  • Experience guiding teams evaluating and prototyping alternative storage/processing backends (e.g., ClickHouse, Loki) as part of a longer-term platform cost reduction and scalability strategy
  • Experience with other Observability tooling like Grafana, Cortex, and Tempo
  • Familiar with a variety of cloud security and automation concepts, practices and procedures
  • Champion the DevOps/SRE approach across the organization
  • Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, and cross-organizational stakeholder communication

title: Senior Manager, Adobe Commerce
descriptionHtml:
About the Role


Adobe Commerce powers storefronts for merchants and brands worldwide, making security, reliability, and scalability critical.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager with a strong software engineering background, hands-on development experience, and practical security expertise. The ideal candidate brings proven people leadership and a track record of delivering complex engineering initiatives.

While initially focused on security engineering, this broader leadership role offers opportunities to expand into developer tooling, platform engineering, automation, and other Commerce Engineering initiatives.


What You'll Do

  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and career growth.
  • Provide technical leadership across architecture, development, testing, and operational excellence.
  • Own engineering planning and execution, balancing business priorities, technical debt, and security risks.
  • Lead security engineering initiatives across vulnerability remediation, patching, hardening, and automation.
  • Partner with Security, Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to prioritize risks and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Champion AI-first security engineering to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks at scale.

What You'll Bring

Must Have

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on design, development, and delivery of production software.
  • 4+ years of engineering management experience, building and leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong technical foundation in full-stack development (React/TypeScript, Java, Node.js), REST APIs, and microservices, with solid knowledge of system design and security best practices.
  • Hands-on experience in application and cloud security (OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secure SDLC), vulnerability management, identity and access management (OAuth2, SSO), and security monitoring and incident response.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple initiatives, drive execution, and collaborate across teams.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools and automation to improve engineering productivity and security workflows.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills, including managing critical production and security incidents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading security or platform engineering teams in SaaS/cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with threat modeling, vulnerability management, and security frameworks (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Experience applying AI/ML and agentic workflows to security scanning, threat detection, and automated remediation.
  • Experience with Adobe Commerce, e-commerce platforms, or PHP applications.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it.


The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion.

You will work in a cross-functional Customer Pod: a small, autonomous team with end-to-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals.
  • Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  • Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third-party systems.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance.
  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work.
  • Feed field patterns back to product and engineering to shape the Workfront roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers in the pod and set practices for how the team documents decisions and learnings.
  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go-live and expansion.

What Success Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates show:

  • Customer empathy. You meet customers on their terms and understand their constraints and definition of success.
  • Ownership at senior level. You find problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution without waiting for permission.
  • Clear communication. You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings.
  • Business acumen. You understand the use case before choosing the technology.
  • Software craft. You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality.
  • Data and integration judgment. You weigh trade-offs in data models, API design, and system integration.
  • Growth mindset and AI fluency. You use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities.

Typical background: 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering. What matters is what that experience produced, not the title or the number of years.


Your Domain 

  • Work management platforms: Workfront or comparable tools (project, portfolio, resource, planning, proofing, and approval workflows).
  • Integration and automation: REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and low-code or workflow orchestration tools such as Workfront Fusion.
  • Enterprise architecture: Multi-system integration, SSO and identity, data flows, and API design across complex landscapes.
  • Application development: Strong skills in a modern language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
  • Cloud and data: AWS or Azure, plus reporting and analytics pipelines.
  • Security and compliance: Enterprise permissions, data privacy, and regulated-industry constraints.

Nice to Have 

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or Creative Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Workfront Planning, or Adobe GenStudio.
  • Background in SaaS work management, PPM, or marketing operations platforms.
  • Experience building agentic or LLM-powered workflows in enterprise settings.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government.
  • Track record of driving architecture decisions at team or organization level.

How You'll Work: Pod-Based Execution

You operate within a small, cross-functional Customer Pod embedded with specific strategic accounts. Each pod has a customer representative for feedback and validation, a product manager for prioritization, engineers and builders for implementation and experimentation, and an account team with enterprise architects for alignment and strategy.

The Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical execution backbone of the pod: customer-facing, hands-on, and focused on rapid end-to-end delivery. We run small, time-boxed experiments, keep tight customer feedback loops, prototype before fully building, document decisions, and use staged rollouts to reduce risk.


Why This Team

  • Solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact. Your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks.
  • Work in autonomous pods embedded with Adobe's most strategic accounts.
  • Combine architecture, engineering, and customer engagement in one role, so no two weeks look the same.
  • Help shape a new engineering engagement model built on rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution.
  • Join the Lehi engineering community alongside experienced Workfront platform engineers.

This role is for engineers who want to understand not only how systems work, but why they matter to the customer.

title: Regional Security and Safety Manager for Western - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


Adobe’s Global Security & Safety team (GSS) enables life safety and business objectives by delivering critical security, crisis management, and health & safety services.  Based in Paris, France, the Regional Security and Safety Manager for Western EMEA will contribute to this mission, supporting Adobe’s offices and employees in France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, & Belgium.

This role requires a comprehensive understanding of security management practices, to include risk assessment and mitigation, emergency response, event security, physical security systems, and investigations. It also requires significant knowledge and experience with safety compliance tasks – to include health and safety regulations in the assigned countries, fire safety, hazard and risk mitigation, and safety committees. The candidate should model Adobe Values, exercising duties with discretion, nuance, and maturity. They should possess excellent judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills.

What you’ll do 

  • Collaborate with the Regional Director and lead operations at Western EMEA sites 
  • Develop relationships with executives, site leaders, and cross-functional teams to influence compliance and improve security programs  
  • Oversee all aspects of our 24/7 security guarding vendor in Paris; work with onsite manager to ensure successful execution   
  • Conduct audits and hazard risk assessments; address vulnerabilities and complete corrective actions  
  • Lead and implement incident management processes and support business continuity during emergencies 
  • Engage and oversee security systems vendors for install and maintenance; provide support to project teams for office construction and relocation
  • Manage the budget at assigned sites; approve invoices and expenses 
  • Respond to incidents such as theft, alarms, and injuries 
  • Build relationships with local law enforcement, fire departments, and emergency teams 
  • Develop and conduct employee training programs and briefings 
  • Help ensure a safe environment at corporate events 

What you'll need to succeed

  • Minimum 10 years relevant work experience; at least 5 years in corporate security preferred in an international environment
  • Understanding of local laws, regulations and working environments for countries assigned  
  • Experience in role with responsibility for making life safety decisions
  • Proven track record managing security teams, vendors, and contractors,
  • Excellent interpersonal skills; able to communicate effectively with senior leaders, site managers, and partners 
  • Familiarity with security technologies including surveillance and access control; ability to troubleshoot basic issues
  • Strong leadership skills, without ego  
  • Ability to evaluate risks, build solutions, and think creatively 
  • Strong customer service focus with a strive to build programs that improve employee experience 
  • Proficiency in French and English required; any other European language would be beneficial
  • Ability to travel 10-20%
