title: 2027 University Graduate - Enterprise Architecture Analyst
descriptionHtml:
2027 University Graduate - Enterprise Architecture Analyst (Open) 

The Opportunity  

At Adobe, our mission is to empower creatives, marketers, and IT professionals with application-based products that transform their daily work and accelerate progress towards their business goals. Our Technical Pre-Sales (TPS) organization plays a critical role in preparing customers to purchase Adobe’s integrated solutions by understanding their business needs, defining and validating their technical requirements, and demonstrating their ideal future state with Adobe technology.  

The Enterprise Architecture (EA) team is within the TPS group. This role will be supporting the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team within TPS.  

Learn More about Enterprise Architecture   

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team sits within the TPS organization and works directly with Adobe customers to understand their current technology architecture and usage, evaluate its effectiveness as it relates to their larger business objectives, and create a future-state technology architecture to best support their long-term marketing vision.    

You will learn how the team runs, how they interact with customers, real-world customer problems mapped to Adobe software solutions, and what key results they are responsible for building all while supporting and influencing the growing team’s operational strategy.   

What You’ll Do  

  • Learn to connect the dots between customers’ business problems and Adobe’s solution offerings to demonstrate value for our customers and their business   
  • Collaborate with cross-organizational partners including sales teams, solution experts, digital strategists, customer success managers, and more to develop innovative solutions to help them through various stages in the sales cycle   
  • Gain experience with conducting current-state technology analyses and developing high-impact recommendations for future-state technology     
  • Learn to build custom architecture diagrams and phased implementations that showcase how Adobe technology can best support our customers’ objectives   
  • Create presentations to best communicate technical information and architecture mapping to our customers’ business needs   
  • Leverage Agentic AI technologies to enhance our current offerings and help to design the future for our customers’ evolving digital landscapes  
  • Help brands fully capitalize on the era of digital & agentic transformation, so they can deliver personalized and meaningful experiences across all devices and channels for their customers by aligning to Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration solutions.   

What You Need to Succeed  

  • Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a Bachelor's degree graduating between December 2026 and June 2027 
  • Proven interest in business strategy, digital marketing, technology, analytics or experience design through coursework, extracurricular activities, or work/internship experience   
  • Curiosity and/or application across agentic AI technologies, including agents, LLMs and AI tooling  
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills including conducting research, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations

We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with Customers across every screen. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours. 


The Challenge 

We are seeking a Director of Customer Value to act as a strategic partner to senior leadership within Adobe’s most important customers across the Middle East. The role drives measurable business outcomes from Adobe investments, with an emphasis on complex, customer facing enterprises where digital experience, loyalty and personalized engagement are central to growth.

Positioned at the intersection of sales, customer success and delivery, the Customer Value Director takes a long term, outcome led view of the customer journey. The director orchestrates cross functional alignment, establishes value governance, accelerates adoption and communicates business impact. The role is accountable for the value framework and executive narrative, rather than day to day project delivery or commercial ownership. 

What you will do: 


Strategic alignment

  • Partner with customer executives to understand enterprise priorities, transformation ambitions, business challenges and investment criteria, including the ambitions of major Middle East organizations to scale digital services and customer experiences; define a shared vision for the outcomes Adobe can enable.
  • Translate priorities into a joint value roadmap linking prioritized use cases, Adobe capabilities, business owners, dependencies, milestones and measurable success indicators. Tailor value hypotheses to customer economics, such as customer acquisition, loyalty, conversion, digital channel adoption, ancillary revenue and service experience.
  • Work with the Adobe ecosystem to align engagement plans with strategic account priorities.

Outcome orchestration

  • Bring together Adobe Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, technical specialists and partners around agreed value milestones and decision points.
  • Proactively identify risks, misalignment, and barriers to value realization. Coordinate executive escalations when required, ensuring clear ownership, timely engagement from relevant stakeholders, and alignment on resolution plans that protect customer outcomes.
  • Guide customers through business change considerations, operating model alignment and adoption priorities needed to realize value.

Value governance and realization

  • Define value hypotheses, baseline measures, target KPIs and an evidence based approach to tracking business impact.
  • Establish executive governance and business review cadences to validate progress, test assumptions, address gaps and evolve the value roadmap.
  • Build compelling executive value narratives, scorecards and customer success stories that distinguish realized benefits from forecast or potential benefits.

Executive partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders including CEOs, CMOs, CDOs, CIOs, CFOs and relevant business unit leaders, navigating complex stakeholder structures and executive sponsorship models common in major regional enterprises.
  • Lead strategic workshops, business reviews and executive conversations that connect customer priorities, industry dynamics and Adobe enabled outcomes; constructively challenge assumptions where appropriate. Adapt engagement to the diverse markets, languages, customer expectations and digital maturity levels across the Middle East.
  • Advocate for the customer internally and position Adobe as a long term strategic transformation partner.
  • Drive customer advocacy by identifying opportunities to showcase successful transformation outcomes through executive testimonials, customer success stories, industry events, speaking engagements and strategic forums.
  • What you’ll need to succeed 
  • Extensive experience in customer success leadership, strategic customer engagement, digital transformation or comparable senior customer facing roles within enterprise SaaS and cloud technology organizations, with a proven ability to drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence and demonstrated experience engaging, influencing and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, including the ability to navigate high pressure situations, manage sensitive executive escalations and lead challenging conversations with confidence.
  • Proven ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, translating executive priorities into actionable plans while orchestrating internal teams, partners and stakeholders to drive alignment, resolve challenges and accelerate customer outcomes.
  • Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to understand customer business models, identify value opportunities and articulate how technology investments contribute to strategic priorities, operational improvements and measurable business impact.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise SaaS and cloud technologies, digital transformation and customer experience strategies. Experience with marketing technology (MarTech) platforms and ecosystems, particularly in areas such as customer data, personalization and digital marketing, would be a strong advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer relationships, ideally within large, matrixed organizations and across multiple business and technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to develop compelling executive briefings, strategic value roadmaps, business reviews, customer success stories and narratives that communicate business impact to senior audiences.
  • Strong collaboration and orchestration skills, with experience working across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, Engineering and partner ecosystems to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver customer outcomes without direct authority.
  • An understanding of the Middle East business environment, including the dynamics of large regional enterprises, complex stakeholder structures and varying levels of digital maturity. Experience across customer centric industries such as travel and hospitality, retail etc. would be advantageous.

title: Global Alliance Director, Microsoft
descriptionHtml:
About the Role 

The Global Microsoft GTM Lead owns the strategic partnership between Adobe and Microsoft. You will set and execute the joint go-to-market strategy, expand customer relationships and Azure Marketplace adoption, and align executives, field teams, product, and marketing across both companies. As the primary liaison between Adobe and Microsoft, you are accountable for revenue growth, cloud adoption, seller enablement, and delivery of the joint business plan. 


This is a build role. The partner ecosystem is early, programs are still being designed, and you will work across three organizations (including SIs) whose incentives on any given deal don’t always align. You will help shape how frontier AI technology reaches the enterprise through the services ecosystem. 


Key Responsibilities 

Strategy and Execution 

  • Own the end-to-end GTM strategy and operation of the alliance, prioritizing high-value enterprise opportunities and driving revenue through Microsoft field engagement and joint co-sell motions. 
  • Decide where to concentrate investment across the partner portfolio, and make the case to stop investing where returns are not there. 
  • Provide market intelligence and competitive insight on the partner ecosystem to inform product and commercial strategy. 
  • Partner with Adobe’s alliances, sales, partner marketing, and regional cloud teams to keep the motion consistent globally while regions execute locally. 

Governance and Operating Cadence 

  • Lead the alliance operating rhythm: annual business planning, executive business reviews (EBRs), and quarterly and monthly business reviews (QBRs, MBRs). 
  • Develop and manage annual business plans, growth initiatives, and partnership objectives with Adobe and Microsoft leaders. 
  • Build scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management, business reviews, and reporting. 
  • Maintain executive engagement plans, stakeholder maps, governance frameworks, and action tracking. 
  • Prepare executive-ready materials, including strategic updates, account reviews, business cases, win stories, and operating plans. 

Performance and Measurement 

  • Own executive dashboards, scorecards, pipeline reviews, forecasting, and performance reporting for both leadership teams. 
  • Define, track, and report alliance KPIs: revenue influence, Azure consumption, Marketplace performance, co-sell activity, customer adoption, migration outcomes, and executive engagement. 
  • Monitor partnership health, flag risks and opportunities, and recommend actions to accelerate growth. Draw on data from sales, finance, marketing, product, engineering, and customer success. 
  • Drive operational excellence through process improvement, reporting automation, and business insights. 

Field Activation and Marketplace Growth 

  • Expand Azure Marketplace adoption and manage incentive programs, sponsorships, funding, and co-sell benefits. 
  • Activate Microsoft field teams around Adobe priorities and strategic accounts to accelerate adoption of Co-Worker/Copilot, AMA Launch, CSC on Azure, Adobe Brand Visibility, and relevant third-party partner solutions. 
  • Deliver enablement programs, workshops, and GTM guidance so Adobe solutions are positioned effectively in Microsoft customer conversations, driving consumption through Adobe workloads and modern workplace initiatives. 
  • Support regional sales leadership meetings, pipeline management, reporting, and field enablement alongside the Adobe Microsoft Alliance team. 

Marketing and Thought Leadership 

  • Work with Adobe and Microsoft sales and marketing teams to develop assets, events, and customer programs. 
  • Support customer references, success stories, analyst engagements, and executive communications. 
  • Present at industry events, customer workshops, and alliance forums, positioning Adobe as a strategic cloud, AI, and digital workspace partner in the Microsoft ecosystem. 

Cross-Functional and Product Alignment 

  • Align executives, product teams, the Adobe-Microsoft partner team, sales leadership, and marketing around year-over-year revenue growth. 
  • Coordinate stakeholders across sales, marketing, product, engineering, finance, and operations to drive accountability on strategic initiatives. 
  • Work with product management and engineering to align Adobe and Microsoft roadmaps and secure opportunities and funding for integration, innovation, and joint solutions. 
  • Represent customer and Microsoft requirements in product planning, using adoption metrics and usage telemetry to measure impact and business value. 

Qualifications 

  • Education: MBA or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Experience: 10-15+ years in global technology partner management, GTM, and partner sales leadership, working directly with enterprise customers, cloud service providers, C-level executives, and sales leaders. 
  • Industry knowledge: Enterprise software sales and operations, competitive landscapes, and cloud marketplace business models. 
  • Alliance expertise: Deep knowledge of alliance management, co-sell metrics and motions, and partner programs, ideally within the Microsoft ecosystem. 
  • Hyperscaler partnerships: Experience developing GTM strategy and co-sell programs with the largest hyperscalers. 
  • Strategic agreements: Experience planning and executing multi-year partner sales and product agreements. 
  • Influence and collaboration: Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive execution across matrix organizations, including sales, product, and marketing. 
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments across time zones, with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
  • Travel: Willingness to travel as needed to support partner and business priorities.

title: Senior Manager, Labor Relations EMEA (Location: London or Amsterdam)
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity


We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Manager, Labor Relations for the EMEA region. This role will help develop and deliver our approach to labor relations and social dialogue across the region.


Working closely with the EMEA Director of Employee & Labor Relations, you will help set regional priorities, advise the business on complex labor relations matters, and build effective relationships with employee representatives. You will directly lead engagement with the Dutch Works Council and manage a small team of Labor Relations Consultants responsible for our German, French, and Spanish Works Councils.


We are looking for someone who brings strategic thinking, curiosity and sound judgment, with a natural ability to cut through complexity and offer clear, practical advice. You will be an expert at balancing business priorities with a genuine commitment to meaningful social dialogue.


What You'll Do

  • Drive regional strategy: Partner with the Director of ELR to develop and implement our EMEA Labor Relations and social dialogue strategy, ensuring it reflects both business priorities and local requirements.
  • Lead works council engagement: Directly manage the Dutch Works Council relationship while providing strategic oversight and guidance to the Labor Relations Consultants responsible for the German, French, and Spanish Works Councils.
  • Enable the business: Partner with the business to understand their priorities, anticipate labor relations challenges, and develop practical solutions that support business objectives while respecting social dialogue obligations.
  • Stay ahead: Anticipate emerging labor relations trends, risks, regulatory developments, and potential challenges, helping the business plan ahead and make informed decisions.
  • Lead and develop the team: Manage, coach, and empower a small team of experienced Labor Relations Consultants, setting priorities and ensuring effective regional delivery.
  • Drive operational excellence and insights: Evolve how Labor Relations operates across EMEA, strengthening intake, tracking, reporting, and governance to improve data quality, consistency, and visibility of key activities and risks, while providing meaningful insights to inform priorities and decision-making.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant Labor Relations experience in a complex multinational environment, with deep knowledge of European works councils and social dialogue
  • Hands-on experience engaging with works councils, particularly in the Netherlands, and navigating consultation processes across EMEA
  • Proven experience advising complex organizational change and multi-country initiatives
  • Strong business insight and good judgment, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build trust with senior leaders and employee representatives.
  • An strong and articulate communicator who can simplify complex labor relations matters and translate them into clear, practical advice for different audiences.
  • A natural problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, bring structure to complex situations, and identify practical ways forward.
  • Proven experience managing and developing people, with a collaborative and empowering leadership style
  • Proficiency in English

The location for this role may be flexible in our key EMEA markets with a priority for Amsterdam (Netherlands) and London (UK).

title: Mgr, Software Development
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Engineering at Frame.io is about more than just writing code - it's crafting products that inspire creativity and allow our users to do great work. We care deeply about how our products are built, how they look, how they feel, and how they function.

We're looking for an engineering manager to lead our Search squad - a team of dedicated engineers working on our next-generation, search and secure workflow capabilities of our platform. Your squad will participate in cross-team initiatives, as well as own the upcoming work on search, custom fields, metadata, views and workflow features critical to our success as a business.

You'll have 3 main jobs:

  • Empower the squad to be better at their jobs
  • Lead the squad in building ambitious, best-in-class applications
  • Help grow our engineering team and culture

Additionally, you’ll directly contribute to codebases with your feedback and provide mentorship through pair programming. To provide additional space for technical growth, each quarter you’ll pick one week to cancel all your meetings to code. We call these Manager Hack Weeks and it’s an integral part of our management culture.
Success in this role means leading the team to craft the best work of their careers.

What You’ll Do

  • Be a great leader and teammate - we create amazing products by working together
  • Facilitate a squad of highly effective web and backend engineers. Coach them. Provide technical mentorship. Unblock them. Celebrate them. Help them expand their impact each and every day
  • Advocate for engineering excellence and contribute to architecture and high-level structure of our applications
  • Rapidly form action plans to align workstreams across squads, ensuring squad needs are appropriately accounted for and eliminate communication gaps
  • Partner closely with engineers, product, design, user insights, and QA to help shape, sequence, and lead the squad’s engineering work
  • Provide technical leadership to the engineers and be accountable for the technical decisions made on the team
  • Grow, educate, and retain a successful team with a high delivery cadence in an agile environment
  • Co-own the strategy for the squad with your product and design partners and senior partners
  • Help drive culture and process improvements across our engineering organization with guidance to the broader company

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • A love of full-stack engineering, technical leadership, people management, product design, and using exceptional products
  • Experience planning, implementing and delivering projects with multiple engineers, and multiple squads. You’ve taken ideas and turned them into reality
  • A strong desire to foster a working environment that’s enriching, inclusive, and safe, where people of all backgrounds and identities feel welcome
  • Experience working across a full web application stack. You understand a spectrum of technologies at varying degrees of expertise. We use React, Next.js, Apollo Client, Typescript, GraphQL Codegen, and Styled Components on the frontend and Elixir, Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis, and AWS on the backend
  • Experience leading people, including providing formal and informal feedback
  • Passion for collaborating with design from concept to production, and helping engineers to do likewise
  • Track record of delivering beautiful and performant software, including a strong sense of clean animations and flexible layout

title: AEM Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers.

As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences.

The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences.

You will act as a trusted technology advisor to customers, lead complex solution architecture and guide multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes.

What you'll do

AEM and Digital Experience Architecture

  • Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring.
  • Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures.
  • Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6.x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS.
  • Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity.
  • Provide technical leadership across complex enterprise implementations and integrations.

AI and Agentic Experience Adoption

  • Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations.
  • Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems.
  • Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation.
  • Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions.
  • Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety.

Customer and Consulting Leadership

  • Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs and digital business leaders.
  • Lead customer workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and technology strategy conversations.
  • Understand customer business challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions and transformation roadmaps.
  • Shape consulting opportunities by defining solution approaches, contributing to proposals and articulating business value.
  • Clearly communicate complex technology concepts and the business value of emerging AI capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, Adobe account teams, partners and product engineering teams.

Technical and Delivery Leadership

  • Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across large and complex customer engagements.
  • Lead solution discovery, architecture definition, technical design and implementation oversight.
  • Work closely with Delivery Managers and Project Managers to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.
  • Lead and mentor architects, developers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and take ownership of architecture decisions.
  • Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators and best practices, particularly around AEM, EDS and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud innovations and emerging AI technologies and share knowledge across the consulting community.
  • Manage multiple customer engagements and provide technical leadership with minimal supervision.

What you need to succeed

AEM and Digital Experience Expertise

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology consulting, architecture and software delivery, with strong hands-on experience in Adobe Experience Manager.
  • Deep understanding of AEM architecture, including AEM as a Cloud Service, implementation, integrations, deployment and performance optimization.
  • Practical experience or working knowledge of Edge Delivery Services, including block development, Document-based Authoring, Universal Editor and modern front-end practices.
  • Experience with enterprise CMS, headless/hybrid CMS, DAM, composable architectures and digital experience platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AEM Assets, content management, workflows, metadata and enterprise integrations.
  • Familiarity with AEM Cloud Service tooling, Cloud Manager, CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows and Adobe App Builder.

AI and Agentic Capabilities

  • Good understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI and their applications in digital experience platforms.
  • Awareness of Adobe's emerging AI capabilities, including Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker, Firefly, GenStudio and LLM Optimizer.
  • Understanding of how AI agents can integrate with enterprise content, applications and business workflows.
  • Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs, MCP and prompt engineering.
  • Ability to identify relevant customer use cases and architect solutions leveraging AI capabilities.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles, including security, privacy, governance, IP and brand safety.

Technical and Architecture Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and modern web technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Python and APIs, microservices and enterprise integrations.
  • Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, CDN and edge delivery.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, including scalability, security, performance, capacity planning and infrastructure.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps and the complete enterprise software development lifecycle.

Customer and Leadership Skills

  • Proven experience leading enterprise consulting engagements and interacting with senior customer stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to independently lead customer workshops, architecture reviews and executive presentations.
  • Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business challenges and recommend appropriate technology solutions.
  • Ability to articulate technology solutions and their business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience leading and mentoring large, distributed and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple engagements and take ownership of customer outcomes.
  • Willingness to work onsite with customers when required and travel up to 50% on average.

title: Director, Customer Value
descriptionHtml:
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with Customers across every screen.  

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.  


The Challenge 

We are seeking a Director of Customer Value, who is the strategic partner to senior leadership within Adobe’s most critical customers, focused on delivering measurable business value from Adobe investments.  

The role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of sales, success, and delivery, taking a long-term, outcome-led view of the customer’s transformation journey, with clear accountability for tracking, demonstrating, and communicating business value realisation.  

The Strategic Customer Director leads internal cross-functional teams and partners to orchestrate execution against the customer’s strategic goals—driving alignment, tracking progress, and articulating value realization, with a focus on business outcomes over project oversight.  

What you will do: 

Strategic alignment: Partner with customer leadership to co-define business goals, strategic priorities, and Adobe’s role in supporting them. Translate customer objectives into value-focused roadmaps and measurable outcomes aligned to Adobe capabilities. Ensure internal teams are aligned to a shared strategic direction that guides execution and engagement.  

Outcome orchestration: Coordinate Adobe and partner teams to sequence delivery and capability deployment around customer value milestones. Act as the central orchestrator of execution—focused on outcome delivery, not project or task ownership. Identify and remove roadblocks to progress, ensuring a steady march toward defined value outcomes.  

Value governance: Define, track, and evolve KPIs aligned to customer objectives and value realization. Establish a governance rhythm with customer and Adobe stakeholders to review progress and recalibrate where needed. Lead the articulation of success through reporting and storytelling to showcase impact over time.  

Executive Partnership: Build and maintain trusted, strategic relationships with customer executives and senior stakeholders. Serve as the executive voice of Adobe, aligning communications to both business and technical leadership audiences. Elevate Adobe’s position as a long-term transformation partner, driving shared vision and sustained engagement.  

Market Development: Build strategic relationships, drive early-stage growth in market. Represent Adobe through thought leadership, networking, targeted engagement. Represent the voice of customer internally to align teams, escalate blockers, and influence roadmap discussion. Drive cross-functional engagement across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support through insights, risks, and opportunity spotting  



  • Extensive relevent experience in digital transformation, value consulting, value engineering and/or a background in complex technology delivery/transformation programmes.  
  • Capability to exert influence on both customer stakeholders and internal Adobe counterparts, navigating challenging conversations that may emerge during the customer journey  
  • Strong executive presence and presentation skills, comfortable collaborating with and presenting to C-suite executives (CIO, CMO, CFO, board-level)  
  • An ability to understand and communicate the path to business value through technology transformation.   
  • Working knowledge of how Marketing, Engineering and Product teams’ function, particularly in the areas of Data Engineering, Personalization and Customer Insights  
  • Capability to produce and deliver communication materials including Executive briefings, vision documents, strategic account plans, use cases, value metrics, quarterly business review documents, project management documentation, reports, value stories and customer case studies  
  • Demonstrated collaboration and orchestration skills, especially in working with Sales, Customer Engineering & Customer Success, and other key partners  
  • Self-starter, comfortable initiating and leading programs within a fast-paced environment  
  • Results-oriented, strategic thinker who demonstrates an ability to create the future through effective customer engagement   
  • A passion for technology and digital marketing strategy

title: Senior Project Manager Nordics
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

From the moment you wake up until you go to bed, consider the media you consume, the ads you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse, and the online shopping you do throughout the day. Every single one of those interactions is likely powered by an Adobe product.


We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services Team in Copenhagen. As a key leader in Adobe’s Professional Services organization, you will drive the successful delivery of client projects, ensuring that they achieve their business goals using Adobe solutions. You will collaborate closely with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to manage resources, timelines, and budgets while maintaining outstanding client satisfaction.


If you’re ready to deliver impactful results for Adobe’s clients in the Nordics Region, we’d love to hear from you.


What you’ll do

1. Program Leadership & Strategic Value Creation

  • Establish and maintain C-level relationships throughout project cycles to understand customer business objectives and key performance indicators.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Professional Services engagements, ensuring alignment with teams such as Technical Support, Technical Account Management, and Customer Success.
  • Ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales to post-sales execution, translating customer requirements into actionable project plans.
  • Develop and deliver CxO-ready presentations, including return on investment (ROI) and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses, to drive value realization discussions.
  • Assess customers’ current (“as-is”) and future (“to-be”) business processes, identifying and prioritizing key use cases and value drivers.

  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks early and implement mitigation strategies to ensure project continuity and success.
  • Process Improvement: Advocate for and implement best practices in delivery methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum) to enhance service quality and efficiency.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience: 7-10 years of proven experience in delivering complex, transformational projects/programs.
  • Industry Knowledge: Strong expertise in Customer Experience Management (CXM), including Digital Marketing, CRM, and related technologies.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep understanding of the Nordics market, including business culture and operational nuances in Sweden and Denmark.
  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional and distributed teams, fostering collaboration and accountability.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with a track record of resolving complex project challenges.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English. Any other Scandinavian language would be a plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, and MS Project, along with expertise in Agile delivery frameworks.

This position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

title: Product Manager - Observability
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Adobe is redefining creativity, document intelligence, and digital experience through AI. The role requires an AI-native Product Manager to own Enterprise Platform Observability and the service health monitoring and alerting platform used by internal service teams across Adobe. Observability is what lets hundreds of teams ship quickly and operate reliably across extensive environments, and this role is central to making that possible.

You’ll own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for the telemetry, monitoring, and alerting systems that thousands of engineers depend on every day. This is a hands-on IC role with real scope: you’ll work directly with platform engineering, SRE, and service owners to make Adobe’s services easier to understand, faster to debug, and more reliable for customers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems rather than features, has shipped infrastructure or developer-facing products at scale, and sees AI to fundamentally change how teams detect, diagnose, and resolve issues.


What You’ll Own


  • Observability Platform Product. Own the product vision and strategy for enterprise observability, including metrics, logs, traces, and the unified experiences built on top of them. Define how internal teams instrument services, consume telemetry, and gain insight into system behavior across a multi-cloud environment. Coordinate with Engineering teams to translate those priorities into products and features.
  • AI-Powered Observability. Lead the introduction of AI into the observability lifecycle: anomaly detection, intelligent alert correlation, automated root cause analysis, natural-language querying of telemetry, and agentic incident workflows. Ensure the right human-in-the-loop moments are preserved where judgment matters.
  • Internal Customer Partnership. Treat internal service teams as customers. Run discovery, gather feedback, track adoption and satisfaction, and translate real operational pain into prioritized product investments. Partner closely with SRE, incident management, and on-call communities.

What We’re Looking For


  • Platform product experience. 5+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on infrastructure, observability, monitoring, or developer platform products consumed by large engineering organizations.

You can discuss SLIs/SLOs, alerting strategy, incident response, cardinality and cost tradeoffs, and distributed systems behavior. You’re comfortable reviewing design docs and debating tradeoffs with principal engineers. You don’t need to write production code, but you can read it and reason about it.

  • Internal platform product sense. You know how to drive adoption without a sales funnel: by earning trust, reducing friction, and delivering measurable value to internal customers.
  • Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts quickly. You can synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets with incomplete information, and adjust course without losing momentum.
  • Strong influence and communication. You lead through influence across engineering, SRE, security, and program management, and communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior leaders.
